raw.description:
Job Summary and Responsibilities

As our Market Manager, Revenue Cycle Input Coding, you will provide strategic oversight of coding teams, holding them accountable to enterprise-established Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including critical metrics like "Discharge Not Final Coded" (DNFC). This leadership role is central to optimizing our revenue cycle management by ensuring superior accuracy and compliance in all coding activities.

Every day you will leverage your expertise as a subject matter expert in current ICD coding classification systems, healthcare reimbursement, and enterprise compliance plans. You will actively manage staff, ensuring the coding team consistently meets rigorous productivity and quality standards, and develop effective performance improvement plans as needed. You will also serve as a vital liaison between CDI, physicians, clinical quality, and patient financial services, fostering collaborative relationships essential for the accuracy and integrity of the inpatient medical record.

To be successful in this role, you will need a deep understanding of ICD-10 coding, compliance, and healthcare revenue cycle operations. We are seeking a dynamic leader with proven experience in managing and developing coding teams, a strong analytical mindset to track and improve KPIs, and exceptional interpersonal skills to build strong cross-functional partnerships. Your ability to drive operational excellence in medical coding is paramount.

  • Oversees inpatient coding, ensuring optimal performance and adhere to compliant coding practices and regulatory requirements. Adhere to the ethical standards of coding as established by AAPC and/or AHIMA
  • Actively monitors daily DNFC and coding work queues to ensure KPIs are met. Ensures coding team meets productivity and coding accuracy standards, develop action plans for sustained improvements and KPIs
  • Acts as a liaison with CDI, patient financial services, patient registration, clinical staff to resolve problems and improve workflow
  • Ability to identify and determine resolution of complex issues. Ability to troubleshoot computer issues timely while working remotely
  • Assist CSH leadership in strategic planning and assists with the development of combined coding and CDI steering presentations
  • Ability to communicate effectively, deliver presentations to large groups, stay organized, and demonstrate effective leadership skills

Job Requirements

Required

  • Associate’s degree in HIM or related field
  • Four to six (4-6) years of recent management of hospital-based coding teams (hospital, large multi-facility organization, etc.)
  • Four to six (4-6) years experience in process improvement strategies and mentoring staff
  • Four to six (4-6) years experience effectively managing remote teams
  • Registered Health Information Administrator
  • Registered Health Information Technician
  • Certified Coding Specialist

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree or Bachelor's degree in HIM or related field
  • Three plus (3+)) years of inpatient coding experience
  • Four to six (4-6) years experience working in a level I/II trauma center and/or teaching hospital with complex conditions and procedures (cardiovascular/interventional radiology, orthopedic, neurosurgery, and obstetrics/NICU)
  • Experience working with a CDI program

Where You’ll Work

Inspired by faith. Driven by innovation. Powered by humankindness. CommonSpirit Health is building a healthier future for all through its integrated health services. As one of the nation’s largest nonprofit Catholic healthcare organizations, CommonSpirit Health delivers more than 20 million patient encounters annually through more than 2,300 clinics, care sites and 137 hospital-based locations, in addition to its home-based services and virtual care offerings. CommonSpirit has more than 157,000 employees, 45,000 nurses and 25,000 physicians and advanced practice providers across 24 states and contributes more than $4.2 billion annually in charity care, community benefits and unreimbursed government programs. Together with our patients, physicians, partners, and communities, we are creating a more just, equitable, and innovative healthcare delivery system.

raw.description:
About BigHand

BigHand offers technology solutions for busy legal professionals that provide data and insights to increase value and profits. Through our expert knowledge and innovative technology, we enable our customers to achieve enhanced efficiency, better decision-making and harness their competitive edge.

We build with tomorrow in mind, transforming ideas into action and empowering our customers to succeed in a world of constant change. We make big happen for our customers.

We are a business driven by our values and have these at the centre of everything we do. Our BigHanders are dedicated to building a culture where We Win Together, We Love to Learn, We Do the Right Thing, We Own It and We Find the Fun.

About the role

As a Customer Support Analyst at BigHand, you'll be the first point of contact for our clients across the APAC region, handling support enquiries, requests and incidents through our support channels. You'll take ownership of cases from start to finish, diagnosing technical and configuration issues across a range of technologies and working with our Product Specialists, Development, Customer Success and Account Management teams to get things resolved.

This is a chance to make a real difference to how the world's leading law firms experience our products, helping to improve customer satisfaction and product adoption along the way.

This role covers APAC hours, working 9:00 am to 5:30 pm AET.

What you’ll do

  • Provide first-line support for incidents and requests, following our case management processes.

  • Triage and diagnose client issues using playbooks and knowledge articles, carrying out remote investigations to restore product functionality.

  • Manage the full case lifecycle, working with Product Specialists, Development and Account Management to reach the right resolution.

  • Keep clients updated in line with our SLAs, and monitor cases through dashboards to make sure processes are followed.

  • Troubleshoot product integration challenges with client IT teams and BigHand experts, documenting and addressing any product shortcomings.

  • Create and maintain support documentation, including our internal and external knowledge base, known problems, defects, resolutions and support website.

What we’re looking for

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint and Excel) and Microsoft Windows Server.

  • A solid understanding of the OSI model, with the ability to troubleshoot across all network layers, from physical connectivity and routing through to application-level services and integrations.

  • A hands-on approach to problem-solving, with the ability to generate ideas and solutions.

  • Confidence with technology and how different platforms and applications connect, plus the ability to pick up new products quickly.

  • The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.

  • Excellent organisation, documentation and record-keeping skills, with a keen eye for detail.

  • The ability to prioritise effectively and manage your own workload in a fast-paced environment, both independently and as part of a team.

  • Strong communication, listening and questioning skills, with a positive, can-do attitude and a genuine enthusiasm for helping people.

What we offer

  • 25 days holiday (exc. public holidays) + 3 BigHand days off between Christmas & New Year

  • Various wellbeing benefits including private medical, online wellbeing programs & webinars, access to online therapy and Employee Resource Groups (ERG)

  • Company-wide Wellness day for our teams all across the globe to switch off and spend the day doing something to nourish their mental health

  • Opportunities to give back with company volunteer events and individual volunteer days

  • Career growth opportunities and study leave allowance

  • Family benefits including enhanced parental leave, secondary caregiver leave and fertility support

  • Financial benefits including life assurance, hardship loan and salary sacrificing

  • Access to over 500+ retail discounts through our company intranet

  • Fully remote working

  • Growing business with a global presence and a true focus on work-life balance

OurDEI Commitment

We welcome the unique value and individuality that you can bring to BigHand. We are an equal opportunity employer and are dedicated to recruiting solely based on capability and potential regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, educational background, national origin, religion, military status or physical ability. Our BigHanders are dedicated to advancing our culture of belonging by embracing differing viewpoints, opinions, thoughts, and ideas.

raw.description:
Standard Job Description

Responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing data to develop immersive stories that answer business questions. Using proven and sound statistical methods, the analyst draws insights from data, and translates those insights into action that drive business results. Data Analysts are extremely resourceful and able to find novel new data sources to enrich their analysis. They apply mathematical and statistical methods to business and risk management problems. Mine, process, and summarize data; Manage the quality assurance of data scraping, query databases for stakeholder requests, and triage data issues for timely resolutions; Analyze large datasets, draw valid inferences and prepare insights in narrative or visual forms, including dashboards; Set up and maintain data processes and new analytics capabilities; Produce and track key performance indicators; Ability to formulate functional and technical requirements from business problems; Program management of key tasks and resources to achieve cost and schedule.

You will be the Data Analyst Sr for the Production Planning & Control (PP&C) department. Our team is responsible for delivering data‑driven insights that guide business decisions and improve operational performance.

What You Will Be Doing

As the Data Analyst Sr you will be responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing production‑planning data, turning insights into actionable recommendations, and supporting cross‑functional decision‑making.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
- Collect, process, and analyze data to answer business questions and support PP&C objectives.
- Develop interactive dashboards and visual narratives that communicate insights clearly.
- Collaborate with leadership and cross‑functional teams to define problem statements, modeling approaches, and ground rules.
- Manage data quality, oversee data‑scraping activities, and resolve data issues promptly.
- Track key performance indicators and support program‑management tasks related to cost and schedule.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelors degree from an accredited university
- Must be able to obtain a DoD Secret Clearance to perform job duties
- Experienced in scripting (one or more common languages e.g., Python, R, SQL) and data visualization (e.g., Tableau, Power BI)
- Strong analytical skills and understanding of system databases, data elements, data structures and hierarchies, and/or application software solutions to optimize data gathering and analysis
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Desired Skills

- Bachelors of Science degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline (Industrial, Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, etc.), Physics, Management Information Systems, Data Science, Data Analysis, Mathematics
- Ability to interact with the customer and senior leadership as the subject matter expert to present and work through data issues and discrepancies
- Familiar with working in a SAFe agile framework environment and in a product owner support role
- Ability to define technical solutions against business opportunities
- Experience with continuous improvement initiatives
- Experience deconstructing complex operations into component data problems for distributed work across teams
- Experience creating executive level presentations to include summary and talking points
- Experience with application of scientific methods for testing and debugging, problem resolution, root-cause analysis

- Experience in HANA and/or Oracle

- Ability to adapt business processes into automated tools
- Experience collecting and compiling datasets from disparate data sources into the required data structure
- Ability to perform analysis via multi-criteria decision modeling including life-cycle cost analysis, performance & cost trade-offs, and business case analysis
- Experience in the reconciliation process
- Experience with impact analysis and RCCA

- Proficiency with MS Office tool suite

Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $106600.00 - $198000.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $95900.00 - $178100.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $85300.00 - $158300.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $76700.00 - $142500.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only.
Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

raw.description:
In a context of growth, we’ve got ambitious objectives, especially in our Tech & Product Team. We’re looking for a Sr Full-stack Software Engineer with a strong appetite for front-end and solid AI background to join our squad in the Payroll perimeter. You will be part of the next decisive chapter of Combo: building the best HR solution for SMBs and frontline workers.

🌟 Context

Combo is growing fast: today, more than 6,000 clients and 11,000+ locations rely on our solutions to manage their teams, schedules and payroll.

Our Tech & Product team counts 40+ people, organized in 4 squads each owning its functional domain end to end as well as a Platform squad (SRE). You will join the Payroll squad, which builds one of the most critical and complex parts of our product: getting every payslip right, every month, for thousands of businesses and their employees.

You will report to Dorsaf, Engineering Manager of the Payroll squad, and work daily with the squad’s Product Manager, Designer and Quality Engineer.

We’ve got many challenges ahead of us:

  • consolidating a solid payroll solution using decoupled and distributed systems on functional domains

  • crafting clear and intuitive interfaces for complex payroll workflows

  • building AI powered solutions across the entire Payroll product suite

  • mentoring and coaching the team

  • … and contributing to Combo’s Engineering culture!

We’re looking for passionate, ambitious people who can take our squads to the next level in terms of processes, skillset, impact and excellence, and who know how to make the most of AI tools to get there.

Our stack today is made of NodeJS, TypeScript, React, Postgres, Redis, GCP, Kubernetes, GitHub, GitHub Actions, etc.

🛠️ Your missions

  • Build an HR SaaS that is genuinely useful and meaningful for its users, with a real social impact

  • Implement new features related to payroll calculation, tax deduction and social declarations

  • Build a performant and reliable payroll engine

  • Design and build intuitive, accessible and performant user interfaces that make complex payroll processes simple for our users

  • Work with hairy business rules and fascinating user needs

  • Leverage AI tools (coding assistants, agents, LLMs) in your daily work to ship faster and with higher quality, and help the team adopt best practices around them

  • Contribute to our Engineering culture and promote it

  • Work with passionate teams of Engineers, Product Managers, Designers, Quality Engineers, Customer Support and other colleagues in a friendly and international environment

👀 Preferred experience

  • Strong full-stack background on Node.js / React

  • Comfortable with large React code base and structure

  • A real appetite for front-end: you care about UX, UI quality, performance and accessibility, and you enjoy working closely with Designers

  • Hands-on mastery of AI tools for software development (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) and a critical eye on how to use them well: reviewing generated code, knowing their limits, integrating them into your workflow

  • Very strong overall software engineering and computer science background

  • Solid System Design, Architecture and Database modeling skills

  • At least 6–7 years of software development experience in Tech companies

  • B2B or SaaS experience preferred

  • Experience with remote teams, English speaking

📌 Expectations

  • Start date: ASAP

  • Location: Paris area preferred

  • Package: €60–70k

  • Benefits: Health insurance (Benefiz), Swile card, stock options (BSPCE), 50% of commute costs covered, flexible remote policy

  • Manager: Dorsaf Fayech

🤝 Our hiring process

  • Step 1: HR screening with Thomas (30')

  • Step 2: Management Fit Interview withDorsaf(60–90')

  • Step 3: Technical Interview with Arnaud and 2 of our Software Engineers

raw.title: Commercial Insurance Sales Agent II (Intermediate)
raw.excerpt: Why USAA?  At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice.
raw.description:
Why USAA?

At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.

Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.

We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.

The Opportunity

As a dedicated Commercial Insurance Sales Agent II (Intermediate), you will work within defined guidelines and frameworks to advise business owners and commercial clients on risk management strategies, insurance program design, coverage analysis, and tailored commercial insurance solutions. Leverage commercial insurance products and marketplace expertise to address unique risk exposures, evaluate coverage needs, and develop customized risk management solutions. Secures appropriate coverage by utilizing knowledge of the insurance marketplace, carrier relationships, underwriting guidelines, and policy structures.


Start date for this position is February 22, 2027.


  • 14 weeks of virtual training 8:00am – 4:30pm CT
  • Work schedule after training with be 9:30am – 6:00pm CT.

This role is remote eligible in the continental U.S. with occasional business travel.


What you'll do:

  • Utilizes a consultative approach to determine customer needs, build rapport, and provide solutions across 5 or more carriers, including USAA, to offer options and fulfill members unique needs and exposures.
  • Build and maintain relationships between members, nonmembers and insurance carriers, exercising effective technical knowledge and communication skills.
  • Utilizes understanding of compliance and insurance standards and Agency Management Systems to limit agency Errors & Omissions (E&O) exposure through proper documentation.
  • Classifies members’ and/or non-members’ business and provides accurate risk management and risk mitigation solutions.
  • Facilitates periodic account reviews by leveraging the carrier renewal cycle and understanding the members' and nonmembers' risk profile to provide consultative advice and appropriately address and mitigate risk.
  • Partners and negotiates with underwriters on endorsements, renewal questions, and remarkets for underwriting determination (approval or declination) leveraging intermediate knowledge of Carrier guidelines and processes.
  • Provides select account service including policy changes, certificates, endorsements, renewals, non-renewals, and remarkets, cancellations, reinstatements, and record updates within agency systems.
  • Ensure risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.

What you have:

  • High School Diploma or General Equivalency Diploma.
  • 1 year of experience managing, retaining, servicing, and expanding commercial insurance relationships in an agency or broker setting.
  • Demonstrated product and underwriting knowledge to serve members across a national distribution footprint.
  • Experience using Agency Management Systems (AMS), Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, and multiple carrier platforms.
  • Knowledge of estimating/calculating Insurance to Value (ITV) across a wide range of commercial property types and structures.
  • Demonstrated communication, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience documenting customer interactions in CRM systems and effectively managing opportunities through the customer lifecycle.
  • Experience in supporting retention efforts by identifying coverage gaps, recommending solutions, and uncovering cross-sell opportunities.
  • Experience working in a goal-oriented environment with individual performance expectations.
  • Valid General Lines Insurance License for home state and/or ability to obtain home state and multistate licenses within 90 days.
  • Develop proficiency in coverage interpretation and policy servicing while delivering exceptional customer experience.
  • Support retention efforts by identifying coverage gaps, recommending solutions, and uncovering cross-sell opportunities.
  • Effectively document customer interactions and account activity within agency and CRM systems.
  • Identify opportunities to deepen customer relationships through additional insurance solutions and risk management recommendations.

What sets you apart:

  • Commercial Insurance experience.
  • Strong curiosity and active listening skills.
  • Ability to build trust quickly with customers.
  • Resilience and adaptability in a changing environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy.
  • Growth mindset and openness to coaching and feedback.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

Compensation range: The salary range for this position is: $48,340.00 - $86,630.00.


USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).

Compensation: USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location.

Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.

The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.

Benefits: At USAA our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.

For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. Thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting.

USAA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

raw.description:
Who We Are

ABOUT ENOVIS™

Enovis Corporation (NYSE: ENOV) is an innovation-driven medical technology growth company dedicated to developing clinically differentiated solutions that generate measurably better patient outcomes and transform workflows. Powered by a culture of continuous improvement, global talent and innovation, the Company’s extensive range of products, services and integrated technologies fuels active lifestyles in orthopedics and beyond. For more information about Enovis, please visit www.enovis.com.

What You'll Do

At Enovis™ we pay attention to the details. We embrace collaboration with our partners and patients and take pride in the pursuit of scientific excellence — with the goal of transforming medical technology as we know it.

Because that’s how we change the lives of patients for the better. And that’s how we create better together. Why work at Enovis? See for yourself.

As a key member of the Recovery Sciences team, you will play an integral part in helping Enovis drive the medical technology industry forward through transforming patient care and creating better patient outcomes.

Job Title: Product Marketing Manager

Reports To: Director, Commercial Marketing

Location: Remote

Job Title / Position Summary:

The Product Marketing Manager owns downstream marketing strategy and execution for the LightForce High Intensity Laser Therapy (HILT) portfolio in the U.S., with responsibility for additional product categories and customer segments. You will identify growth opportunities, strengthen product positioning, and develop programs that generate demand, improve sales conversion, and increase customer adoption.

This remote role offers autonomy with accountability for business results. Success requires commercial judgment, initiative, and proactive communication. You will work closely with sales, clinical, marketing communications, and upstream marketing to turn customer insights into action and deliver measurable growth.

The role provides opportunities to build expertise across product categories, lead cross-functional initiatives, and take on broader commercial responsibility as performance and business needs warrant.

Key Responsibilities:

U.S. Marketing Strategy and Commercial Performance

  • Develop and execute U.S. marketing strategies, including annual and quarterly planning for assigned products in partnership with the Commercial Marketing Director, sales, clinical, and marketing communications teams.
  • Translate product strategy into clear content priorities and briefs. Partner with marketing communications to deliver timely campaigns and materials that educate customers and generate qualified leads.
  • Analyze market trends, customer needs, competitive activity, and business performance to identify growth opportunities and guide positioning, pricing, promotions, and marketing investment.
  • Drive marketing execution against annual revenue and profitability targets. Track results, recommend corrective actions, and continuously improve program effectiveness.

Product Development and Launches

  • Collaborate with upstream marketing, representing commercial marketing through the product development process; informing customer requirements, positioning, messaging, branding, and launch planning.
  • Drive commercial readiness for new product launches, including messaging, sales tools, training, and launch communications. Partner with clinical, regulatory, and legal on accurate, supported claims.

Product Management

  • Partner with operations, sales, and finance on demand forecasting, pricing, and product transitions.
  • Resolve product and customer issues with cross-functional partners such as engineering, manufacturing, quality, and customer support. Use customer feedback to recommend product improvements and portfolio priorities.

Sales Enablement and Customer Engagement

  • Develop sales tools, training, presentations, and competitive resources that help sales teams and distributor partners communicate product value and address objections.
  • Partner with marketing communications, sales leadership, and clinical education on campaigns and programs that support lead generation, sales conversion, and customer adoption.
  • Gather customer and field sales insights through visits, interviews, and events. Develop customer success stories into marketing content.
  • Participate in and support coordination of marketing events including seminars, conferences, conventions, and sales meetings.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Align stakeholders on priorities, deliverables, timelines, and ownership. Resolve barriers and deliver projects in a highly matrixed environment with competing priorities.

Minimum Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Five or more years of experience in medical device commercial marketing, including U.S. downstream product marketing.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing marketing plans, product positioning, launches, and sales enablement programs that support revenue growth.
  • Strong analytical and business skills, including the ability to interpret market and sales data, develop business cases, and assess pricing and profitability.
  • Proven ability to collaborate across functions, influence without direct authority, and execute effectively in a highly matrixed, fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to make sound decisions with incomplete information, test assumptions, and adjust plans based on results.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple products and initiatives and meet deadlines.
  • Experience with CRM tools, marketing automation, and analytics tools.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Three or more years of experience marketing capital equipment, preferably medical capital equipment.
  • Outside sales experience of capital equipment in an outpatient healthcare setting.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, HubSpot, Allego, and Power BI.
  • Experience developing marketing programs for distributor or dealer channels.
  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree.

Travel Requirements and Work Environment:

  • Travel up to 25% for customer visits, field collaboration, training, trade shows, and meetings. Typical assignments range from one to five days and require overnight stays as needed.
  • Typical office environment, with customer and event work as needed. Physical activities include sitting, standing, walking, and handling demonstration or event materials. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Enovis values the contribution each employee brings to our organization. The pay range listed is what we reasonably and in good faith expect to compensate candidates who meet the specified qualifications and requirements for this role. Actual starting pay will depend on various factors, including but not limited to education and experience in the job and/or industry.

Base Pay Range: $110,000-$126,912-$144,900 (reflective of a full-time position)

Employees in this position are also eligible to earn an annual performance bonus.

“Creating better together”. It’s the Enovis purpose, and it’s what drives us and empowers us every day on a global scale. We know that the power to create better – for our customers, our team members, and our shareholders – begins with having the best team, pursuing common goals, operating at the highest levels, and delivering extraordinary outcomes.

What does creating better together mean to us at Enovis? Discover the “why” behind our purpose, values and behaviors:

Our Enovis Purpose, Values and Behaviors on Vimeo

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Spending and Savings Accounts
  • 401(k) Plan
  • Vacation, Sick Leave, and Holidays
  • Income Protection Plans
  • Discounted Insurance Rates
  • Legal Services

Join us in creating better together.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY
Enovis provides equal employment opportunities based on merit, experience, and other work-related criteria without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, national origin, sex, age, pregnancy, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We also strive to provide reasonable accommodation to employees’ beliefs and practices that do not conflict with Enovis policies and applicable law. We value the unique contributions that every employee brings to their role with Enovis.

raw.description:
A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Role Summary

As a Technical Community Support with SmartSimple’s Essential Support team at Foundant, you'll be the voice of customer support and a critical link between our clients and internal teams. You’ll provide prompt, professional, and knowledgeable technical support to help mission-driven organizations succeed with our software. This role combines troubleshooting expertise with a passion for customer success, operating as a technical problem-solver and customer advocate who helps organizations achieve their missions more efficiently and effectively.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.

WhatYou’llDo:

  • Respond to and triage inbound support tickets, applying initial diagnosis and prioritization based on severity and SLA.
  • Troubleshoot common SmartSimple configuration, workflow, and reporting issues, resolving independently where possible.
  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to Subject Matter Experts with clear documentation of steps already taken.
  • Maintain accurate, timely ticket notes and status updates in the ticketing system (powered by Zendesk) to support reporting on KPIs and knowledge continuity.
  • Maintain a high level of communication with all levels of client interaction to ensure proactive, solution-oriented problem identification and resolution.
  • Test fixes provided by the Engineering team and incorporate them into client systems.
  • Advocate new platform features and assist clients in adopting these through upgrades, configuration changes, or training. Provide instruction and documentation to ensure the technical success of these initiatives.  
  • Facilitate relationships across client success, internal teams, and departments to strengthen partnerships.
  • Contributor to continuous process improvement within and between all areas of Support.
  • Participate in team huddles, training sessions, knowledge-sharing activities and process improvement discussions.
  • Meet individual and team KPIs for ticket volume, response time, and customer satisfaction.
  • Some travel may be required (estimated less than 10%).
  • Other duties as assigned.

WhatYou’llNeed:

Required qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Engineering, Sciences, Mathematics (STEM) field.
  • 1–2 years of experience in a customer-facing technical support, or SaaS support role.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
  • Comfortable learning new software platforms quickly; prior exposure to SaaS, CRM, or grants management tools is a plus.
  • Solid troubleshooting instincts - able to isolate a problem, test hypotheses, and document findings.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing a queue of concurrent tickets.
  • Demonstrable success in thinking strategically, executing tactically, while providing consistent and high levels of client satisfaction and retention in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Comfortable working in a metric-driven environment.
  • Must be legally eligble to work in Spain.

Required Technical Skills

  • Basic understanding of cloud and SaaS terminology.
  • Fundamental knowledge of databases and SQL - able to read basic queries, understand table relationships, and assist with simple data troubleshooting.
  • Field data storage concepts - understanding of data types, field mappings, and how data is stored and retrieved in database systems.
  • Basic HTML/CSS knowledge - able to read and understand HTML/CSS code, troubleshoot formatting issues.
  • JavaScript fundamentals - able to recognize JavaScript syntax, understand basic functions and logic, and troubleshoot workflow automations.
  • Workflow automation concepts - understanding of conditional logic, triggers, actions, and how automated workflows function in SaaS.
  • Integration protocols and SSO (Single Sign-On) - familiarity with how external systems connect via integrations, including SMTP, SFTP, API connections, and authentication methods.
  • Data analytics fundamentals - able to interpret reports, understand data visualizations, and assist with report troubleshooting and configuration.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with SaaS, SmartSimple or similar technology platforms.
  • Experience with a ticketing platform such as Zendesk.
  • Exposure to the nonprofit, philanthropic, or grants management sector.
Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
  • With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
  • We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
  • As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
  • Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants without regard to race, color, citizenship, religion, sex, marital/family status, sexual orientation, gender identity, Indigenous status, age, disability, or individuals who may require accommodation.

Foundant is also committed to providing accommodations throughout the interview and employment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the selection process. If you have accessibility requirements during the recruitment process and require accommodation, please contact .

About Soundsnap

Soundsnap is a professional sound effects platform used by filmmakers, video editors, game developers and creative teams worldwide.

We're an independent, profitable company with over 15 years in the industry, expanding into AI-powered tools, music and sound design products.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced software engineer to help develop new products and AI-powered features while taking ownership of our backend systems and infrastructure.

You'll work closely with the founder, our existing developer and an experienced technical architect. The role combines hands-on development, technical decision-making and responsibility for reliable engineering delivery.

We're open to both strong senior engineers and experienced technical leads.

What You'll Do

  • Build new products, features and AI integrations across backend and frontend.
  • Own and improve backend systems, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.
  • Manage DevOps, deployments, monitoring, security and platform reliability.
  • Contribute to architecture, performance and scalability improvements.
  • Collaborate on technical planning, code reviews and feature delivery.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend and full-stack skills.
  • Experience building and maintaining production web applications, APIs and databases.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD.
  • Ability to independently own technical projects from planning to deployment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, clear communication and reliability.
  • Based only in Europe and nearby time zones (within ±2 hours of Central European Time)

Technical stack: GCP, PostgreSQL, Linux, Docker, Docker Compose, Typesense.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with generative AI models and APIs.
  • Background in audio, video or creative software.
  • Experience with search systems and large content libraries.
  • Technical leadership or mentoring experience.
  • Experience with subscription-based SaaS platforms.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and fully remote work with flexible hours.
  • Autonomy and input into technical and product decisions.
  • Direct collaboration with the founder and a small engineering team.
  • Work on new AI and creative technology products.
  • Opportunity to take on broader technical leadership responsibilities.

How to Apply

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile, a short introduction and examples of products or systems you've built.

Job Description:

Summary

Responsible for handling initial third-party payer billing (Medicare and managed care) for the purpose of reimbursement of services, cash receipts posting and other month-end charge entry duties; Upholds the philosophy, core values and goals of the organization and ensures that the Christian Mission of EverTrue is realized – “Older Adults Living Life to the Fullest”.

Responsibilities

1. Initial billing of skilled nursing facility/Anywhere Care claims to third party payers (Medicare, Managed Care, Commercial Insurance) or vendor Medicaid claims (Medicaid, Managed Care Medicaid and Medicaid Hospice) for multiple EverTrue sites, utilizing electronic claims submission

2. Ensures claims are received, and if returned to provider, resubmitted in a timely manner

3. Bills coinsurance claims where the primary insurance pays without issue; Refers more complex or past-due claims to the Senior Billing Specialist as needed

4. Posts cash receipts to Accounts Receivable (A/R) for third-party payer payments

5. May be responsible for filing of Medicare no-pay, benefit exhaust and information claims

6. Responsible for transferring claims to Senior Billing Specialist if:

  • Primary payer does not pay expected reimbursement, especially if in conflict with contract terms.

  • Claim aging becomes >90 days, or under 90 days and not submitted to payer and acknowledged

  • Claim is being audited/reviewed for any reason (ADR, CERT, RAC)

  • Claim non-payment/under-payment needs to be appealed

7. Maintains up-to-date technical knowledge of applicable Medicare/Medicaid/Managed Care/Anywhere Care billing rules and regulations via the CMS website, MAC website, etc.

8. Inputs Medicare ancillary charges in billing system in a timely manner

9. Serves as a resource to residents and community billing staff for applicable insurance benefit related issues

10. Serves as backup to RCM Billing Specialist; Handles verification of resident’s Medicare/Medicare Managed Care/Medicaid/Commercial Insurance benefits prior to receipt of third-party billable services

11. May handle small balance adjustments of $10 or less

12. May be responsible for maintaining Medicare Coinsurance bad debt schedule for cost report

13. Handles maintenance of resident income related to retroactive vendor Medicaid authorizations or retroactive changes in resident income

14. Handles Medicaid re-billing of charges related to retroactive vendor Medicaid authorizations or retroactive changes in resident income

Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • High School diploma

  • 1 – 3 years of Medicare billing experience

  • Proficient computer skills including Microsoft Outlook, Excel and Word are required

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

The physical activities and demands described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job duties and responsibilities.

Lifting up to 30 pounds; Pushing/pulling 100 lbs. on wheels; A well-lighted and ventilated working area that has its own temperature control system (air conditioning and heat); The work will have some short notice requests, timelines for completion of tasks or reports and some major projects extending over months; Minimal exposure to infectious diseases and blood borne pathogens; Minimal exposure to chemicals and hazardous waste; Minimal exposure to outside weather conditions.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by those assigned to this classification. This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by those occupying this position. The job description and job functions described herein are subject to possible modification by EverTrue in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Location

Fargo Corporate Office - Remote

Job Description:

Work Location: Fargo Corporate Office (Remote Capable in Midwest States)

Work Location Type: On-Site, Hybrid, or Remote Capable in Midwest States

Work Hours: 8-5 M-F


The SVP of Enterprise Payments is responsible for shaping and leading Gate City Bank’s enterprise payments strategy across consumer, commercial, and treasury experiences. This position will define the Bank’s future-state payments vision and build a scalable, flexible ecosystem that supports customer growth, operational efficiency, new revenue opportunities, and continued innovation.


Serving as the Bank’s enterprise payments leader and subject-matter expert, this position will evaluate customer and business needs, payment economics, market trends, regulatory requirements, and emerging technologies to determine how Gate City should evolve the way money moves. The role will translate that strategy into a prioritized roadmap and lead key initiatives from discovery and design through implementation, launch, adoption, and optimization.


This position will initially lead primarily through influence, expertise, and cross-functional partnership, while establishing the technology, partnerships, governance, and internal capabilities needed to support the Bank’s evolving payments business. Success will be measured by Gate City’s ability to deliver secure, integrated, and differentiated payment experiences that create sustainable value while maintaining the flexibility to adapt as payments continue to evolve.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:


  • Owns the strategic vision, capability model, roadmap, and governance for modernizing the Bank’s consumer and business payments ecosystem.
  • Develops and maintains Gate City Bank’s enterprise payments strategy, including strategic priorities, target customer segments, differentiated value propositions, investment priorities, and a multi-year capability roadmap.
  • Identifies opportunities to grow payment-related revenue, deepen customer relationships, increase transaction activity, improve deposit retention, and expand the Bank’s role in consumer and business financial workflows.
  • Develops the business and operating model for future payment capabilities, including product ownership, pricing, revenue models, service models, operational responsibilities, technology support, risk ownership, and performance management.
  • Leads discovery of consumer and business financial workflows to identify unmet needs, friction, manual workarounds, external fintech dependencies, and opportunities for Gate City to own, orchestrate, integrate, or partner.
  • Uses customer interviews, transaction behavior, operational data, frontline insight, market research, and competitive intelligence to define and prioritize payment problems worth solving.
  • Establishes and applies an Own, Orchestrate, Integrate, or Partner framework to determine where Gate City should control the customer experience, coordinate multiple providers or rails, connect to valued external platforms, or rely on strategic partners.
  • Defines potential target-state models connecting payment initiation and capture, customer and account context, identity and authentication, fraud and risk decisioning, payment-method selection, routing, execution, settlement, reconciliation, notifications, exceptions, and servicing.
  • Works with Technology and Enterprise Architecture to translate strategic choices into business and architectural requirements, including APIs, data flows, integration patterns, security, resiliency, interoperability, scalability, observability, and platform dependencies.
  • Determines appropriate build, buy, extend, integrate, partner, or hybrid approaches and develops recommendations considering strategic control, customer value, speed, economics, scalability, vendor dependency, implementation complexity, and long-term flexibility.
  • Researches the payments ecosystem and identifies processors, networks, orchestration platforms, fintechs, core and digital providers, fraud and identity partners, open-banking providers, and other · technologies that could enable the future-state model.
  • Leads partner discovery and evaluation, including requirements definition, market scans, RFI/RFP support, demonstrations, due diligence, proofs of concept, reference validation, commercial evaluation, and recommendation development, after customer needs and strategic requirements are sufficiently defined.
  • Develops decision-ready business cases defining the customer problem, target use cases, strategic value, expected economics, investment requirements, risks, dependencies, operating impacts, implementation approach, and measures of success.
  • Defines intelligent payment decisioning and routing requirements that may consider customer preference, payment purpose, transaction context, speed, cost, availability, risk, fraud controls, limits, recipient capability, liquidity, settlement requirements, and operational impact.
  • Establishes an incremental implementation roadmap allowing the Bank to modernize in practical stages while integrating with existing channels, Fiserv DNA, operational processes, payment rails, and related technology investments.
  • Leads cross-functional delivery of approved priorities from discovery and requirements through partner selection, design, pilot, implementation, launch readiness, adoption, measurement, and post-launch optimization.
  • Evaluates how existing and emerging capabilities should connect to the future-state ecosystem, including cards, ACH, wires, instant payments, digital wallets, account-to-account and Pay by Bank, open-banking APIs, P2P, embedded payments, cross-border payments, tokenization, digital assets, and agentic payment experiences.
  • Partners with Fraud, Risk, Compliance, BSA/AML, Legal, Information Security, and Operational Risk to embed customer protection, regulatory requirements, controls, monitoring, and responsible decisioning from the beginning.
  • Partners with Digital, Commercial Banking, Treasury Services, Deposit Operations, Customer Experience, Finance, Data, Technology, Enterprise Architecture, and frontline teams to identify and sequence high-value consumer and business use cases that improve transparency, control, speed, trust, and operational capacity.
  • Defines outcome measures for payment modernization, including adoption, transaction volume, revenue, cost, payment success, speed, fraud and loss, exceptions, customer experience, workflow penetration, and operational capacity.
  • Manages strategic relationships with networks, processors, technology providers, fintechs, consultants, and other ecosystem partners, ensuring recommendations and implementations support the Bank’s long-term architecture and business objectives.
  • Monitors payment technology, standards, network developments, regulation, customer behavior, and competitor activity and recommends what the Bank should implement, pilot, explore, monitor, partner for, integrate, or intentionally defer.
  • Builds enterprise payment fluency by clearly communicating customer evidence, strategic choices, future-state models, partner trade-offs, implementation implications, and the roadmap for customers, team members, operations, risk, and technology.

Other Duties:


  • Deliver a consistently exceptional service experience for both team members and customers.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with team members, leaders, customers, and external partners.
  • Demonstrate reliability and accountability in attendance to support operational needs and service expectations.
  • Comply with all Gate City Bank policies, procedures, and all applicable laws and regulations.
  • Maintain a high level of attention to detail and accuracy in all responsibilities.
  • Exercise sound judgment and make timely decisions in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Utilize approved AI-enabled tools and technologies to enhance productivity, support problem-solving and decision-making, and drive efficiencies while exercising sound judgment and adhering to company policies, privacy standards, and responsible use expectations.

Education and Experience: Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, technology, information systems, product management, or a related field; 7 or more years of progressively responsible experience in payments, digital banking, financial technology, product management, payment operations, or platform modernization; experience leading cross-functional technology implementations and payment transformation initiatives; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Other Skills:

  • Deep understanding of consumer and business payment journeys and working knowledge of payment rails, processors, networks, digital channels, payment hubs or orchestration concepts.
  • Strong capability in partner and platform evaluation, requirements definition, business case development, payment economics, solution design, implementation planning, and data-informed decision-making.
  • Ability to translate between business outcomes and technology requirements and influence effectively across business, technology, operations, risk, compliance, finance, and external partners.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguity, separate durable opportunities from hype, connect technology advancement to customer and business outcomes, and move initiatives from research through implementation and measurable adoption.

Certifications: Relevant payments, product, technology, risk, or project management certification preferred, including CPP, AAP, NCP, CTP, or PMP.

Vira Games — незалежна ігрова компанія, що спеціалізується на розробці та видавництві мобільних ігор. Наша команда — це творчий альянс, що об’єднує досвід, креативність, драйвовість і професіоналізм.

Ми в пошуках AI Game Architect із сильною експертизою в Game Design на рівні Senior, який самостійно перетворюватиме ідеї на готові мобільні ігри для Google Play та iOS за допомогою AI-інструментів.

В основі ролі — Game Design, системне мислення та цілісне продуктове бачення. Це не класична позиція Developer або AI Engineer: роль передбачає як розробку концепції гри, так і її практичну реалізацію. На ранніх етапах робота над грою відбувається практично самостійно. Якщо прототип або MVP демонструє сильні результати, навколо продукту поступово формується повноцінна команда.

Основні обов’язки:

  • Створення ігор: самостійно створювати нові мобільні ігри з нуля до релізу.

  • Game Design: проектувати core gameplay, метасистеми, прогресію, ігрову економіку та монетизацію.

  • AI-інструменти: використовувати Claude Code, Cursor, Codex та інші AI-інструменти для створення ігор.

  • Продуктові рішення: аналізувати результати та ухвалювати рішення щодо подальших ітерацій, припинення роботи над продуктом або його масштабування — Iterate / Kill / Scale.

  • Розвиток після запуску: проводити перші продуктові ітерації після релізу.

  • Масштабування продуктів: передавати успішні продукти на масштабування та допомагати формувати команду.

  • AI / Unity pipeline: удосконалювати пайплайн для повторного використання під час створення наступних ігор.

Очікування від кандидата:

  • Сильний досвід у Game Design / Systems Design.

  • Досвід роботи над великими мобільними проєктами, бажано в сегменті mid-core.

  • Уміння самостійно формувати цілісне бачення гри, а не лише окремих фіч.

  • Практичний досвід роботи з Unity.

  • Технічне мислення та розуміння базової структури ігрового проєкту.

  • Досвід створення власних прототипів, інструментів або ігор за допомогою AI.

  • Розуміння продуктових метрик мобільних ігор і вміння працювати ітеративно на основі результатів тестів.

Процес підбору:

Location

Fargo Corporate Office - Remote

Job Description:

Work Location: Fargo Corporate Office (Remote Capable in Midwest States)

Work Location Type: On-Site, Hybrid, or Remote Capable in Midwest States

Work Hours: 8-5 M-F


The SVP of Enterprise Payments is responsible for shaping and leading Gate City Bank’s enterprise payments strategy across consumer, commercial, and treasury experiences. This position will define the Bank’s future-state payments vision and build a scalable, flexible ecosystem that supports customer growth, operational efficiency, new revenue opportunities, and continued innovation.


Serving as the Bank’s enterprise payments leader and subject-matter expert, this position will evaluate customer and business needs, payment economics, market trends, regulatory requirements, and emerging technologies to determine how Gate City should evolve the way money moves. The role will translate that strategy into a prioritized roadmap and lead key initiatives from discovery and design through implementation, launch, adoption, and optimization.


This position will initially lead primarily through influence, expertise, and cross-functional partnership, while establishing the technology, partnerships, governance, and internal capabilities needed to support the Bank’s evolving payments business. Success will be measured by Gate City’s ability to deliver secure, integrated, and differentiated payment experiences that create sustainable value while maintaining the flexibility to adapt as payments continue to evolve.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:


  • Owns the strategic vision, capability model, roadmap, and governance for modernizing the Bank’s consumer and business payments ecosystem.
  • Develops and maintains Gate City Bank’s enterprise payments strategy, including strategic priorities, target customer segments, differentiated value propositions, investment priorities, and a multi-year capability roadmap.
  • Identifies opportunities to grow payment-related revenue, deepen customer relationships, increase transaction activity, improve deposit retention, and expand the Bank’s role in consumer and business financial workflows.
  • Develops the business and operating model for future payment capabilities, including product ownership, pricing, revenue models, service models, operational responsibilities, technology support, risk ownership, and performance management.
  • Leads discovery of consumer and business financial workflows to identify unmet needs, friction, manual workarounds, external fintech dependencies, and opportunities for Gate City to own, orchestrate, integrate, or partner.
  • Uses customer interviews, transaction behavior, operational data, frontline insight, market research, and competitive intelligence to define and prioritize payment problems worth solving.
  • Establishes and applies an Own, Orchestrate, Integrate, or Partner framework to determine where Gate City should control the customer experience, coordinate multiple providers or rails, connect to valued external platforms, or rely on strategic partners.
  • Defines potential target-state models connecting payment initiation and capture, customer and account context, identity and authentication, fraud and risk decisioning, payment-method selection, routing, execution, settlement, reconciliation, notifications, exceptions, and servicing.
  • Works with Technology and Enterprise Architecture to translate strategic choices into business and architectural requirements, including APIs, data flows, integration patterns, security, resiliency, interoperability, scalability, observability, and platform dependencies.
  • Determines appropriate build, buy, extend, integrate, partner, or hybrid approaches and develops recommendations considering strategic control, customer value, speed, economics, scalability, vendor dependency, implementation complexity, and long-term flexibility.
  • Researches the payments ecosystem and identifies processors, networks, orchestration platforms, fintechs, core and digital providers, fraud and identity partners, open-banking providers, and other · technologies that could enable the future-state model.
  • Leads partner discovery and evaluation, including requirements definition, market scans, RFI/RFP support, demonstrations, due diligence, proofs of concept, reference validation, commercial evaluation, and recommendation development, after customer needs and strategic requirements are sufficiently defined.
  • Develops decision-ready business cases defining the customer problem, target use cases, strategic value, expected economics, investment requirements, risks, dependencies, operating impacts, implementation approach, and measures of success.
  • Defines intelligent payment decisioning and routing requirements that may consider customer preference, payment purpose, transaction context, speed, cost, availability, risk, fraud controls, limits, recipient capability, liquidity, settlement requirements, and operational impact.
  • Establishes an incremental implementation roadmap allowing the Bank to modernize in practical stages while integrating with existing channels, Fiserv DNA, operational processes, payment rails, and related technology investments.
  • Leads cross-functional delivery of approved priorities from discovery and requirements through partner selection, design, pilot, implementation, launch readiness, adoption, measurement, and post-launch optimization.
  • Evaluates how existing and emerging capabilities should connect to the future-state ecosystem, including cards, ACH, wires, instant payments, digital wallets, account-to-account and Pay by Bank, open-banking APIs, P2P, embedded payments, cross-border payments, tokenization, digital assets, and agentic payment experiences.
  • Partners with Fraud, Risk, Compliance, BSA/AML, Legal, Information Security, and Operational Risk to embed customer protection, regulatory requirements, controls, monitoring, and responsible decisioning from the beginning.
  • Partners with Digital, Commercial Banking, Treasury Services, Deposit Operations, Customer Experience, Finance, Data, Technology, Enterprise Architecture, and frontline teams to identify and sequence high-value consumer and business use cases that improve transparency, control, speed, trust, and operational capacity.
  • Defines outcome measures for payment modernization, including adoption, transaction volume, revenue, cost, payment success, speed, fraud and loss, exceptions, customer experience, workflow penetration, and operational capacity.
  • Manages strategic relationships with networks, processors, technology providers, fintechs, consultants, and other ecosystem partners, ensuring recommendations and implementations support the Bank’s long-term architecture and business objectives.
  • Monitors payment technology, standards, network developments, regulation, customer behavior, and competitor activity and recommends what the Bank should implement, pilot, explore, monitor, partner for, integrate, or intentionally defer.
  • Builds enterprise payment fluency by clearly communicating customer evidence, strategic choices, future-state models, partner trade-offs, implementation implications, and the roadmap for customers, team members, operations, risk, and technology.

Other Duties:


  • Deliver a consistently exceptional service experience for both team members and customers.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with team members, leaders, customers, and external partners.
  • Demonstrate reliability and accountability in attendance to support operational needs and service expectations.
  • Comply with all Gate City Bank policies, procedures, and all applicable laws and regulations.
  • Maintain a high level of attention to detail and accuracy in all responsibilities.
  • Exercise sound judgment and make timely decisions in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Utilize approved AI-enabled tools and technologies to enhance productivity, support problem-solving and decision-making, and drive efficiencies while exercising sound judgment and adhering to company policies, privacy standards, and responsible use expectations.

Education and Experience: Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, technology, information systems, product management, or a related field; 7 or more years of progressively responsible experience in payments, digital banking, financial technology, product management, payment operations, or platform modernization; experience leading cross-functional technology implementations and payment transformation initiatives; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.


Other Skills:

  • Deep understanding of consumer and business payment journeys and working knowledge of payment rails, processors, networks, digital channels, payment hubs or orchestration concepts.
  • Strong capability in partner and platform evaluation, requirements definition, business case development, payment economics, solution design, implementation planning, and data-informed decision-making.
  • Ability to translate between business outcomes and technology requirements and influence effectively across business, technology, operations, risk, compliance, finance, and external partners.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguity, separate durable opportunities from hype, connect technology advancement to customer and business outcomes, and move initiatives from research through implementation and measurable adoption.

Certifications: Relevant payments, product, technology, risk, or project management certification preferred, including CPP, AAP, NCP, CTP, or PMP.

Vira Games — незалежна ігрова компанія, що спеціалізується на розробці та видавництві мобільних ігор. Наша команда — це творчий альянс, що об’єднує досвід, креативність, драйвовість і професіоналізм.

Ми в пошуках AI Game Architect із сильною експертизою в Game Design на рівні Senior, який самостійно перетворюватиме ідеї на готові мобільні ігри для Google Play та iOS за допомогою AI-інструментів.

В основі ролі — Game Design, системне мислення та цілісне продуктове бачення. Це не класична позиція Developer або AI Engineer: роль передбачає як розробку концепції гри, так і її практичну реалізацію. На ранніх етапах робота над грою відбувається практично самостійно. Якщо прототип або MVP демонструє сильні результати, навколо продукту поступово формується повноцінна команда.

Основні обов’язки:

  • Створення ігор: самостійно створювати нові мобільні ігри з нуля до релізу.

  • Game Design: проектувати core gameplay, метасистеми, прогресію, ігрову економіку та монетизацію.

  • AI-інструменти: використовувати Claude Code, Cursor, Codex та інші AI-інструменти для створення ігор.

  • Продуктові рішення: аналізувати результати та ухвалювати рішення щодо подальших ітерацій, припинення роботи над продуктом або його масштабування — Iterate / Kill / Scale.

  • Розвиток після запуску: проводити перші продуктові ітерації після релізу.

  • Масштабування продуктів: передавати успішні продукти на масштабування та допомагати формувати команду.

  • AI / Unity pipeline: удосконалювати пайплайн для повторного використання під час створення наступних ігор.

Очікування від кандидата:

  • Сильний досвід у Game Design / Systems Design.

  • Досвід роботи над великими мобільними проєктами, бажано в сегменті mid-core.

  • Уміння самостійно формувати цілісне бачення гри, а не лише окремих фіч.

  • Практичний досвід роботи з Unity.

  • Технічне мислення та розуміння базової структури ігрового проєкту.

  • Досвід створення власних прототипів, інструментів або ігор за допомогою AI.

  • Розуміння продуктових метрик мобільних ігор і вміння працювати ітеративно на основі результатів тестів.

raw.excerpt: About Cogstate At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.
raw.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- VINELAND/VABS Administration Experience Required
- Norwegian Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MA/MS in Psychology or equivalent
  • ≥25 administrations of study scales or similar semi-structured clinical interviews
  • Experience working with pediatric populations with neurodevelopmental delays
    • Rare disease experience is a plus, including Angelman syndrome, Phelan-McDermid syndrome, Fragile X syndrome, or similar disorders
  • Vineland/VABS administration experience
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment, including experience working with pediatric populations and caregivers
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • Norwegian Fluency

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

We collect and process your information for recruitment purposes in compliance with applicable laws, including the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs), the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA), Colorado Privacy Act (CPA), and similar laws in other jurisdictions.
