raw.description:
Renewal Advisor

Future-Forward. Broker-Focused.

About Us

For over a decade, CMLS Residential has been a trusted leader in Canada's residential mortgage industry, helping brokers grow their business through innovative mortgage solutions, competitive rates, and exceptional service.

Working exclusively through the broker channel, we deliver a seamless mortgage experience powered by advanced technology and AI. From prime mortgages and HELOCs to alternative lending solutions, we're a true one-stop shop for mortgage financing. We continuously evolve our products, tools, and support to help brokers stay ahead in a changing market, while our long-term partnership approach reflects our commitment to their lasting success.

CMLS Residential has been awarded Overall Best Mortgage Lender in Canada (2024) in the CMP Brokers on Lenders Survey.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS, nesto, and Nesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at:

Life at CMLS Residential

At CMLS Residential, you'll join a collaborative team that's passionate about innovation, partnership, and delivering exceptional experiences. Whether you're supporting brokers, launching new products, or improving how Canadians access home financing, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while growing your career.

About the team

The Mortgage Retention Specialist will be responsible for managing a portfolio of loans with the ultimate goal of retaining the mortgage. To be successful as a Mortgage Retention Specialist, one must have a deep understanding of mortgage products with the ability to manage multiple customer relationships and priorities simultaneously. In addition to working with our mortgage clients, you will also collaborate with other industry professionals, such as mortgage advisors, underwriters, etc, to ensure that customers receive comprehensive support throughout the retention process. This role offers many growth opportunities within our rapidly scaling company.

This role is a base + commission compensation structure. Normal hours of operation are from 9:00 am to 5:30 pm; however, you must be able to exercise flexibility with working hours and can be asked to work later hours when necessary.

What you’ll be doing

  • Handle incoming calls and emails from clients, mortgage brokers and consultants inquiring about conversions, ports, early renewals, maturing loans, payout requests and early renewals.
  • Support all mortgage retention activities. Examples include managing early renewal requests, transforming client payout requests into sales, and completing blend-and-extend transactions.
  • Follow up regularly with clients and mortgage brokers consultants/advisors on maturing mortgages.
  • Negotiate renewals based on predetermined renewal rates; offer clients the best product.
  • Analyze clients' needs and provide appropriate options based on those needs.
  • Direct referrals for new business opportunities to the Mortgage Advisor network.
  • Ensure proper documentation and that all compliance requirements are met (KYC - client interview) and ensure SLAs and timely communication are adhered to.
  • Collaborate with teams within the Servicing department and other business units within Nesto Group.
  • Escalate complex or unresolved client retention issues to the manager as required.
  • Adhere to regulatory and compliance requirements, including Anti-Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing reporting requirements.
  • Provide exceptional customer service during the retention process.

Who we’re looking for

  • At least 3 years of experience in a related retention or servicing role within the mortgage, financial services, or banking industry.
  • Must hold a valid Mortgage License in one or more Canadian provinces (or be willing to obtain within 6 months).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and French (French is an asset).
  • Strong negotiation and sales skills.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Attention to detail, strong focus on accuracy, and ability to meet deadlines.
  • Self-motivation with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Results-oriented mindset.
  • Comfort using multiple system platforms simultaneously.
  • Working knowledge of Google Workspace.
  • A solid understanding of mortgage lending and servicing (asset).

Why You'll Love Working Here

We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.

  • Competitive Rewards — Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.
  • Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.
  • Time to Recharge — Generous vacation (4 weeks), floater days, and statutory holidays to help you recharge.
  • Planning for the Future — RRSP matching to support your long-term financial wellbeing.
  • Family Support — Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.
  • Learning & Growth — Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.
  • Tools for Success — Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, we are committed to working with you to meet your needs.


Salary range : $40,000 base + commission

raw.description:
Are you a proactive and highly organised Client Services Professional who enjoys helping customers and building relationships? At Outsourcery, we connect exceptional professionals with UK businesses across a variety of industries.

We're looking for relationship builders with strong communication skills, technical competence, and a practical approach to solving problems. If you enjoy understanding customers' needs, resolving queries, and delivering a positive customer experience, this opportunity could be the perfect fit.

What You'll Be Doing

  • As a Remote Client Services Professional employed through Outsourcery, you will be placed on UK client accounts. Our Outsourcerers often support multiple clients at once, requiring them to adapt to different businesses, systems and ways of working.
  • To thrive in this role, you should be eager to take on new clients and challenges, readily available for client meetings and onboarding, and committed to continuously building your portfolio.
  • While responsibilities will vary depending on each client's needs, you will generally act as a key point of contact for their customers, building strong relationships and ensuring a positive customer experience.
  • You will handle customer enquiries through email, live chat, phone and other channels, providing clear information and timely support.
  • Responsibilities may include assisting with orders, deliveries, returns and refunds, resolving complaints, troubleshooting issues, and escalating queries that require further support.
  • You will maintain accurate customer records, keep support tickets up to date, and follow through to ensure queries are resolved.
  • The role may also include gathering customer feedback, reporting recurring issues, and identifying opportunities to improve the customer experience.

Required Skills & Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in customer service, customer support, client services or a similar customer-facing role.
  • Experience managing high volumes of customer enquiries while maintaining accuracy, professionalism and service quality.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including confidence handling complaints and challenging conversations.
  • Strong organisational, administrative and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience managing support tickets, prioritising queries and following through on outstanding issues.
  • Experience using customer service platforms such as Gorgias, Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom, etc.
  • Experience using CRM systems to maintain accurate customer records and track interactions.
  • Further studies in business, communications or a related field will be an advantage.
  • Experienced in using AI tools to support productivity and customer communication.
  • Tech-savvy with high learning agility. Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace is required.
  • Experience working with international customers; UK customer experience is preferred.
  • Own work-from-home setup, including a suitable workspace, computer and reliable internet connection.
  • Available for at least 4 hours during UK business hours.

The ideal candidate will:

  • Be empathetic, patient, resilient and calm under pressure.
  • Demonstrate professionalism, integrity, proactivity and ownership.
  • Build trust through clear communication and reliable follow-through.
  • Be comfortable managing expectations, addressing complaints and escalating issues when needed.
  • Take time to understand customers' concerns and find practical solutions.
  • Work well independently and collaborate effectively with colleagues.
  • Have a stable work history, ideally with UK or international and remote experience.
  • Take pride in high-quality work, seek growth and maintain a reliable remote work setup.

raw.title: Business / Implementation Analyst IV
raw.excerpt: Overview LMI is seeking a Business / Implementation Analyst for a prospective VA OSP program, contingent upon contract award.
raw.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Business / Implementation Analyst for a prospective VA OSP program, contingent upon contract award. These full-time positions will support standardized organizational assessments, implementation-gap analysis, targeted capacity improvement plans, and a repeatable process for tracking progress from findings to action.

Analysts will review qualitative and quantitative evidence, document workflows and implementation conditions, maintain assessment records, and help develop clear recommendations for government decision-makers. The work involves balancing consistent criteria with the realities of different organizational models and maturity levels.

This role works under the Business / Implementation Analyst Lead and with HCD, public-health, evaluation, and data colleagues. Successful candidates bring structured analysis, thoughtful stakeholder engagement, and clear writing to ambiguous operational challenges.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Review organizational program narratives, budgets, service plans, data summaries, policies, and workflow artifacts.
  • Conduct or support structured assessment sessions using approved maturity rubrics and evidence expectations.
  • Document organizational strengths, implementation gaps, workforce and governance needs, systemic barriers, and information gaps.
  • Map current-state processes and identify changes needed to improve clarity, consistency, and operational readiness.
  • Draft assessment findings and concise organization-specific capacity improvement plans.
  • Define proposed next-state conditions, priority support needs, possible support resources, and expected evidence of progress.
  • Track assessment findings, routing recommendations, client decisions, support actions, and reassessment points.
  • Coordinate with evaluation and public-health SMEs to contextualize findings and avoid unsupported conclusions.
  • Prepare decision briefs, requirements lists, action trackers, working-session notes, and presentation materials.
  • Support recurring reassessments and aggregate lessons learned for continuous improvement.
  • Apply quality, accessibility, confidentiality, and document-control standards to work products.
  • Build and maintain structured evidence matrices that connect each finding to its source, assessment domain, maturity criterion, and proposed follow-up.
  • Conduct root-cause analyses of workflow failures, staffing constraints, referral bottlenecks, reporting burden, and other implementation barriers identified during assessment.
  • Draft clear support requirements that identify the affected audience, urgency, recommended delivery modality, expected outcome, and evidence of progress.
  • Maintain a closed-loop action register that differentiates contractor recommendations from VA assignment, grant-management, and policy decisions.
  • Coordinate data, evaluation, and public-health input to confirm that recommendations are feasible, context-sensitive, and supported by available evidence.
  • Support peer review and quality-checking of assessment packages, maturity judgments, and improvement plans before leadership submission.
  • Prepare complete assessment files with source inventories, documented evidence gaps, preliminary criteria interpretations, reviewer questions, and clearly labeled assumptions.
  • Analyze how staffing changes, partner agreements, data practices, service definitions, or financial constraints affect a grantee's ability to sustain proposed operational changes.
  • Develop concise capacity improvement plan entries with owners or recommended delivery resources, prerequisites, milestones, verifiable evidence of progress, and reassessment triggers.
  • Support collaborative workshops by preparing evidence summaries, facilitating focused process walk-throughs, recording decisions, and distinguishing validated findings from future-state ideas.
  • Maintain a prioritized work queue of assigned organizations and follow-up actions, coordinating with HCD, evaluation, and data leads to meet review and reporting milestones.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, public administration, operations, health services, social sciences, or related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of relevant business analysis, implementation support, operations analysis, process improvement, or organizational assessment work.
  • Experience analyzing documents and stakeholder inputs to develop requirements, workflows, findings, and recommended actions.
  • Ability to use a structured rubric, maintain traceable evidence, and produce accurate professional deliverables.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and collaborative tracking tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple assigned assessments and stakeholder interactions while meeting deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound professional judgment, and ability to work effectively with federal stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust suitability determination; must meet applicable federal/VA background, security, privacy, training, and system-access requirements.
  • Experience eliciting business rules, writing operational requirements, documenting decision criteria, and producing clear current-state and proposed-state process maps.
  • Practical analytical skills in Excel, issue and action tracking, workflow mapping, document comparison, and structured written synthesis.
  • Ability to identify the difference between implementation barriers, data-quality concerns, support needs, and matters requiring government judgment.
  • Demonstrated capability to manage evidence versions, record review comments, and resolve documentation discrepancies under time-sensitive delivery cycles.
  • Ability to interpret and compare operational source materials such as budgets, staffing plans, service tables, narratives, standard operating procedures, and performance reports.
  • Experience preparing concise decision memoranda and action plans that distinguish the root cause of a problem from symptoms and identify measurable next-state conditions.
  • Comfort working within defined governance boundaries, seeking senior or government review where policy, compliance, and grant-management judgments are required.

Desired:

  • Highly desirable: Prior VA OSP/VHA business analysis, program operations, or improvement support experience.
  • Highly desirable: Experience with federal grantee support, including onboarding, capacity-gap assessment, support-needs tracking, and follow-up improvement actions.
  • Experience with maturity models, improvement plans, Lean process mapping, or requirements elicitation.
  • Experience supporting qualitative interviews, consensus workshops, or reassessment cycles.
  • Business analysis, Lean Six Sigma, or implementation-management credentials.
  • Entry Certificate in Business Analysis (ECBA), Certification of Capability in Business Analysis (CCBA), PMI-PBA, or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt.
  • Familiarity with requirements traceability matrices, BPMN or comparable process notation, and organizational capability or maturity models.
  • Experience with continuous-improvement work in federal, public-health, grant-recipient, or multisite service-delivery settings.
  • Familiarity with requirements repositories, business-process mapping tools, workflow automation concepts, or simple data-validation checks that improve consistency.
  • Experience documenting action ownership, deadlines, evidence of closure, and later verification in an organizational continuous-improvement setting.

Target salary range: $96,000 - $145,000

Disclaimer:

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

raw.title: Associate Director - New OFS, Fiber, & Fixed Wireless
raw.excerpt: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career.
raw.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you'll be doing…


Verizon is rapidly expanding its Fios Fiber and Fixed Wireless Access (FWA) footprint into new markets. The Associate Director, New Launch (OFS) will own end-to-end execution and success of new market and new serviceable-location launches, turning network build completion into revenue-generating, customer-ready markets on time, on budget, and with a high-quality customer experience.

This role sits at the intersection of network engineering, IT/systems readiness, sales, marketing, care, and field operations. You will be a point of accountability for taking a product from "network ready" to "commercially live" and scaling that repeatable playbook across dozens of markets per year to achieve subscriber sales targets.


Launch Strategy & Execution:


  • Owning the end-to-end launch playbook for new fiber and fixed wireless markets, from pre-launch readiness through go-live and post-launch sales stabilization.
  • Owning, adapting, and maintaining a standardized, repeatable launch playbook (readiness checklists, launch offer, timelines) and continuously improving it based on lessons learned.
  • Serving as the executive-level point of contact and escalation path for all launch-related Sales and Marketing issues.

Cross-Functional Orchestration:


  • Coordinating closely with Network Engineering to track fiber/FWA build planning, completion, serviceability, and address activation.
  • Partnering with IT/Systems teams to ensure provisioning, billing, and address databases are launch-ready.
  • Aligning with Sales, Marketing, and Care to synchronize go-to-market timing, local marketing activation, staffing, and training with network readiness.
  • Working with Field Operations to ensure equipment, technician capacity, and installation resources are in place ahead of demand.

Governance & Reporting:


  • Establishing and running launch governance cadences (weekly market reviews, go/no-go readiness meetings, executive status updates).
  • Owning launch scorecards and KPIs: serviceable address counts, activation rates, install completion, customer satisfaction/NPS, time-to-revenue, and launch-to-target attainment.
  • Proactively identifying risks to launch timelines or quality and drive mitigation plans with accountable owners.

Team Leadership & Process Improvement:


  • Leading, mentoring, and developing a team of Senior Launch/Program Managers for each product, overseeing individual market launches.
  • Driving continuous improvement of launch sales processes to improve first-time-right execution as the launch cadence scales.
  • Building strong relationships with regional and local leaders to ensure launch plans reflect on-the-ground realities.

This is a remote position with standard working hours from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET) and up to 25% travel to support new market launches.


What we're looking for…


You'll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
  • Eight or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
  • Three to four years proven leadership experience, including managing managers or a team of program/project leads.
  • Eight or more years of experience in telecommunications, program/project management, or operations, with meaningful experience in network launches, market expansion, or large-scale operational rollouts.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex, cross-functional programs with hard deadlines and significant financial/customer impact.
  • Strong understanding of fiber and/or fixed wireless access network deployment, activation, and service delivery processes.
  • Excellent executive presence and communication skills; comfortable presenting to and influencing senior leadership.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to build and interpret launch scorecards, dashboards, and KPI trends.
  • Track record of building or improving standardized playbooks/processes and scaling them across multiple markets or sites.
  • Ability to travel to launch markets up to approximately 25% of the time.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.
  • Experience with telecom OSS/BSS systems, address/serviceability databases, or provisioning workflows.
  • PMP, Six Sigma, or equivalent process/program certification.
  • Prior experience at a telecom, cable, or ISP in network deployment, market launch, or new product introduction roles.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every "even better" qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this remote role, you'll work from home with occasional in-person trainings and meetings.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $113,500.00 - $198,000.00.

raw.title: Senior Growth Leader
raw.excerpt: About this team At PSBLTY, we’re assembling a powerhouse team of passionate, innovative, and growth-driven leaders who are committed to helping others achieve their fullest potential.
raw.description:
About this team

At PSBLTY, we’re assembling a powerhouse team of passionate, innovative, and growth-driven leaders who are committed to helping others achieve their fullest potential. Our team is not just about filling roles; it’s about creating a collective force that drives authentic growth for our client partners and within our own organization. As part of a rapidly growing company, our team members are expected to take 100% responsibility for everything they do, think strategically, make bold decisions, and act as catalysts for transformation in the financial services industry—and beyond.

This team thrives on a culture of possibility, where every member is encouraged to bring their boldest, most authentic self to work, contribute fresh ideas, and push the boundaries of what’s possible. We draw inspiration from world-class organizations that don’t just follow trends but set them. Here, you’ll have the freedom to experiment, the support to grow, and the tools to make a real impact, whatever your role.

Reporting to our Director of Fulfillment, you’ll collaborate closely with a dynamic group of growth leaders, strategists, and client success champions. Together, we’re not just building a company; we’re crafting a movement that empowers other leaders to stand out and make a difference. Join us, and you’ll be part of a team that’s dedicated to breaking new ground, both in our own growth and in the growth we create for our client partners.

What you will do

At PSBLTY, we believe that creating value is at the heart of every role. Whether someone’s a growth leader, strategist, or specialist, everybody’s contributions are key to our collective success, yours included.

As a Senior Growth Leader, you will lead our most advanced coaching engagements with financial advisors and their teams, primarily through our enterprise partnership programs. You will facilitate high-level cohorts and individual sessions that create clarity, drive accountability, and produce measurable business and personal outcomes. You will also help develop the next generation of PSBLTY Growth Leaders.

You will be responsible to:

  • Lead advanced coaching cohorts for experienced financial advisors, bringing deep industry knowledge of practice economics, team structure, client segmentation, and growth strategy.
  • Facilitate 1:1, team, and group coaching sessions that deliver clarity, value, and actionable next steps.
  • Lead specialized enterprise engagements, including coaching for internal partner teams and advisor teaming engagements.
  • Drive client partner outcomes by setting goals, tracking progress, and celebrating measurable wins.
  • Mentor and support developing Growth Leaders, sharing industry knowledge and helping them prepare for more advanced work.
  • Serve as a trusted delivery lead for enterprise partners, maintaining high standards of quality and consistency.
  • Provide program and product feedback to improve PSBLTY offerings, especially advanced cohort content.
  • Ensure deliverable quality and timeliness, reviewing work outputs and keeping commitments on scope and deadlines.
  • Conduct session prep and follow-up to reinforce accountability and maximize impact.
  • Support client partner and enterprise retention through proactive relationship-building and high-value interactions.
  • Identify expansion opportunities and support renewals aligned with client and partner goals.
  • Continuously refine growth playbooks, frameworks, and approaches for advanced client partners.
  • Participate in internal team meetings, retrospectives, and leadership syncs to improve collaboration and delivery.

While the specifics of your responsibilities are based on your role, certain expectations are universal across our entire team. In addition to your role’s responsibility, you will join everyone at The PSBLTY Co. in your responsibility to:

  • Champion our brand and culture. Be a steward of our brand values in every interaction, both internally and externally. Represent The PSBLTY Co. with integrity, passion, and authenticity, ensuring that who we are—and who you are—is reflected in all that we do.
  • Drive impact through your work. Align your efforts with our mission to help leaders and their organizations grow profits by standing out. Ensure that every task, project, or initiative you undertake moves us closer to this goal.
  • Deliver measurable results. Focus on outcomes that can be tracked and reported. Whether you’re responsible for driving revenue, increasing engagement, or improving client partner satisfaction, your work should be data-driven and results-oriented.
  • Collaborate and lead cross-functionally. Work seamlessly with other team members and departments to ensure that our projects and strategies are aligned, cohesive, and effective. Your ability to communicate and coordinate with others will be crucial to our success.
  • Innovate and refine processes. Continuously seek opportunities to improve the way we work. Whether it’s by streamlining processes, introducing new tools, or refining existing systems, your contributions should make our operations smoother and more efficient.

Embrace the PSBLTY spirit by committing to “Be 100”—100% responsible, 100% of the time, and lead with unwavering accountability in every action you take. We’re counting on you.

What you bring

We’re seeking an impact-driven individual who is eager to contribute to a company that prioritizes authentic growth and transformation.
Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional coaching experience, including facilitating group coaching or cohort-based programs.
  • 3+ years of experience in the financial services or wealth management industry, such as working with, coaching, or leading financial advisors.
  • Deep working knowledge of how advisor practices operate, including practice economics, team structure, client segmentation, and growth strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust, create accountability, and drive measurable outcomes with experienced professionals.
  • Exceptional communication skills and a commitment to delivering a world-class client experience.

Preferred Requirements

  • 8+ years in coaching, consulting, leadership development, or executive advisory roles.
  • Experience coaching financial advisors within large firms or enterprise advisory networks.
  • Background in transformational, leadership-focused, or personal development coaching.
  • Professional coaching certification (such as ICF).
  • Experience mentoring, training, or leading other coaches or client-facing professionals.
  • Experience guiding business owners, executives, or leadership teams through growth and transformation.
  • Track record of driving measurable client outcomes, client retention, referrals, renewals, or expansion opportunities.
  • Ability to work Eastern Time hours

How your success will be measured

As a Senior Growth Leader, you will steward the leadership of four primary metrics:

  • Cohort and Client Partner Retention. Ensuring client partners and enterprise cohorts complete their programs and continue through renewal or expansion.
  • Program Completion and Outcomes. Leading client partners to measurable progress through their program milestones.
  • Growth Leader Development. Helping developing Growth Leaders build the skills and industry knowledge to take on more advanced work.
  • Referrals and Expansion. Generating new opportunities through exceptional delivery and relationship-building.

To be clear, your role will be incentivized to hit these goals. As you grow in the position, we may mutually agree that your goals must evolve to meet the changing needs of the business, too.

What we will do

At The PSBLTY Co., we believe in mutual commitment and responsibility. As much as we expect our team members to contribute to our collective success, we are equally committed—and 100% responsible—to supporting and empowering you to reach your goals. As a team, we commit to:

  • Invest in your growth. We commit to providing you with opportunities for continuous learning, professional development, and leadership growth.
  • Provide clear direction and support. We will ensure you have clear goals, actionable feedback, and the resources you need to succeed in your role.
  • Foster a culture of belonging. We promise to cultivate a work environment where perspectives are valued, and where every team member feels heard, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic self to work.
  • Encourage innovation and creativity. We commit to giving you the creative freedom to explore new ideas, run experiments, and contribute innovative solutions that drive our mission forward.
  • Maintain open and honest communication. We pledge to be transparent in our communication, keeping you informed and engaged in our strategic direction and decisions.
  • Create a balanced work environment. We will prioritize your well-being by encouraging a healthy work-life balance and offering flexibility where possible.
  • Recognize and celebrate your contributions. We promise to acknowledge and reward your hard work, dedication, and the unique value you bring to our team.
  • Support your success. We are committed to being your advocates, removing obstacles in your path, and doing whatever it takes to ensure you thrive within our organization.
  • Align on purpose and values. We will consistently demonstrate our core values, ensuring that our actions as leaders align with the culture we’re building together.
  • Commit to your long-term success. We’re here for the long haul, dedicated to your personal and professional journey, and committed to helping you build a career that’s as fulfilling as it is impactful.

At The PSBLTY Co., your success is our success. We’re in this together, and we’re fully committed to creating an environment where you can do your best work and grow into the leader you’re meant to be.

About the role

This is a full-time, salaried W-2 position.

Why choose PSBLTY

We’re not perfect, but we are relentlessly focused on growth, improvement, and creating an environment where everyone has the space to be their most authentic selves. Whether you’re joining us from Phoenix, Paris, Peru, or anywhere in between, you’ll find a culture that is as bold and dynamic as the leaders we serve. Inspiration will penetrate you daily.

This isn’t just a job; PSBLTY is a movement, and I’m proud to be a part of it.”

We could go on about the reasons to join us, but we believe in hiring for fit above all else. If you’re passionate about pushing boundaries, making a difference, and being part of something bigger than yourself, we invite you to learn more about our culture. We’re not looking for someone to fit into a role—we’re looking for people who feel called to help us shape the future and spread possibility to the world.

Who we’re looking for

We’re seeking an impact-driven individual who is eager to contribute to a company that prioritizes authentic growth and transformation. You will thrive at The PSBLTY Co. if you:

  • Pursue impact and income. You’re driven by a desire to make a meaningful difference in the lives of others, not just by financial gain.
  • Embody our core values. You align with and are committed to upholding our culture of belonging, performance, and leadership.

  • Bring experience and innovation. You have 3+ years of experience in your field, with a strong track record of delivering results and driving growth.

  • Set and achieve goals. You’re results-oriented, focused on hitting targets, and driving both personal and team success.
  • Collaborate and adapt. You work well with others, enjoy the collaborative process, and are comfortable with the ambiguity that comes with growth and change.
  • Value systems and scalability. You embrace systems and processes that enable us to scale and improve continuously.
  • Consider yourself a leader. You’re looking for opportunities to grow in your leadership within a rapidly expanding company.
  • Support diversity and inclusion. You understand that diversity and inclusion are not just buzzwords, but essential to our mission. We’re building a team that reflects a wide range of perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences.

If you typically feel underrepresented in industries like ours, know that you’re not only welcome to apply, but we actively encourage it. We’re committed to building a team that’s as diverse and inclusive as the world we want to impact.

raw.description:
Title: Threat and Vulnerability Management Analyst
Reporting to: Product and Offensive Security Manager

The bright side of mortgages

nesto is Canada's leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go – with total transparency and no haggling.

About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands – CMLS, nesto, and Nesto Cloud – our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services.

Work Location

This is a remote-first role open to candidates anywhere in Canada. You'll have the flexibility to work from home or from any of our offices nationwide.

Why We Are Hiring

Vulnerabilities are being weaponized faster than ever. With AI, the gap between a public disclosure and a working exploit has shrunk from weeks to roughly a day, which means threat exposure needs a daily watch. This new role exists so that someone owns it full time: spotting emerging vulnerabilities inside that tight window, working out what they mean for nesto, and getting the right teams to fix what matters.

Just as important is cutting through the noise. There is a lot of it, and our teams should only spend their time on what is worth it. You'll be the person who can explain clearly what is important and what is not.

What You'll Be Doing

1. Continuous, validated watch of the external perimeter

  • Monitor external attack surface management.
  • Test/validate exploitability and reachability of high-impact findings.
  • Challenge results from tools: flag false positives, stale findings and misattributed assets, and feed them back into tool tuning.
  • Own follow-up to closure: assign an owner, track severity-based SLAs, escalate slips, re-test fixes.
  • Explain risk clearly to internal teams and drive remediation.
  • Partner with engineers on fixes, which are largely handled as infrastructure as code, so you can contribute directly to the solution.
  • Keep the external asset inventory accurate: detect shadow and orphaned assets.
  • Report to leadership: open exposure by severity and age, validated-exploitable count, SLA compliance, time to remediate.

2. Threat intelligence watch

  • Monitor threat intel daily for issues that could impact nesto.
  • For each relevant advisory, publish a fast verdict (exposed and exploitable?) with evidence and a recommended action.
  • Prioritize on real-world risk, not CVSS alone.
  • Turn recurring patterns into new checks, watchlists and threat-model input.

3. Tooling and automation, continuous improvement

  • Use AI tooling in your daily workflow to move faster.
  • Finetune Automation: ASM sources, threat enrichment, reachability checks, ticketing, owner notification, SLA tracking, re-testing.
  • Propose tooling improvements from observed gaps (coverage, false positives, enrichment, reporting).
  • Detects new exposure proactively (DNS, certificate transparency, cloud and deployment changes) before it is scanned or exploited.
  • Build reusable validation checks and playbooks others can run.
  • Follow and refine documented procedures to make sure every vulnerability is tracked through to resolution, including the routine steps.
  • Report posture: share of findings handled without manual work, time to detection, time to validated verdict, false-positive rate.

What You Bring

  • 1–3 years of experience in vulnerability management, or equivalent experience in offensive and defensive security.
  • Hands-on experience with attack surface management and vulnerability scanning tools (e.g., Wiz, Nuclei/Neo, or equivalent), including triaging findings by real-world risk and validating exploitability.
  • Experience working in a corporate environment: opening tickets, communicating across teams, and following up until something is resolved.
  • Enough offensive understanding to judge whether a vulnerability is actually exploitable or just noise.
  • A procedural, autonomous way of working: you follow a process through to the end, including the less exciting steps.
  • Strong judgment and research skills, with the curiosity and attention to detail to spot gaps.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical teams.
  • A healthy skepticism toward AI-generated output: you verify it rather than accept it as given.

Nice-to-Have

  • A background in IT or engineering (not required).
  • Certifications such as OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional) or OSWE (Offensive Security Web Expert), or a recent AI-focused security certification.
  • French is an asset.

This Role Might Be for You If

  • You enjoy structure: finding the vulnerability is only the start for you, and you like seeing it through to the fix.
  • You read a new security advisory and immediately ask "what do we run that this could affect?"
  • When an AI tool gives you an answer, your first instinct is to check it.
  • You are curious enough to keep up with a field that changes daily.
  • You want to help fix problems, not just report them.

Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screen (30 min): A quick intro call to learn about your background and give you a real picture of the role.
  • Discovery Call and Case Study (45 min): A conversation with the hiring manager to dig into your experience and assess mutual fit, including a live role-play exercise relevant to the role. No take-home assignment.
  • Final Interview (60 min): You'll meet with additional team members for a final conversation before a decision is made.
  • Offer Stage: Pending successful background and role-specific vetting checks, you'll receive a formal offer to join the team.

Why You'll Love Working Here

We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.

  • Competitive Rewards – Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.
  • Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.
  • Time to Recharge – Generous vacation (4 weeks), floater days, and statutory holidays to help you recharge.
  • Planning for the Future – RRSP matching to support your long-term financial wellbeing.
  • Family Support – Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.
  • Learning & Growth – Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.
  • Tools for Success – Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, we are committed to working with you to meet your needs.

raw.description:
About IMSM

IMSM (International Management Systems Marketing) is a global force in ISO consultancy - helping organisations not just achieve certification, but transform the way they operate. We partner with businesses across every sector, elevating performance, boosting compliance and unlocking measurable competitive advantage.

Now part of the Axiom GRC division within the WorkNest group and backed by Inflexion, we bring the reach and resources of a worldwide organisation. With teams spanning the UK, Europe, North America, APAC, Africa and Canada - and a growing network of 85 employees and more than 350 expert contractors enables us to deliver high-quality, results-driven ISO consultancy to clients worldwide.

Role Overview

The Sales Development Representative (SDR) position is designed for ambitious, hardworking individuals who want to develop their sales career utilising market-leading lead generation tooling, an attractive and relevant product portfolio and forming part of an experienced, supportive team. This is a mixed inbound and outbound role. The SDR will generate new pipeline by prospecting target accounts and working marketing-qualified leads, with the primary goal of booking qualified discovery call meetings for Business Development Managers. Success is measured by those meetings converting into closed business. SDRs earn commission on two explicit triggers: when a qualified discovery meeting they booked is held, and when a deal originating from that meeting closes, based on contract value.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Delivery

  • Spend approximately 70% of time on outbound prospecting into target accounts and 30% on inbound follow-up of marketing-qualified leads.

  • Proactively identify, research, and qualify potential clients through outbound prospecting, account research, and networking.

  • Execute a structured mix of outbound and inbound outreach, optimising connect rates, meeting conversion, and lead response times.

  • Book qualified discovery call meetings for BDMs, ensuring each meeting is well briefed, accepted by the receiving seller, and positioned to convert into a sale.

  • Qualify interest, fit, and need on introductory conversations so only sales-ready discovery meetings are passed to BDMs, improving the likelihood that sourced meetings close.

Learning & Growth

  • Participate fully in training, mentoring, and coaching to build product knowledge and sales skills.

  • Shadow more experienced colleagues in client meetings and pitches to gain exposure to the full sales process.

  • Take ownership of personal development, applying feedback to continually improve.

  • Demonstrate ambition and readiness to progress into more senior roles over time.

Team Contribution

  • Own inbound follow-up on campaigns, events, and marketing-generated leads (approximately 30% of the role), converting them into qualified discovery meetings.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records of activity, meetings booked, meeting outcomes, and sourced pipeline so BDMs, and leadership have full visibility.

  • Bring energy, resilience, and a positive mindset to the team environment.

  • Contribute to a culture of collaboration, accountability, and client focus.

KPIs & Performance Measures

Lead Response:

  • 100% of inbound MQLs called within 10–15 minutes during business hours.

Activity Levels:

  • 40–60 calls per day, weighted approximately 70% targeted outbound and 30% inbound MQL follow-up.

  • Execution of agreed multi-channel outreach cadences (minimum 7 contact attempts per MQL or target contact).

  • Primary quota: qualified discovery meetings booked and held for BDMs. Commission is triggered when those meetings are held and when sourced deals close.

Outcome Metrics:

  • Targeted on qualified discovery meetings set and accepted for BDMs.

  • Commission triggers, tracked in CRM: (1) Meeting held - paid when a qualified discovery meeting booked by the SDR is held with a BDM; no-shows and unaccepted meetings do not pay. (2) Closed -won - paid on the contract value of deals that originate from an SDR-sourced meeting.

Skills & Attributes

  • Customer-facing or sales development experience is essential in a B2B setting.

  • Strong communication skills, with confidence to engage potential clients on outbound calls and convert inbound inquiries into meetings.

  • Highly motivated, target-driven, and comfortable working toward both meeting quotas and closed-revenue commission.

  • Organised and disciplined, with attention to detail in managing outreach cadences, meeting handoffs, and CRM activity.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn about the industry.

  • Ambitious, career-driven, and eager to progress.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for events, training, and client engagement.

What We Offer in Return:

  • Flexible Work Arrangements- Enjoy the freedom of fully remote or hybrid work options, giving you the flexibility to balance work and life your way

  • 25 Days Annual Holiday (Increasing with Service)- Start with generous holiday time, and watch it grow as you build your career with us

  • Birthday Day Off- Celebrate your special day with a day off, because we believe in making your birthday memorable!

  • Charity Day Off- A paid day off to give back to your community by volunteering at a local charity

  • Up to £15 per Month Fitness Subsidy- Stay healthy and motivated with a monthly fitness allowance to support your well-being

  • Life Assurance- Enjoy peace of mind knowing you and your loved ones are covered

  • Auto-Enrolment Pension Contributions- Secure your future with our pension plan, starting after just three months of service

  • Learning and Development Opportunities- Take your career to the next level with access to training workshops, courses, and continuous professional development

  • Opportunities for Professional Growth- We are committed to your career progression and will support you with opportunities to advance within the company

At IMSM, we believe in creating a workplace that’s built on collaboration, inclusivity, and continuous growth. We are committed to fostering a culture where Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) are fundamental values, and where every team member feels respected, valued and empowered to succeed. We provide opportunities for professional development to help our colleagues reach their full potential, and we strive to create an environment where everyone’s voice is heard.

We are proud of our culture, which fosters both innovation and learning, and we are dedicated to building a space where all our team members can thrive and contribute to our collective success.

Are you ready to join us and be part of a dynamic, inclusive team that is shaping the future of ISO consultancy?

Overview

Ogletree Deakins is seeking a technically grounded, business-oriented leader to manage its Business Solutions & Delivery team. This multidisciplinary team supports business engagement, solution discovery, requirements definition, project coordination, and business validation.

The ideal candidate combines first-hand software engineering experience and knowledge of contemporary technology practices with strong people leadership, business acumen, and delivery expertise. This individual will lead and develop a high-performing team, strengthen collaboration between business and technology stakeholders, and drive improvements in technology delivery and operational maturity

Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary team of Business Analysts and Project Managers.
  • Establish clear expectations for performance, accountability, quality, and professional development.
  • Manage team priorities and capacity while fostering a collaborative, accountable, and results-oriented culture.

Business Solutions & Discovery

  • Partner with business leaders to understand challenges, clarify objectives, and identify opportunities for technology-enabled improvements.
  • Lead business-focused discovery, facilitate decisions, and collaborate with technical teams to evaluate potential solutions.
  • Oversee requirements definition, business analysis, and acceptance criteria, ensuring alignment between business needs and technical execution.

Project Management & Delivery

  • Oversee project planning, coordination, risk management, dependencies, and stakeholder communication for assigned initiatives.
  • Partner with engineering leaders and delivery teams to align commitments, resolve challenges, and maintain delivery visibility.
  • Coordinate business validation and acceptance activities to ensure delivered solutions meet expectations.

Operational Maturity & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive cross-functional initiatives to improve application reliability, supportability, and operational readiness in partnership with engineering and operational leaders.
  • Promote effective delivery practices, clear handoffs, and continuous improvement across business and technology teams.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce rework, improve efficiency, and strengthen long-term operational sustainability.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 8+ years of progressive professional experience in software engineering, application development, technology delivery, or related disciplines.
  • 3+ years of hands-on professional software engineering experience, including developing, integrating, or maintaining production software applications.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of contemporary software engineering practices and architectures, including modern application development, cloud-based solutions, APIs, systems integration, and software delivery practices.
  • 3+ years of people management or technical team leadership experience, including coaching, performance accountability, and professional development.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex technology initiatives involving multiple teams, stakeholders, and dependencies.
  • Ability to apply technical knowledge to recognize solution complexity, understand technical risks, and collaborate effectively with engineers and architects.
  • Experience engaging business stakeholders, defining requirements, and translating business needs into technology deliverables.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional discussions, challenge assumptions, manage disagreement, and drive decisions.

Job title:Software Engineer, PCA

Reports to:Team Lead, Engineering

Division:Central Services

Location:Alpharetta, GA/Remote US or Canada

Grade:19

About Priority:

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people tobe known for results- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

About the Role:

We are building the next generation of financial management applications for the automotive vertical. We are a small, experienced team of agentic engineers, leading Priority's acceleration into AI-native product development.

You will work across the full stack: product features, the integrations that feed them, the platform andtooling underneath, and a share of your time on Priority's company-wide AI transformation initiatives.

Responsibilities:

What you will do

  • Design, build and ship features end to end: back-end services, APIs, front-end screens, tests and deployment.

  • Build and maintain integrations with dealer management systems, banks and payment platforms through their supported APIs and partner programs.

  • Model and load operational data into our data platform with full change history.

  • Use AI coding agents daily, and help maintain the team's shared agent tooling and standards.

  • Contribute to internal AI initiatives such as evaluation tooling, internal assistants, and guardrails appropriate to a regulated financial company.

  • Participate in code review, sprint planning and production support.

  • Interface with customers, both remotely and on-site, to gather feedback and improve our offerings.

How we work

You will help set the culture of a small team, so we are explicit about it:

  • Own the outcome, not the ticket. You ship it, watch it in production, and fix what breaks without being asked.

  • Speed through judgment.You decide quickly when something is reversible and slow down deliberately when it moves money or touches customer data.

  • Say the hard thing early.If a plan, a deadline or a design is wrong, you raise it before it costs us, including when it is your own work.

  • Raise the bar for others.You mentor through code review, write down decisions, and leave every system easier for the next engineer.

  • Customer-close. You talk to dealers directly and build from what they actually do, not what we assume.

Security and compliance are part of the job

  • We move money for businesses, so trust is the product. Here, that means:

  • You treat security as a design input. Least privilege, secrets management, input validation and audit logging are part of "done", not a follow-up ticket.

  • You never build a shortcut around a control, even under deadline pressure. If a control is slowing the team down, you fix the control the right way and with the right people.

  • You understand why PCI DSS and SOC 2 exist, keep cardholder and customer data out of places it does not belong (including AI tools), and produce evidence as a by-product of good engineering.

  • You keep customer-facing and internal access strictly separate, and you design integrations so every money movement is traceable and reconcilable.

  • You report mistakes and near misses immediately and without spin. We treat those reports as a strength.

Candidate Requirements:

  • 3 to 8 years of professional software development experience, or equivalent demonstrated ability.

  • Proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, and in React.

  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.

  • Experience integrating with third-party APIs and handling external data.

  • Hands-on experience using AI coding agents (such as Claude Code) as part of your daily development

  • workflow. You will be asked to demonstrate this during the interview process.

  • Familiarity with AWS, Docker and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Clear written communication and a track record of finishing what you start.

  • Located in the United States or Canada.

Nice to have

  • Experience with NestJS, Fastify, TypeORM, MySQL, Redis, Vite or Tailwind.

  • PHP and Laravel, which run parts of our current production platform.

  • Experience working under PCI DSS or SOC 2 controls.

  • Exposure to automotive retail or dealer management systems.

  • Fintech or payments experience, including reconciliation or ledger-style data.

  • Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse.

  • Keycloak or OpenID Connect.

  • Experience building evaluations for LLM-based systems.

Work Environment & Culture:

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand -an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

Compensation and Benefits:

Compensation range: [$120K-$145K USD, $95K-$116K CAD]
We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

Financial Wellness

  • Bonus programs

  • 401(k) match

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • HSA and FSA options

  • Financial wellness resources and employee discount programs

Health & Well-being

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Mental health support for employees and dependents through Lyra Health

  • Family planning and women’s health benefits through Carrot

  • Gym membership reimbursement and virtual wellness programs (including yoga)

Time Off

  • 3 weeks PTO to start, with unlimited PTO after year one

Growth & Development

  • Education expense reimbursement

  • Leadership development programs

  • Certified Payments Professional (CPP) certification support

We believe great performance starts with feeling supported - and we’ve built our benefits with that in mind.

Traditional Physical Requirements:

  • Requires prolonged sitting, standing, bending, stooping and stretching.

  • Requires the ability to lift 10 pounds.

  • Requires eye-hand coordination, manual dexterity and a normal range of hearing and vision (with or without correction).

Join our team at Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. and be part of a dynamic and innovative company that is transforming the financial technology landscape. Together, we can shape the future of payments and banking solutions while providing unmatched value to our clients.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Oracle HCM integration technologies, collaborative skills with Boomi middleware, and a strong background in API-based and file-based integrations.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain complex Oracle HCM Cloud integrations using Boomi as middleware in accordance with enterprise architecture standards and development best practices.
  • Develop and support inbound and outbound integrations utilizing Oracle HCM technologies including REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, HCM Extracts, HDL, HSDL, BI Publisher, XML, JSON, and XSLT.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical designs, interface specifications, data mappings, transformation rules, and integration workflows.
  • Lead technical design sessions and provide subject matter expertise for Oracle HCM integration architecture and development.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production integration issues, data discrepancies, interface failures, and performance bottlenecks to ensure system reliability.
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and SQL-based analysis to support troubleshooting and maintain data integrity across integrated systems.
  • Collaborate with HR, Payroll, Benefits, Talent Management, IT teams, and third-party vendors to support ongoing business initiatives and system enhancements.
  • Support Oracle HCM quarterly releases by evaluating integration impacts, implementing required updates, and ensuring continued compatibility.
  • Develop and execute unit testing, system integration testing, and deployment activities while adhering to organizational change management processes.
  • Implement and maintain security controls, authentication protocols, API governance, and data protection standards across all integrations.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, interface specifications, support procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Participate in production support and lead root-cause analysis efforts for critical integration incidents.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, process improvements, and integration optimization to enhance operational efficiency and system performance.


YOU MUST HAVE:

  • Minimum 4 years of experience developing integrations for Oracle HCM Cloud.
  • Strong experience with Oracle HCM integration technologies including: HCM Extracts, HDL (HCM Data Loader), HSDL, REST APIs, SOAP Web Services,BI Publisher.
  • Experience with XML, JSON, XSLT, SFTP, and file-based integrations.
  • Strong SQL skills for data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting production environments and resolving complex integration issues.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.


WE VALUE:

  • Experience integrating Oracle HCM Cloud with Payroll, Benefits, Recruiting, Learning, Workforce Management, and Talent Management modules.
  • Experience with API management, OAuth, security certificates, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and release management practices.
  • Prior experience leading integration project
  • Oracle HCM Cloud : Core HR, Recruiting, Talent Management, Learning, Compensation, Payroll
  • Integration Technologies: Oracle HCM REST APIs, Oracle HCM SOAP Services, HCM Extracts, HDL / HSDL, BI Publisher, XML, JSON, XSLT, SFTP / File Transfer, Boomi middleware.
  • Development & Support: SQL, API Security & Governance, Integration Architecture, Production Support, Root Cause Analysis, Performance Optimization, Change & Release Management

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:

  • Health Insurance Coverage
  • Education Assistance
  • Maternity & Paternity Leave
  • Menstrual Wellness Benefit
  • Bereavement Leave

raw.description:
FICO (NYSE: FICO)is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100+ countries make better decisions. Join our world-class team today and fulfill your career potential!

At FICO, we are always looking for exceptional talent to drive our ambitious growth strategy. While we may not have an immediate opening, this is a general posting for outstanding Product Marketing - Sr. Directors who specialize in market intelligence. If you’d like to learn more, we encourage you to introduce yourself so that we can begin a conversation and consider you for opportunities as they arise.


The Opportunity

FICO is seeking a Senior Director of Market Intelligence to lead the competitive and market intelligence discipline that equips our Sales and Product Management teams with the insight they need to win. Reporting to the head of Market Intelligence & Ecosystem Enablement, you will build and lead the function, set its strategy, and help define the FICO context lake that supports customer-facing and product management roles across short-, medium-, and long-term needs. This is a high-visibility leadership role in which sharp analysis, executive communication and cross-functional influence directly shape how FICO positions and grows FICO Platform.

What You’ll Contribute

  • Lead FICO's market and competitive intelligence function, setting the strategy, operating model and priorities for a team that serves Sales and Product Management.
  • Define and own market intelligence requirements as strategic inputs to FICO’s cross-functional enterprise context lake, curating competitive, market and customer-facing intelligence to support short-, medium- and long-term use cases by target customer persona.
  • Deliver timely, decision-ready competitive analysis, including competitor positioning, win/loss insight and battlecard inputs, for sellers, product leaders and executives.
  • Track and assess the decisioning, AI, governance, and related software markets, and identify emerging categories that FICO should address.
  • Partner with Analyst Relations to inform FICO's preparation for analyst evaluations so that our participation results in a Leader outcome.
  • Align with Value Messaging so that intelligence informs messaging, positioning and differentiation across the portfolio.
  • Establish intake, cadence and success measures for intelligence requests, and show how insights influence sales and product decisions.
  • Build demand for, then develop and lead a high-performing team.
  • Evaluate tools, data sources and AI-enabled methods that scale the function.

What We’re Seeking


  • Demonstrated leadership of competitive intelligence, market intelligence, and strategic research in an enterprise software or technology environment.
  • Proven ability to turn complex market and competitor data into clear, actionable recommendations for executives, sellers and product leaders.
  • Experience designing and scaling intelligence programs, including data sources, knowledge repositories, workflows and governance.
  • Working knowledge of how industry analyst firms evaluate vendors and markets, and experience supporting analyst relations or category strategy.
  • Strong grasp of enterprise software, data, AI, and decisioning related markets, with the curiosity and aptitude to learn horizontal adjacencies and vertical use case domains with focus on B2C industries.
  • Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills, with the credibility to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Experience building and developing teams and collaborating across product, sales, marketing and partner organizations.
  • Sound judgment, ethical handling of competitive information and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Our Offer to You


  • An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
  • The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
  • Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
  • An engaging, people-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.
  • The targeted base pay range for this role is: $149,100 to $234,300 with this range reflecting differences in candidate knowledge, skills and experience.

Why Make a Move to FICO?

At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.

FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:

• Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.

• Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.

• Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.

Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!

Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at

FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.

  • capacità analitiche;

  • capacità di lavorare su sistemi complessi;

  • capacità di condivisione delle competenze con figure più junior;

  • flessibilità;
