raw.title: Senior User Acquisition Manager (Meta Ads), ApplyMe
raw.excerpt: ApplyMe — AI-платформа, яка автоматизує пошук роботи і допомагає людям швидше отримувати запрошення на співбесіди.
raw.description:
ApplyMe — AI-платформа, яка автоматизує пошук роботи і допомагає людям швидше отримувати запрошення на співбесіди.

Ми вже провалідували бізнес-модель, налагодили залучення платного трафіку та знайшли робочу юніт-економіку. Наша наступна велика ціль: масштабування у 2027 році. Саме тому ми шукаємо Senior User Acquisition Manager, який(-а) візьме на себе відповідальність за цей напрям і допоможе вивести продукт на новий рівень.

Твоя задача: побудувати повноцінну growth-систему, а не просто запускати рекламні кампанії.

Якщо ти вже проходив(-ла) подібний скейл, розумієш воронку end-to-end і вже мислиш як Head of Acquisition, ця роль для тебе.

Про цю вакансію.ApplyMe є самостійним стартапом, проєкт має власну команду та інвестиції, а Jooble допомагає йому з наймом.

Чим ти будеш займатися

  • Відповідати за paid acquisition end-to-end: розробляти стратегію закупівлі трафіку, управляти бюджетами та відповідати за досягнення бізнес-KPI.

  • Масштабувати Meta Ads до $1M+ на місяць, утримуючи CAC та LTV у цільових межах.

  • Контролювати якість трекінгу та аналітики: Meta CAPI, server-side events, UTM, атрибуція та коректність даних для прийняття рішень.

  • Знаходити й усувати вузькі місця у воронці: ads → landing → onboarding → paywall → subscription

  • Розвивати систему тестування креативів: формувати гіпотези, аналізувати результати та масштабувати успішні концепти.

  • Формувати та пріоритизувати growth-експерименти: тестувати аудиторії, офери, підходи до закупівлі та воронки на основі потенційного впливу на бізнес-результат.

  • Автоматизувати управління рекламними кампаніями та звітність: розробляти автоправила (Birch), впроваджувати AI-інструменти (зокрема Claude) для оптимізації процесів.

  • Планувати бюджети та прогнозувати результати: будувати прогнози масштабування, аналізувати відхилення та коригувати стратегію.

  • Побудувати та реалізувати стратегію зниження залежності від одного каналу та гео.

Що для нас важливо

  • 3+ роки в User Acquisition / Performance Marketing / Growth Marketing.

  • Запуск нових напрямів росту з нуля (гео, аудиторії, воронки, канали), досвід у R&D-проєктах (B2C Subscription).

  • Практичний досвід масштабування бюджетів від 100-200К на місяць до $1 млн в Meta Ads.

  • Досвід роботи з Tier 1 ринками (США або подібні), розуміння конкуренції та CPM.

  • Досвід із web-підписочними продуктами: лендинги, квіз-флоу, paywall-структури, їхній вплив на конверсію і CAC.

  • Досвід швидких циклів експериментів і пріоритизації гіпотез за впливом.

Буде перевагою

  • Робота з кількома платними каналами одночасно.

  • Досвід менеджменту або менторства UA-спеціалістів.

Тобі буде з нами комфортно, якщо ти

  • Береш відповідальність за результат, самостійно знаходиш рішення та не потребуєш постійного контролю і не відпускаєш проблему, поки не знайдеш рішення.

  • Вмієш сказати "ні" нереалістичній цілі і запропонувати альтернативу з цифрами.

  • Тобі цікаво будувати систему і команду, а не лише крутити кампанії.

  • Любиш занурюватися в деталі воронок, креативів і поведінки користувачів.

  • Спокійно ухвалюєш рішення на неповних даних в інтенсивному середовищі, де важливі швидкість і результат.

Що ми пропонуємо

  • Реальний вплив: ти відповідаєш за ключовий напрям росту, що напряму впливає на revenue.

  • Чіткий шлях до Head of Acquisition разом із масштабуванням продукту та до розвитку в R&D.

  • Мінімум бюрократії: тестуєш, вирішуєш і швидко бачиш результат.

  • Продукт зі змістом: job-tech, який реально допомагає людям знаходити роботу.

  • Віддалений формат.

Не відповідаєш усім пунктам, але маєш сильний досвід скейлу в Meta? Все одно відгукуйся, ми хочемо з тобою поговорити.

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfill their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

Specific job responsibilities:
Responsible for achieving coverage and frequency targets, and consistently achieving sales targets in assigned territory.
Contributes to regional training, developing the key skills of other team members.
With guidance, initiates systems to monitor sales progress and action plans. Regularly measures success, documents and provides feedback on performance.
May work in collaboration with outside partner companies to co-promote products or services.
Manages territory budgets for customer contacts, speaker events and other miscellaneous external expenditures.
May represent company at professional events and promote company products at such events.
Works cooperatively with Medical Science Liaisons, National Account Managers, Marketing and other internal Gilead team members on various cross-functional projects.
Assists in the identification and resolution of issues and opportunities, and communicates proactively to marketing and sales management.
Completes necessary administrative tasks in a timely manner e.g. updating customer database, expenses.
Communicates and functions across the commercial team, ensuring efficient collaboration on projects.
Operates in compliance with Gilead commercial compliance policy, and all applicable federal and state laws and guidance relating to product promotion and information dissemination including, but not limited to, the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, the Food and Drug Administration’s implementing regulations, the Federal Anti-Kickback Statute, the False Claims Act, PhRMA, Corporate Code of Business Conduct and the Office of the Inspector General’s Compliance Program Guidance for Pharmaceutical Manufacturers.

Knowledge:
Has proven expertise in interpersonal and relationship-building skills, along with strong influencing and negotiating skills.
Has a working knowledge of relevant therapeutic/disease/product area.
Is familiar with industry trends and remains current with competitor’s resources and practices. Can speak to the pros and cons (overall goals of plan, cost vs. efficacy, dosing, duration, etc.) of a product protocol.
Is able to identify rising issues / solutions / opportunities and is able to present / communicate arguments to management/marketing.
Demonstrates solid analytical skills, able to identify and understand moderately complex issues and problems, and interpret information in a manner that provides appropriate recommendations to management and specialists.
Is able to work in cross-functional teams.

International Therapeutic Specialist

Must be self-motivated and able to work with a general level of autonomy and independence. Previous pharmaceutical experience is essential and relevant therapeutic working knowledge is desirable. Proven expertise in interpersonal and relationship building skills is required.

Specific education and experience requirements:
Typical candidates will possess a BA or BS degree, and 4+ years of relevant sales experience within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry. Prior experience in appropriate therapeutic area highly desired.
Achievement of any mandatory country-specific pharmaceutical sales certifications is essential.

International Therapeutic Specialist

Typically requires a BA or BS degree and minimum of 2 years + of relevant selling experience within the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry. Prior experience in appropriate therapeutic area highly desired.


International Therapeutic Specialist
Responsible for achieving coverage and frequency targets and consistently achieving sales targets in assigned territory. Represents Gilead’s products and services to a defined customer base within a specific geographic area. Prepares business plan for own territory, assigns targets and communicates required actions to achieve goals. With guidance, initiates systems to monitor sales progress and action plans. Prepares territory budgets for customer contacts, speaker events and other miscellaneous external expenditures. May work in collaboration with outside partner companies to co-promote products or services. May represent company at professional events and promote company products at such events. Works cooperatively with Medical Science Liaisons, National Account Managers, Marketing and other internal Gilead team members on various cross-functional projects related to specific accounts or physicians. Assists in the identification and resolution of issues and opportunities, and communicates proactively to marketing and sales management. Completes necessary administrative tasks in a timely manner e.g. updating customer database, expenses, etc. Responsible for achieving the competency levels required in the role. Compliance with all regulatory agencies, state, and federal law is required.

Except if otherwise provided by applicable law, all employment actions relating to issues such as compensation, benefits, transfers, layoffs, returns from layoffs, company-sponsored training, education assistance, social and recreational programs are administered on a non-discriminatory basis (i.e. without regard to protected characteristics or prohibited grounds, which may include an individual’s gender, race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, creed, physical or mental disability, marital status, medical condition, veteran status, and age, unless such protection is prohibited by federal, state, municipal, provincial, local or other applicable laws including nationalization and residency restrictions and requirements). raw.description:
WHAT WE DO

Founded in 2007, Growth Acceleration Partners (GAP) is a consulting and technology services company. We consult, design, build and modernize revenue-generating software and data engineering solutions for clients. With modernization services and AI tools, we help businesses achieve a competitive advantage through technology. GAP’s remote, integrated engineering teams use end-to-end solutions to innovate and align with your business goals. We have 600+ English-speaking engineers based in Latin America and approximately 20 U.S.-based engineers. With some of the highest customer satisfaction scores in the industry, GAP’s focus is customer and employee success.

GAP is a woman-owned company headquartered in Austin Texas. We are a values-based company focused on growing our people by investing in education, onsite English classes and training in the latest technologies, including AI, data analytics and machine learning. Our goal is to provide solutions for our customers that help them achieve critical business outcomes, while enabling our GAPSters and our communities to attain long-term success.

Summary

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Node/React Engineer to design, build, and deploy scalable features across serverless back-end services and modern web interfaces for a leading company in the insurance technology industry. You will take end-to-end ownership of technical solutions from architectural analysis through development, automated testing, and release. Operating with a high level of autonomy in a collaborative Agile environment, you will also own the cloud infrastructure as code for the services you build while providing technical guidance to the team.

Education

achelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience with full SDLC exposure, specializing in Node.js, TypeScript, and React
  • Proven experience designing, building, and shipping enterprise-scale AWS serverless architectures from day one
  • Hands-on experience writing Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK in TypeScript, including custom constructs and CI/CD pipeline deployments
  • Strong experience working with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and ORMs such as Prisma, including schema migrations
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs documented with OpenAPI within monorepo architectures

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop new features and enhancements across Node.js back-end services and React front-end applications
  • Architect, build, and deploy AWS serverless solutions using Lambda, API Gateway, and related managed services
  • Define and maintain Infrastructure as Code using AWS CDK, enforcing least-privilege security and serverless best practices
  • Own work items from technical analysis and estimation through unit and end-to-end testing to production release
  • Write and maintain clear technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and runbooks while conducting thorough peer code reviews

Required Technical Skills

Strong experience in several of the following areas:

  • Front End: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Vite, Zustand, Ant Design
  • Back End & APIs: Node.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, OpenAPI, Middy, AWS Lambda Powertools
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, Aurora PostgreSQL, EventBridge, SNS, SQS, S3, Cognito, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch), AWS CDK
  • Testing & DevOps: Jest, Testing Library, Playwright, GitHub Actions, Docker, Nx monorepos

Nice to Have

  • Insurance domain experience, particularly involving quoting, rating, or underwriting workflows
  • Experience designing multitenant architectures with tenant isolation across data, authentication, and configuration
  • Familiarity with business rules or decision engines (such as GoRules) and calculation-heavy logic requiring decimal accuracy
  • Experience with AWS Step Functions, DynamoDB, k6 performance testing, and observability tools like AWS X-Ray

Soft Skills

• Advanced English proficiency

  • High autonomy and ownership with the ability to deliver independently in a distributed, asynchronous environment
  • Strong collaboration skills with a habit of proactive communication and clear technical documentation
  • Ability to provide constructive technical guidance and design input within an Agile Scrum team

We value everyone's unique background, and we provide equal opportunities regardless of race, color, creed, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, veteran status or any other personal right protected by law. Our team is growing! We’re excited to be expanding our team with a new Telehealth Registered Nurse position. If you’re ready for a new challenge and an opportunity to use your nursing skills in a different way, check out the openings and take your next step with us!

The Registered Nurse, Telehealth is part of the Clinical Engagement Center (CEC) and conducts telephonic comprehensive medication reviews and consultations to improve patient adherence, close therapy gaps, and support clinical initiatives, all while ensuring compliance with CMS and HIPAA regulations.

The Registered Nurse, Telehealth will also collaborate with healthcare providers, clinics, and pharmacies to resolve patient concerns and enhance care coordination. Additionally, the Registered Nurse, Telehealth will stay current with regulatory updates and clinical guidelines.

Is this you? Find out more below!

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Independently conduct routine telephonic comprehensive medication reviews (CMRs) in accordance with the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), ensuring compliance with HIPAA and other regulatory standards.
  • Educate members on program benefits and medication adherence applying routine clinical judgment within program protocols to identify risks, address, barriers and determine appropriate interventions.

  • Support members during transitions of care, including routine Personalized Member Transitions (PMT), by discussing alternative medications and coverage changes.
  • Collaborate with team members to maintain consistent, high-quality clinical services.
  • Stay informed on clinical program requirements and procedures to ensure compliance and quality.
  • Conduct telephonic clinical outreach to members, prescribers, and pharmacies address patient concerns and enhance care coordination.
  • Coordinate with providers, clinics, pharmacies, and members to resolve medication-related concerns and promote continuity of care.
  • Maintain current knowledge of clinical practice guidelines, medications, and best practices to deliver accurate and effective recommendations.
  • Identify and address barriers to medication access, providing guidance on benefits and available resources.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What our team expects from you?

  • High school diploma or GED required. BSN preferred.
  • Current, unrestricted Registered Nurse multi-state compact license in the state of residence required. Willingness and ability to obtain additional state licensure where applicable.
  • 3 years of clinical experience including direct consultation experience required.
  • Experience as a member of a multi-disciplinary team preferred.
  • Professional PBM industry work experience preferred.
  • Experience and demonstrated competency in motivational interviewing techniques and facilitating behavior change preferred.
  • Knowledge of applicable data privacy practices and laws preferred.
  • Knowledge of healthcare industry practices and HIPAA regulations required.
  • Knowledge of chronic disease states, such as diabetes, heart failure, COPD, asthma, cardiovascular disease, hypertension, and dyslipidemia required.

raw.description:
Elevate your career with MANTECH International Corporation! Join a dynamic team dedicated to national security through cutting-edge technology. Since 1968, MANTECH has led in delivering advanced solutions to government intelligence, the Department of Defense, and Federal Civilian sectors. Dive into innovation in Digital Transformation, Cybersecurity, IT, Data Analytics and Software Development. Your journey to impactful work and rapid growth starts now—be extraordinary at MANTECH!

***This is for a future opportunity***

MANTECH seeks a motivated, career and customer-oriented Associate OneStream Consultant to join our team. At MANTECH, we are re-engineering the financial backbone of the U.S. Government. We provide highly configured, mission-critical Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) and Financial Close and Reporting solutions leveraging the OneStream platform. This is a fully remote opportunity.


As an Associate OneStream Consultant, you will work alongside Senior Architects and Lead Consultants to build and configure bespoke OneStream solutions. This is an entry-to-junior level "builder" role for a technically minded professional eager to master the OneStream platform. Under direct guidance and mentorship, you will learn to configure core application components—including business rules, security models, data workflows, and reports—that enable data-driven decision-making for federal agencies.


Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Under the direction of senior project team members, build and configure OneStream artifacts including Cube Views, Dashboards, MarketPlace Solutions, and Workflow Profiles.
  • Create user interface elements, BI Viewer dashboards, and Extensible Documents to support client reporting requirements.
  • Assist in designing and maintaining Security Groups and Roles, assigning appropriate access rights to dimensions, workflows, and users to preserve data integrity.
  • Apply foundational knowledge of VB.NET and SQL to assist with writing member formulas and standard business rules (Finance, Parser, Connector) that enhance application functionality.
  • Design and execute Data Management sequences, transformation rules, and data load artifacts; validate data accuracy using Quick Views and XFGET/XFSET functions.
  • Utilize OneStream error logs and trace analysis under supervision to troubleshoot and resolve
  • Listen carefully to client and team member needs and respond proactively; collaborate constructively with teammates to deliver high-quality outcomes that exceed client expectations.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Systems, Finance/Accounting with an IT focus, or a related field.
  • 0-1+ year of professional or internship experience in software development, financial systems implementation, or other business related projects.
  • Foundational experience with SQL (Oracle or SQL Server) for data querying and manipulation.
  • Basic understanding of multidimensional data (OLAP) concepts or core financial reporting principles.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with federal financial processes, including Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE).
  • OneStream Certified Associate (OCA) – Implementation Foundations, or completion of official OneStream training courses (First Project Readiness / Application Build).
  • Financial or IT Certifications: Certified Government Financial Manager (CGFM), Certified Defense Financial Manager (CDFM), or CompTIA Security+.
  • Exposure to Federal Security frameworks, Single Sign-On (SSO) integration, or Authority to Operate (ATO) processes.
  • Prior experience in a professional services or consulting firm environment.

Clearance Requirements

  • US Citizenship with the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance or higher.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% of the time.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery.
  • Frequently communicates with co-workers and management to exchange accurate information.




The projected compensation range for this position is $63,500.00-$105,900.00. There are differentiating factors that can impact a final salary/hourly rate, including, but not limited to, Contract Wage Determination, relevant work experience, skills and competencies that align to the specified role, geographic location (For Remote Opportunities), education and certifications as well as Federal Government Contract Labor categories. In addition, MANTECH invests in its employees beyond just compensation. MANTECH’s benefits offerings include, dependent upon position, Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Holiday Pay, short-term and long-term Disability, Retirement and Savings, Learning and Development opportunities, wellness programs as well as other optional benefit elections.

MANTECH considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to disability or veteran status or any other status protected under any federal, state, or local law or regulation.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to apply for a position with MANTECH, please email us at and provide your name and contact information.

raw.description:
Summary:

VIAVI (NASDAQ: VIAV) is a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. VIAVI is also a leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications.

We are the people behind the products that help keep the world connected at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between. VIAVI employees are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.

Duties & Responsibilities:

The Strategic Program Manager provides administrative and project coordination support for acquisition, divestiture, and integration activities. This role supports M&A project leaders and cross-functional teams by coordinating meetings and activities, maintaining project plans and documentation, tracking deliverables and action items, and helping ensure key milestones are completed on schedule.


The role requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, discretion, and the ability to work effectively with sensitive and confidential business information. The successful candidate will be comfortable coordinating multiple workstreams and stakeholders in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.


Key Responsibilities


M&A Project Coordination:


  • Provide administrative and project coordination support throughout the M&A lifecycle, including due diligence, transaction planning, closing preparation, and post-close integration activities.
  • Maintain detailed project plans, timelines, milestone trackers, action-item logs, and status reports.
  • Coordinate activities across multiple functional workstreams, including Finance, HR, Legal, IT, Operations, Sales, Supply Chain, and other business functions.
  • Monitor deadlines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and open actions and follow up with responsible stakeholders.
  • Support project leaders with identification and escalation of schedule conflicts, outstanding deliverables, and coordination issues.

Due Diligence & Transaction Support:


  • Coordinate due diligence activities, meetings, documentation requests, and follow-up items.
  • Maintain due diligence request lists and track the status of requested and received information.
  • Assist with the organization of transaction documentation and electronic data rooms or other secure document repositories.
  • Coordinate information requests between internal stakeholders and external parties, as directed by M&A leadership.
  • Maintain accurate records of key decisions, approvals, deliverables, and outstanding items.
  • Handle sensitive company and transaction information with a high degree of confidentiality and discretion.

Integration & Separation Support:


  • Support Day 1 readiness and post-close integration or separation planning.
  • Maintain integration plans, checklists, workstream trackers, and milestone schedules.
  • Coordinate recurring integration meetings and cross-functional workstream reviews.
  • Track integration commitments, dependencies, decisions, risks, and action items through completion.
  • Assist teams with maintaining consistent project documentation and reporting across functional workstreams.
  • Support project closeout activities, including documentation, lessons learned, and transition of outstanding activities to business owners.

Meetings & Communications:


  • Schedule and coordinate M&A project meetings involving internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prepare agendas, meeting materials, presentations, and project updates.
  • Document key decisions, action items, owners, and due dates and distribute follow-up materials as appropriate.
  • Prepare and maintain project status reports and executive-level presentation materials under the direction of project leadership.
  • Help facilitate timely communication among project teams and stakeholders.

Documentation & Administration:


  • Establish and maintain organized project files and document repositories.
  • Help ensure appropriate access to confidential project information and documentation.
  • Maintain stakeholder lists, project calendars, distribution lists, and team resources.
  • Support purchase orders, invoices, consulting engagements, and project expense tracking, as applicable.
  • Follow established document-management, records-retention, confidentiality, and project governance requirements.

Key Competencies:


  • Confidentiality and discretion: Handles highly sensitive transaction and employee information appropriately.
  • Organization: Maintains structure and accuracy across multiple concurrent workstreams.
  • Attention to detail: Reviews schedules, documentation, deliverables, and communications carefully.
  • Follow-through: Proactively monitors commitments and helps drive actions to completion.
  • Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally with stakeholders at multiple organizational levels.
  • Adaptability: Effectively manages changing priorities, deadlines, and transaction requirements.
  • Collaboration: Builds productive working relationships across cross-functional teams.
  • Problem solving: Recognizes coordination issues and escalates them appropriately.
  • Business acumen: Develops an understanding of the business objectives and operational considerations associated with M&A transactions

Pre-Requisites / Skills / Experience Requirements:

Required:

  • Bachelor degree in Business Administration, Finance, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 8+ years experience in project administration, project coordination, business operations, executive administration, or a related role.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines.
  • Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to follow up proactively and drive administrative action items to closure.
  • Excellent judgment and demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive business information.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint.
  • Ability to work successfully across functions, organizational levels, and geographic locations.

Preferred:


  • Previous experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, integrations, divestitures, corporate development, or other complex cross-functional projects.
  • Familiarity with M&A due diligence and post-acquisition integration processes.
  • Experience working with confidential document repositories or virtual data rooms.
  • Experience coordinating projects involving Finance, Legal, HR, IT, Operations, or other corporate functions.
  • Familiarity with project-management tools and methodologies.
  • CAPM, PMP, or related project-management training or certification is a plus.

raw.description:
At Journal Technologies, we believe our technology can be a force for good in the world ensuring the proper and efficient functioning of some of the most foundational aspects of society - the courts and justice system.

We create and implement enterprise software that supports the administration of justice, currently in the United States, Canada, and Australia. While our eSeries product suite enables governments and their employees to deliver continued foundational court processes, our R&D focuses on leveraging emerging possibilities with technology to improve access and efficiency.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, Journal Technologies is a long-time, wholly-owned subsidiary of Daily Journal Corporation (NASDAQ: DJCO). We also have a major office in Logan, Utah, a team in Melbourne, Australia, an office in Victoria, Canada and a growing number of remote staff across North America.

Under our next generation of leadership, we're implementing a vision for the company that prioritizes building an extraordinary workplace with empowered people at the heart of our business. Great people want to collaborate with great people, and we are actively looking for smart, motivated people who care deeply about the work they do.

Chief Technology Officer

The Chief Technology Officer leads technology strategy, architecture, product development, and engineering across Journal Technologies. This leader sets and champions the technical vision, brings strong product and engineering thinking to every initiative, and ensures the company's platforms remain secure, reliable, and positioned for growth. The CTO works cross-functionally with every department and plays a central role in building out the new technology team described above, helping recruit talent and shape how new ideas are evaluated, developed, and scaled.

What you'll do

  • Develop and lead a multi-year technology vision and roadmap aligned with the long-term goals of Journal Technologies and drive it across the organization.
  • Bring a customer-centric, problem-first approach to product development, ensuring teams deeply understand user needs before committing to solutions.
  • Identify emerging technologies and market opportunities that strengthen existing products and open new areas of value for the company.
  • Advise executive leadership on technology investments, build-versus-buy decisions, and potential acquisitions or partnerships.
  • Define architectural vision and principles, ensuring systems are configurable, repeatable, scalable, secure, appropriately modular, and engineered to upgrade and evolve over time.
  • Apply platform thinking by promoting reusable services, APIs, and shared components that serve multiple products and business units.
  • Own the modernization of the Company's technology portfolio, balancing investment in existing platforms with technical debt, modernization, consolidation, and next-generation capabilities.
  • Lead the engineering organization with a culture grounded in ownership, craftsmanship, continuous improvement, and pragmatic decision-making.
  • Maintain and advance modern engineering practices, balancing speed of delivery with quality, reliability, and security.
  • Support our organization-wide transition to Agile methodologies and Scrum-at-Scale.
  • Serve as a true partner to other departments, building alignment on priorities, timelines, and resources across the organization.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business terms for non-technical stakeholders, and bring business context back to technical teams.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing technology organization, including organizational design, leadership development, succession planning, workforce strategy, and recruitment of critical technical capabilities needed for the Company's future.
  • Ensure appropriate standards for security, privacy, compliance, and data governance, including requirements common to courts, government agencies, and criminal justice systems (such as CJIS).
  • Oversee technology investment, performance, and operational resilience, ensuring resources are aligned with priorities and systems remain reliable, scalable, and prepared for business continuity.
  • Establish effective technology governance and risk management, partnering with Security, Cloud Operations, IT, Legal, and business leaders to manage architectural, cybersecurity, regulatory, and third-party technology risks.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in senior technical leadership roles (CTO, VP of Engineering, Head of Engineering, or similar).
  • Proven experience leading and scaling engineering organizations and enterprise software platforms.
  • Deep expertise in software and systems architecture, including distributed systems, cloud-native design, APIs, and data platforms.
  • Strong product sense, with experience making customer-driven product decisions.
  • A track record of setting a compelling technical vision and rallying teams and executives around it.
  • Proven success working cross-functionally, with excellent communication skills and the ability to engage executives, engineers, customers, and partners alike.
  • Background in government technology, justice or court systems, legal technology, or other regulated public sector markets is highly desirable.
  • Experience incubating new products or working in a startup, innovation lab, or venture environment is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI, machine learning, and data-driven technologies to real products is preferred.
  • Experience working within Agile teams or formal training in Scrum or Agile methodologies
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this job function. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties; additional responsibilities may be assigned.

At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are U.S. (or potentially Canadian) citizens or permanent residents due to employment authorization requirements. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or work authorization support for this position.

Why Journal Technologies?

Visit for more information, but highlights include:

  • Competitive compensation* The salary range posted for this position reflects a good-faith estimate of the base salary we reasonably expect to offer a successful candidate upon hire. Final compensation will be based on job-related factors, including qualifications, experience, geographic location, and internal compensation considerations.
  • Quality medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  • Discretionary profit sharing for eligible employees.
  • Competitive paid time off as well as paid holiday time.
  • 401(k) retirement (US) and GRRSP (CDN) programs.
  • Annual professional development funds – minimum $1,500 USD annual per employee (amount depends on role; however, our goal is to invest in our people).
  • Book subscriptions with an extensive library in each office for personal and professional growth.
  • Travel opportunities between Journal Technology offices and to interesting client locations.

We provide technology that matters in the world, and we're a stable employer comprised of quality people, with a commitment to investing in our people.

Concept Plus is a mission-focused technology solutions provider that transforms IT concepts into impactful solutions for federal agencies. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, paid life insurance, paid time off, 11 paid holidays, performance bonuses, tuition reimbursement, unlimited training, and the opportunity to thrive in a collaborative, flexible, and innovative environment.

raw.excerpt: McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare.
raw.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.


What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.


Job Summary

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for managing complex capital construction projects across McKesson's industrial portfolio. This role serves as the primary project lead from project initiation through occupancy and closeout, overseeing planning, due diligence, budgeting, design, permitting, procurement, construction, commissioning, and turnover activities.


The position partners closely with internal business stakeholders, Real Estate, Facilities, Operations, Security, IT, EHS, Finance, Procurement, and external consultants, architects, engineers, contractors, and suppliers to deliver projects that support business growth, operational efficiency, and workplace objectives. The role is expected to serve as a clear point of coordination for impacted business leaders and cross-functional partners, ensuring stakeholder needs are understood, expectations are managed, risks are communicated early, and decisions are documented and escalated appropriately. The successful candidate will possess strong construction project management experience, financial acumen, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously within a fast-paced environment. Success in this role requires proactive, audience-appropriate communication, disciplined follow-through, and the ability to translate complex project information into concise updates for business partners and leadership.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead capital construction projects from concept through completion, including industrial distribution centers, warehouse expansions, office renovations, and infrastructure improvements.
  • Evaluate greenfield sites for future development including constructability, site development costs, existing infrastructure and entitlements.
  • Develop project scopes, schedules, budgets, cost estimates, and execution strategies aligned with business requirements.
  • Coordinate architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, furniture providers, and specialty vendors throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Manage all aspects of project execution, including design reviews, permitting, procurement, bidding, construction, commissioning, occupancy, and closeout.
  • Monitor project budgets, forecasts, contingencies, and change orders to ensure effective financial stewardship.
  • Identify project risks and implement mitigation strategies to support schedule, budget, quality, and operational objectives.
  • Facilitate project meetings and provide regular status updates to stakeholders and leadership, including concise executive summaries that clearly communicate scope, schedule, budget, risks, decisions needed, and next steps.
  • Develop and maintain stakeholder communication plans that define meeting cadence, reporting expectations, escalation paths, decision owners, and communication needs for business leaders, operational partners, and project teams.
  • Serve as the day-to-day communication lead for assigned projects, ensuring business partners and impacted stakeholders remain informed, consulted, and aligned throughout planning, execution, occupancy, and closeout.
  • Partner with Operations, Facilities, Safety, Security, and business leaders to minimize disruption and ensure project goals are achieved, while proactively identifying adoption, change-management, and communication needs that could impact operational readiness.
  • Review contractor and consultant performance, track deliverables, and ensure compliance with contractual requirements and company standards.
  • Build trusted relationships with business unit leaders, site leadership, functional partners, and external providers by listening to business needs, managing expectations, and resolving concerns in a timely and transparent manner.
  • Ensure projects comply with applicable building codes, safety requirements, regulatory requirements, and McKesson policies.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project management processes, project controls, and supplier performance.

Minimum requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience managing commercial, industrial, distribution, warehouse, manufacturing, healthcare, or large-scale corporate facility projects.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, Real Estate, Facilities Management, or a related field. MBA is preferred but not required.
  • Demonstrated experience leading construction projects from planning and design through occupancy and closeout.
  • Experience managing capital budgets, forecasting, cost controls, and change management processes.
  • Strong understanding of construction delivery methods, contracting strategies, building systems, permitting, and project controls.
  • Experience managing external project management firms, architects, engineers, contractors, and suppliers.
  • Proficiency with project management and construction management systems such as Procore, ACC, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar platforms.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to prepare clear written updates, facilitate alignment across diverse stakeholder groups, and present project risks, tradeoffs, decisions, and recommendations to senior leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence without direct authority, manage competing stakeholder priorities, and maintain transparent communication during high-pressure or time-sensitive project conditions.
  • PMP, CCM, LEED, PE, or equivalent professional credentials preferred but not required.

This position is remote with travel to distribution centers and job sites as needed, on average twice a month.


Compensation will vary by geographic location. Starting pay targeting mid-point of respective range - 140-150k Base plus annual bonus.


We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. raw.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

As a Bilingual (Spanish) Community Guide Case Manager, you will play a vital role in supporting our most vulnerable members, many dual-eligible for Medicare and Medicaid, through their most complex and serious situations, such as housing loss, safety concerns, and suspected abuse or neglect. When these challenges arise, cross-functional teams refer members to us for comprehensive support. As a Case Manager, you will build trusting, ongoing relationships with members and caregivers, create person-centered care plans, and remove barriers until goals are met. Reporting to a Community Guide Supervisor, you will use sound judgment and deep knowledge of community, behavioral health, and benefits resources to help members stay safe and stable, and you will strengthen the whole team by consulting on complex cases and coaching peers. This role is ideal for those dedicated to walking alongside members through their hardest moments as they navigate complex healthcare networks, community initiatives, and support resources.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Manage a caseload of members with complex, ongoing needs, building person-centered care plans with members and caregivers and following through until goals are met.
  • Independently handle serious situations, including members expressing suicidal ideation, chronically unhoused members, housing loss or facility discharge, and suspected abuse, neglect, or exploitation that requires an APS referral, following crisis and safety protocols.
  • Lead emotionally complex conversations with members and caregivers, guiding them toward decisions rather than only sharing information.
  • Remove barriers by connecting members directly to housing, behavioral health, long-term care, community, and benefits resources, and confirm that services were received.
  • Coordinate with providers, teams across the health plan and Devoted Medical, community organizations, and government agencies so members don’t have to repeat their story.
  • Anticipate risks before they become crises, look for root causes of recurring issues, and bring member patterns and proposed solutions to team leadership.
  • Strengthen the team by leading or joining case conferences, consulting on complex cases, and coaching teammates on uncovering members’ underlying needs.
  • Support the team’s core work, including common needs and benefit applications, during high-volume periods.
  • Document thoroughly and track your own caseload outcomes, adjusting your approach before a leader needs to ask.

Required skills and experience:

  • 2+ years of case management, care coordination, or social services experience supporting people with complex needs.
  • Bilingual Proficiency: Professional, native-level oral and written fluency in both English and Spanish is required.
  • Sound judgment in high-risk situations (crisis, safety concerns, suspected abuse or neglect), including knowing when and how to escalate.
  • Strong verbal and written communication: you break down complex information clearly and handle emotionally sensitive conversations with composure.
  • Strong organization to manage an ongoing caseload, competing priorities, and accurate documentation across multiple systems.
  • Resilience and a growth mindset: you seek feedback, stay steady through change, and keep showing up for members when resources are limited, ability to work outside your job description in some instances, including the potential for taking inbound calls.
  • Comfort with technology, including learning new systems and AI-enabled tools quickly.
  • Ability to work an assigned schedule within hours of operation (8:30am–8:00pm Eastern), supporting the Mountain or Pacific time zone if needed.

Desired skills and experience:


  • Degree in social work (BSW, MSW, LSW, LMSW, or LCSW) or a related field preferred but not required; equivalent demonstrated experience is considered.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish or Haitian Creole.
  • Experience working with older adults, Medicare Advantage, or Medicaid programs.

Salary: $64,000 - $69,607 / year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

  • Meet non-financial KPIs (e.g., pre-sales calls, software demos, post-sale follow-ups).

  • Develop and manage customer Statements of Work (SOW) through acceptance.
  • Engage early in sales cycles to assess needs and shape strategy.

raw.title: SVP, Operations
raw.excerpt: At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent.
raw.description:
At LegitScript, we are passionate about making the internet and payment ecosystems safer and more transparent. We help companies of all sizes keep their services legal and safe for consumers. To do this, LegitScript combines big data with the world’s leading team of experts skilled in highly regulated and complex sectors, including transaction laundering detection, pharmaceuticals, online gambling, and more.

The result? Unmatched accuracy and deep risk analysis that identifies which commercial entities play by the rules, and which do not. Our diverse industry partnerships provide unique insights that keep businesses and governments at the forefront of emerging trends. That’s why LegitScript is trusted by the world's largest search engines, internet platforms, payment companies, and regulatory agencies.

Overview:

We are hiring a Senior Vice President of Operations to help us scale how we deliver our solutions far beyond where we are today. This is an executive leadership team role, reporting to the CEO, with ownership of our analyst operations organization and direct accountability for the quality, speed, and cost of the work we deliver to clients. In practice, that means improving our gross margin profile while simultaneously raising the expertise our clients rely on.

We want a leader who has seen what is possible at other organizations, where tools, automation, and AI allowed operations to handle several times the volume without a matching increase in manual effort, and who will bring that experience here. You do not need to come from our industry. A fresh perspective is an advantage. What matters is that you have done this before, at scale, and brought people along.

This is a transformation role, and it has two sides that have to move together. One is using AI and automation to take repetitive, manual work off our analysts' plates, so the operation can handle far more volume without a matching increase in effort. The other is putting AI directly into our analysts' hands, so they can do their best work faster and with greater impact. You will do both while keeping the team motivated, supported, and growing.

Our analysts are the foundation of this business, and their knowledge is what makes any technology we build worth using. You will work alongside them, invest in their skills and growth, and help create new roles that do not exist today.

What You'll Do:

Transform how we work

  • Define and lead a transformation roadmap with ambitious targets for scale: growing volume and capability faster than manual effort.
  • Bring proven playbooks from other organizations, including operating models, architectures, and lessons learned, and adapt them to our business rather than copying them.
  • Work side by side with analysts and managers to map our workflows and decide what to automate, what to augment, and where human expertise is essential.
  • Build and sequence a pipeline of initiatives that balances quick wins with structural change, and run fast experiments to prove what works before scaling it.
  • Partner with Engineering, Data, Product, Research, and Compliance/Security on build-versus-buy decisions, vendor selection, and governance.
  • Design and optimize a global delivery model, effectively balancing onshore and offshore strategies to maximize operational efficiency, scalability, and round-the-clock coverage.

Lead AI and automation responsibly

  • Partner closely with our Engineering and Product leadership to automate manual work wherever it can be automated well, and to build the platform our analysts work in every day.
  • Be technical enough to challenge architecture, evaluate models and vendors, and tell a credible solution from a demo. You do not need to be an engineer, but you need real technical and product instincts.
  • Set quality standards for AI-supported work, including accuracy thresholds, human review, monitoring, and escalation paths.
  • Involve analysts as subject-matter experts in designing, testing, and improving the tools we adopt.

Grow our people

  • Lead the analyst organization day to day, keeping performance, quality, and service strong while the way we work evolves.
  • Be the person who rallies and motivates this team. Set a high bar, make the mission clear, and get people genuinely fired up to do great work for our clients.
  • Coach team leaders to guide their teams through change and to build their own skills in doing so.
  • Get to know our analysts' strengths and aspirations, and create pathways into new and expanded roles, such as AI quality review, process design, training and data stewardship, and specialist or leadership tracks.
  • Partner with the People Team on learning programs, skill-building, and career development so people are prepared for what comes next.
  • Team up with Research and Data Integrity to execute successful process pilots and raise analyst knowledge of regulations and safety
  • Communicate openly and consistently about what is changing, why, and how individuals can shape it.

What You'll Bring:

  • 15+ years of operations experience, including at least 5 years leading large, multi-layer teams at the VP level or above, ideally with P&L accountability.
  • A track record of scaling operations through technology at organizations where tools and automation changed the economics of the work, with measurable results such as volume multiplied, cost per unit reduced, or cycle time cut.
  • A collaborative approach to working cross-functionally.
  • Direct experience deploying AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation in production that changed how work gets done, not only in pilots.
  • The ability to name specific playbooks, architectures, and lessons from those experiences, including what did not work and why.
  • Technical depth to engage credibly with engineers and data scientists: workflow and process architecture, data quality, model evaluation, vendor and platform assessment, and risk controls.
  • Experience leading organizations of several hundred people or more through significant change while keeping trust and engagement high.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and speed: you have made consequential decisions with incomplete information and adjusted quickly.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate clearly with the Board, peers, analysts, and customers.
  • Industry experience is welcome but not required. We value relevant operating and transformation experience over sector familiarity.

Who You Are

  • An inspiring leader. You set a clear mission, raise the energy in the room, and get large teams genuinely motivated to do hard work well.
  • A transformation leader. You have seen what technology can do for an operation at scale, you set bold goals, and you know how to turn them into a sequenced plan that delivers.
  • A coach and champion of people. You develop leaders, give direct and kind feedback, and build teams that grow stronger through change.
  • An empathetic communicator. You are honest about what is changing, early and plainly, and you treat every person as a colleague with a future here.
  • A spotter of potential. You notice the judgment, curiosity, and adaptability in people, and you invest in them deliberately, helping them move into roles where they can grow.
  • A builder who delivers. You are accountable for results, hold a high bar, and are as comfortable in the details of a workflow as in a Board meeting.
  • At your best in a fast-paced environment. You are energized by pace, set clear priorities, and keep your teams steady when plans change.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a regulated or high-accuracy environment where automated output must be auditable.
  • Background in analytics, risk, compliance, or data-intensive review operations.
  • Experience with a build-measure-learn approach to automation, including evaluation frameworks for AI output.
  • A technical degree or hands-on engineering background; an MBA or equivalent is also welcome.

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

With over 10 million sales interactions each year, Humana understands that while great products are important, it’s the quality of our service that truly defines us. We know that when our members and prospects have delightful and memorable experiences, it strengthens their connection with us and enables us to deliver on our purpose of helping people achieve their best health. After all, a health services company that has multiple ways to improve the lives of its customers is uniquely positioned to put those customers at the center of everything it does.

The Strategy Advancement Advisor provides data-based strategic direction to identify and address business issues and opportunities. Provides business intelligence and strategic planning support for business segments or the company at large. The Strategy Advancement Advisor works on problems of diverse scope and complexity ranging from moderate to substantial.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner strategy: Build and carry out growth plans for assigned partners with the Director. Find opportunities such as cross-selling, new products and new ways to reach the partner's customers.
  • Partnership economics: Build and maintain partner valuation models using a common framework. Cover lifetime value, acquisition cost, incremental sales (sales that wouldn't happen without the partner), and fee and renewal costs.
  • Renewals and deal structure: Help shape partnership agreements and renewals by modeling scenarios and recommending terms that create long-term value.
  • Performance tracking: Track partner results against plan, explain gaps and recommend fixes. Work with data and technology teams to improve reporting.
  • New opportunities: Evaluate new partnerships from early sizing and business case through pilot and recommendation.
  • Governance and executive support: Prepare materials for partner business reviews, joint governance meetings and executive discussions. Coordinate Finance, Legal, Compliance and Sales to keep work moving.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 6+ years of experience in strategy, finance, corporate development, partnerships or consulting
  • 2 or more years of project leadership experience
  • Strong financial modeling skills, including business cases, scenario analysis and valuation
  • Ability to turn complex analysis into clear recommendations for senior leaders
  • Ability to influence across teams without direct authority
  • Passion for improving consumer experiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • MBA or related advanced degree
  • Experience managing strategic alliances or channel partnerships, including contract negotiations or renewals
  • Familiarity with Medicare distribution (MA, PDP, Med Supp), agent and broker channels, and CMS marketing and compliance rules
  • Experience with retail, insurance or financial services partners

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$115,200 - $158,400 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 12-03-2026


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

  • Working on projects that may be assigned on an ad hoc basis, and assisting in other internal initiatives as necessary, directed, assigned, or requested

  • Contributing to a supportive team culture where everyone is focused on the overall goals of Managed Services; Adapting their own focuses of time and energy, under the guidance of Managers and Application Advisors, to deliver on most-important priorities

  • Taking on new responsibilities and challenges to continually grow and develop skills to meet the evolving needs of Managed Services and our customers

  • Must demonstrate and embody Nordic’s maxims
  • Ability to apply problem solving skills
  • Excellent communication skills, written and verbal
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office applications
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to organize
  • Must be able to work independently, as well as within a team environment
  • Prior experience with ticketing systems and change management processes
  • Strong customer service track record
  • Knowledge of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) processes, previous management and project management experience, and participation in previous systems implementations, preferred

Additional Details

  • Ability to take on-call rotations outside of core business hours, including nights and weekends

About AllyNd's Client
AllyNd's client is driving SOC transformation with its unique application of AI computing, initially focusing on generative AI-powered proactive threat research, threat analysis, and iterative threat hunting. The products purpose-built language agents respond to new threat actors and attack patterns within minutes, with its agentic workflows delivering end-to-end threat detection and containment from integrated feeds of raw cyber threat advisories. Early users of the product include prominent MSSPs and enterprise SOCs across retail, healthcare, SaaS, and technology verticals. The company is based in Palo Alto, CA, and is venture-funded by The Hive.

Job Description

Client is looking to hire a Principal LLM Application Engineer, where you will focus on leveraging and optimizing Large Language Models (LLMs) along with the implementation of advanced AI technologies. You will be working on cutting-edge projects and will utilize skills in GenAI, LLM, and ML Ops to enhance the customer experience. This role offers a significant opportunity for professional growth at the forefront of AI in the dynamic field of cybersecurity.

Responsibilities

  • Development and Optimization of LLMs: Implement and fine-tune state-of-the-art Large Language Models for various applications, focusing on performance and accuracy.
  • Evaluating Model Performance: Conduct rigorous evaluations of LLMs, assessing effectiveness, efficiency, and business alignment.
  • Integration of Advanced AI Technologies: Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), function calling, and code interpreter technologies to enhance the capabilities of Large Language Models.
  • Research and Development: Stay abreast of the latest advancements in machine learning, particularly in LLMs, LLM agents, and large-scale neural network training.
  • Data and Model Parallel Training: Utilize data and model parallel training techniques for efficient handling of large-scale models.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Leadership: Work with ML engineers, data scientists, and product teams, providing guidance and mentorship.
  • Documentation and Reporting: Maintain detailed documentation of methodologies, models, and results, communicating findings across the organization.
  • Contribute to Product Roadmap and Vision
  • Implement and Evaluate LLM Application Logic (Flows) and Prompting Strategies while staying updated with the latest advancements in the field.
  • Lead the Incubation of New Initiatives, Architect Scalable Solutions, and Drive Strategic Technology Choicesto develop and deliver AI/ML capabilities in a microservices architecture for clients.
  • Design, Test, and Deploy Machine Learning Models, including large-language models, and build pipelines at scale for batch and real-time use cases.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in natural language processing, machine learning, and/or data science.
  • Experience in Python or R.
  • Experience working with large language models, such as GPT-3+, LLAMA, or similar.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think creatively to identify new opportunities for LLMs in products and services.
  • Experience with one or more deep learning frameworks.
  • A deep theoretical or empirical understanding of deep learning.
  • Experience in building, testing, and deploying machine learning models, including large language models.
  • Strong analytical and debugging skills.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based infrastructure and distributed computing.
  • Experience with DevOps/MLOps/LLMOps.
  • Ability to address complex challenges in model training and optimization.
  • Effective communication skills for conveying technical concepts and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
  • Passion for staying updated with the latest trends in AI and machine learning.

Preferred Skills

  • Masters or PhD in Computer Science, AI, or related fields, with a focus on machine learning and natural language processing.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R.
  • Working experience within cybersecurity.
  • Experience in building GenAI solutions using the RAG framework and developing LLM agentic applications.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

You will serve as a senior individual contributor responsible for shaping promotional offers and packages and how they impact long term monetization strategy across cloud-based, AI-enabled, and digital product portfolios.

Operating at a strategic level, this role requires both financial and project management skills to expertise to develop scalable monetization frameworks, guide marketing motions, and influence cross-functional strategy.

You understand the full cycle of how a new to market monetization idea comes to be and how to test if it is fit for long term application. You work cross functionally to create, test, and deploy these ideas. It is important to understand how to measure the success and when to recommend that an idea becomes strategic BAU.

  • Align pricing architecture with customer value, usage, outcomes, product strategy, and long-term growth.

  • Use analytics and cohort modeling to understand the effectiveness of new initiatives.
  • Partner with product, engineering, finance, sales, marketing, and go-to-market teams to translate technical capabilities into viable offers.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert on cloud and AI monetization, advising stakeholders on tradeoffs, risks, and best practices.
