raw.description:
About Draganfly:

Draganfly Inc. (the “Company”) has been a recognized technology leader within the commercial UAV space for over two decades. We helped establish the commercial market & adoption of multi-rotor helicopters for public safety, agriculture, aerial imaging, & more. As a leader who helped shape the industry, Draganfly’s focus is on the sale of drone products and services, contract engineering & custom integration product development, and health monitoring products and services.

Additional information on our expertise, projects, and culture can be found at

About The Role:

The Director, Public Safety Operations leads Draganfly’s Public Safety operations across the United States and Canada, reporting to the Director, UAS Programs. You’ll oversee the US and Canada Program Directors, who manage customer execution within their respective countries, including training, program development, deployment, and sustainment for Drone as a First Responder (DFR) and tactical UAS systems.

You’ll set operational priorities, allocate resources, and hold country teams accountable for delivery and customer outcomes. Working directly with the Public Safety Director of Sales, you’ll align customer commitments with operational capacity and ensure an efficient transition from sales through program delivery and ongoing support.

This is a full-time, remote position requiring frequent domestic and international travel (30–50%) across North America to customer sites, partner engagements, and industry events.

Key Responsibilities:

Leadership & Operational Planning

  • Lead and develop US and Canada Program Directors, setting shared priorities and standards that support local customer and regulatory needs.
  • Plan staffing, budgets, and resources to meet customer commitments and program growth; oversee delivery, training quality, readiness, and budget performance.
  • Develop North American operating plans with Sales and the Public Safety Board of Advisors; review pipeline, capacity, risks, and expansion opportunities.

Program Delivery, Compliance & Training

  • Oversee DFR and tactical UAS programs from onboarding and training through deployment, sustainment, and expansion.
  • Improve delivery standards, SOPs, training curricula, and support processes to strengthen customer adoption and operational readiness.
  • Coordinate personnel, equipment, and support resources; resolve competing priorities and senior-level customer escalations.
  • Work with country teams and Flight Operations to maintain documentation and meet safety, regulatory, and customer requirements.

Sales Alignment, Customer Engagement & Product Feedback

  • Partner with Sales on proposals, scope, schedules, and handoffs, ensuring customer commitments are operationally achievable.
  • Represent Draganfly with strategic customers and partners, providing expertise in DFR, remote operations, and tactical deployments.
  • Turn field insights and customer feedback into delivery and training improvements; route capability gaps and mission needs to Product and follow through on customer communications.
  • Identify partner and support needs with Sales and Product, and guide new programs, service offerings, and geographic expansion.

Who are you really?

  • You’re adaptable and comfortable wearing many hats in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • You’re dependable, with a strong work ethic and the ability to coordinate multiple projects and meet goals within tight timelines.
  • You’re detail-oriented, think critically about challenges, and design efficient, effective solutions.
  • You collaborate with peers and supervisors and plan, organize, schedule, and budget efficiently, focusing on key priorities.
  • You communicate clearly and concisely, set direction, and develop country Program Directors while working effectively with executives, customers, and field teams.

Qualifications:

  • Transport Canada Remote Pilot Certificate or FAA Part 107 equivalent (required).
  • 10+ years in UAS operations, program management, or product application, with a military, public safety, or enterprise background; 5+ years leading people, including managers or senior program leaders.
  • Experience leading distributed teams, managing customer programs, budgets, and resources, and partnering with Sales on achievable commitments.
  • Experience overseeing public safety UAS training, program development, deployment, and sustainment, including DFR and tactical systems.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to develop leaders, translate strategy into operating plans, and drive customer outcomes.
  • Knowledge of Canadian and US public safety UAS integration and compliance requirements, MAVLink-based systems, and emerging UAS technologies.
  • Proficiency with HubSpot, Teams, and SharePoint for sales handoffs and program coordination.
  • Ability to lift and transport UAS equipment up to 55 lbs. and work outdoors in varied weather and austere field environments for short-term testing and demonstrations as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Both Transport Canada Remote Pilot Certificate and FAA Part 107 certification.
  • Senior law enforcement leadership overseeing personnel, budgets, readiness, specialized units, and agency-wide public safety or tactical programs.
  • Experience building and expanding DFR or remote operations programs, including staffing, policies, training, funding, risk management, and performance evaluation.
  • Interagency and community stakeholder engagement, plus public safety technology adoption, procurement, and organizational change experience.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift and transport UAS equipment (up to 55 lbs)
  • Comfortable working outdoors in varied weather conditions
  • Ability to handle austere field environments for testing and demos as required (short-term)
  • Ability to pass background checks required for certain government engagements as required

Compensation Package:

  • Competitive salary: $130,000 – $150,000 USD
  • Health Coverage Reimbursement: We reimburse the cost of your existing or preferred healthcare plan (amount varies depending on family size).
  • 401(k) program with employer matching
  • Generous time-off program, including vacation, wellness days, and the week off between Christmas and New Year’s.
  • Professional development support, including assistance in obtaining or maintaining role-relevant certifications (e.g., FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate, where applicable)

Why Join Us?

At Draganfly Innovations, you’ll join a collaborative team that values innovation, curiosity, and continuous improvement. We’re in an exciting growth phase, scaling our technologies, product lines, and teams as we continue to shape the future of UAV innovation. Joining us now means becoming part of a company with deep roots in the industry - and bold ambitions for what comes next.

You’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, work on diverse and cutting‑edge projects, and grow your skills alongside passionate experts. We offer competitive compensation, strong benefits, and a supportive environment where your contributions truly matter. Here, you won’t just join a company - you’ll help build what comes next.

As part of our hiring process, all candidates must successfully complete reference checks and a criminal background check.

raw.description:
Why Keyrus, Why Now!

A Keyrus é um grupo internacional com 2.800 consultores e especialistas em 28 países, construído sobre uma convicção: a IA não transforma empresas. A inteligência arquitetada transforma.
Há mais de 30 anos, construímos as bases de dados que tornam os sistemas inteligentes possíveis, projetando o Sistema Operacional da Empresa Inteligente, onde a inteligência está incorporada ao núcleo dos processos de negócio para criar valor sustentável: operacionalizamos a inteligência.

A IA não substitui os seres humanos. Ela nos reposiciona em um lugar que nenhum sistema pode alcançar: compreender, decidir, criar e inovar.
Na Keyrus, você não desenvolverá apenas habilidades; desenvolverá discernimento. Sua expertise se fortalece a cada sistema que você projeta, a cada desafio de negócio que ajuda a resolver e a cada implementação que evolui a partir dos aprendizados anteriores.

Com o tempo, você se tornará um dos profissionais mais raros da era da inteligência: alguém capaz de conectar dados, IA e tomada de decisão humana em escala, entre diferentes setores, mercados e geografias.
Esta não é apenas uma posição. É uma disciplina que você domina e uma história que ajuda a escrever para se tornar um Arquiteto da Inteligência da Keyrus.

A tecnologia amplia capacidades. A cultura da Keyrus diferencia. A excelência na execução conecta ambas.

O QUE VOCÊ IRÁ ARQUITETAR

Como Engenheiro(a) de Inteligência Artificial Sênior, você será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de aplicações inteligentes e soluções analíticas avançadas, transformando dados e necessidades de negócio em produtos inovadores que ampliem a capacidade de geração de insights e tomada de decisão.

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar aplicações corporativas de Inteligência Artificial.

  • Construir assistentes inteligentes, copilotos e interfaces conversacionais integrados a dados e sistemas corporativos.

  • Desenvolver agentes de IA capazes de consultar múltiplas fontes de informação, executar ferramentas e apoiar fluxos de trabalho.

  • Integrar diferentes fontes de dados, possibilitando análises contextualizadas de informações estruturadas e não estruturadas.

  • Garantir a escalabilidade, segurança, qualidade e usabilidade das aplicações desenvolvidas.

  • Implementar mecanismos de rastreabilidade das fontes, validação de resultados e redução de respostas incorretas ou não fundamentadas.

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções de ponta a ponta, desde a identificação de oportunidades até a implantação em produção.

  • QUEM VOCÊ É

    Você é uma pessoa com sólida experiência em engenharia de software e Inteligência Artificial Generativa, perfil analítico e visão de negócio. Possui autonomia para desenvolver soluções complexas, conectar diferentes fontes de informação e transformar desafios de negócio em aplicações inteligentes, inovadoras e escaláveis.

    QUEM É VOCÊ

    Experiência e Qualificações

    • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações, APIs e integração entre sistemas.

    • Experiência prática com Inteligência Artificial Generativa, Large Language Models (LLMs) e integração de modelos por meio de APIs.

    • Experiência com SQL e integração de diferentes fontes de dados.

    • Conhecimento de arquitetura de dados e tratamento de informações estruturadas e não estruturadas.

    • Experiência com frameworks de desenvolvimento de aplicações e serviços web.

    • Experiência com Git, testes automatizados, CI/CD e boas práticas de engenharia de software.

    • Experiência com ambientes de nuvem e plataformas de dados, como AWS e Databricks.

    • Experiência em decisões técnicas e arquitetura de soluções de média e alta complexidade.

    • Capacidade de desenvolver soluções completas, desde a concepção até a implantação em produção.

    • Capacidade analítica para compreender indicadores, relações entre dados e problemas de negócio.

    • Inglês avançado.

    Diferenciais:

    • Experiência com frameworks de desenvolvimento e orquestração de agentes de IA, como LangChain, LangGraph ou similares.

    • Conhecimento de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings e bancos de dados vetoriais.

    • Experiência com avaliação, monitoramento e observabilidade de aplicações de IA Generativa.

    • Conhecimento de práticas de LLMOps e MLOps.

    • Experiência com soluções de Intelligent Analytics e interfaces conversacionais para exploração de dados.

    • Conhecimento de práticas de IA responsável, segurança e governança de modelos de IA.

    O QUE FARÁ VOCÊ TER SUCESSO

    • Forte capacidade analítica e pensamento crítico.

    • Visão sistêmica e orientação aos resultados do negócio.

    • Proatividade para identificar oportunidades e propor soluções inovadoras.

    • Autonomia e senso de responsabilidade pelas entregas.

    • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

    • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções práticas.

    • Curiosidade, criatividade e aprendizado contínuo.

    • Foco na geração de valor e na experiência do usuário.

  • NOSSOS VALORES

This is an opportunity to play a leadership role in one of the aviation industry's most important customer-facing businesses. You'll help shape the future of World Fuel's airport and FBO partnerships while leading a talented team focused on growth, innovation, and customer success.

When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel


Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose - moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.

About the Role


We are seeking experienced Statistical Programmers to join our team in Poland or Serbia. As a Statistical Programmer, you will lead and deliver high-quality statistical programming outputs that are essential to the success of clinical development programs across a diverse project portfolio. This position plays a key role in regulatory-compliant data submission, CDISC standards adherence, cross-functional collaboration, and the technical mentorship of programming teams. You will operate within FSP client systems and under FSP client SOPs, working closely with Biometrics, Data Management, Biostatistics, and Medical Writing functions to drive study success from programming strategy through final submission.

Key Responsibilities


  • Lead statistical programming activities on FSP projects, including development and QC of deliverables, ensuring quality, traceability, reproducibility, and timeliness
  • Serve as a technical authority, solving complex programming challenges and setting a standard of exemplary performance for the broader programming team
  • Ensure all statistical programming systems, processes, and deliverables comply with applicable regulatory requirements, including 21 CFR Part 11, eCTD guidance, and CDISC SDTM and ADaM standards
  • Maintain detailed project and validation plans, managing competing priorities across concurrent projects with strong time management and organizational discipline
  • Collaborate efficiently with Biometrics, Data Management, and Medical Writing teams across geographies, including teams in Europe and India
  • Provide input into and mentor statistical programmers on documents produced by cross-functional partners, including biostatisticians, data managers, and medical writers
  • Interact with regulatory agencies, as needed, regarding specifications for electronic submissions and lead the development of statistical programming submission deliverables
  • Contribute to the design of new statistical programming processes or optimization of existing workflows to improve productivity, quality, and client satisfaction
  • Support the professional development of local programming teams through functional mentorship and strategic guidance on deliverables and processes
  • Adhere to and ensure team compliance with all applicable CRS work instructions, SOPs, and client-specific processes
  • Maintain current knowledge of evolving statistical programming techniques and applicable technical advancements and support their implementation
  • Communicate effectively with internal and external clients to manage expectations and ensure overall client satisfaction

Candidate Profile


You will thrive in this role if you bring:


  • Strengths in SAS and/or R programming, CDISC standards expertise, and TLF programming/regulatory submission knowledge
  • Experience working in statistical programming within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or clinical research environments
  • The ability to lead cross-functional teams and communicate clearly across disciplines and geographies
  • A quality-focused mindset with strong attention to detail and accountability for deliverable accuracy
  • Comfort working within FSP models, client systems, and matrix organizations

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor of Science or equivalent with relevant research experience, or Master's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related numerate discipline
  • At least 10 years of experience in biostatistics or statistical programming within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry in clinical development
  • Consistent experience as a lead statistical programmer across multiple concurrent projects
  • Proficiency in SAS and/or R
  • Strong knowledge of CDISC ADaM and SDTM standards
  • Strong TLF programming experience.
  • Strong knowledge of relevant regulatory and data submission guidelines, including 21 CFR Part 11 and eCTD requirements
  • Strong project management skills with demonstrated ability to manage timelines and cross-functional workstreams
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English

Preferred Qualifications


  • Master's degree in Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Experience supporting regulatory agency interactions for electronic submissions
  • Familiarity with process design and optimization in a statistical programming function
  • Experience working in an FSP or embedded client model

If this job doesn’t sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who’d be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!


We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

raw.title: Associate Clinical Trial Manager
raw.excerpt: Character Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company working to preserve vision in people with serious, progressive eye diseases.
raw.description:
Character Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company working to preserve vision in people with serious, progressive eye diseases. Founded in 2018, the company has built the most advanced disease intelligence system for drug development in ophthalmology, starting with dry Age-related Macular Degeneration (AMD). This system fully integrates genomics with longitudinal clinical and imaging data to characterize the pathogenic drivers of disease progression.

Leveraging the insights from its disease intelligence system, Character is advancing two innovative, homegrown programs in Phase 1 studies while continuing to expand its discovery-stage pipeline. The company’s interdisciplinary team spans observational clinical research, data science and AI, drug discovery, clinical development, manufacturing, and commercialization. Character is well capitalized, having raised more than $110 million in Series B financing from leading healthcare and technology investors, and maintains a multi-target drug discovery collaboration with Bausch + Lomb.

Role: Associate Clinical Trial Manager

Reports to: Executive Director, Development Operations

Department: Development Operations

Level: 4

Location: Remote

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, execution-focused Associate Clinical Trial Manager to support the operational delivery of one or more of Character’s Dry AMD clinical trials. Reporting to Aggie Malloy, you’ll own discrete operational workstreams — from site start-up activities to monitoring coordination and vendor support — working closely with the Clinical Trial Manager and broader Development Operations team to keep studies on track. This is a chance to deepen your clinical operations expertise while contributing directly to the trials that will bring new therapies to patients with retinal disease.

You’ll operate with increasing independence as you build subject-matter depth in specific areas of trial execution, while staying closely aligned with the rest of the study team on overall strategy and priorities. This is a remote role reporting to Aggie Malloy (Head of Development Operations).

Responsibilities

Study Execution Support

  • Operational Workstreams: Manage discrete operational components of one or more clinical trials — such as site start-up, monitoring coordination, protocol deviation review process, or vendor support — with increasing independence
  • Study Trackers: Maintain study trackers, timelines, and status reports, flagging risks and delays to the Associate Director, Clinical Operations
  • Vendor & Site Coordination: Support day-to-day coordination with CROs, central labs, imaging vendors, and sites to keep deliverables on track
  • Enrollment Tracking: Track enrollment and monitoring visit completion, escalating issues that may affect study timelines

Compliance, Documentation & Collaboration

  • GCP Compliance: Support study conduct in accordance with GCP, the protocol, and applicable regulations
  • Trial Master File: Maintain trial master file documentation, ensuring completeness and inspection readiness
  • Budget Support: Support invoice reconciliation and payment review
  • Cross-Functional Support: Partner with relevant cross functional stakeholders on day-to-day operational needs

About You

You bring a solid understanding of end-to-end clinical operations and have developed subject-matter depth in one or more specific areas — such as study startup, monitoring coordination, or vendor support. You’re comfortable identifying operational risks and proposing solutions, and you’re ready to take on increasing ownership of your workstreams as you grow in the role.

You are organized, detail-oriented, and a dependable partner to the Clinical Operations and broader study team. About the Team/Role

We are seeking a seasoned Staff Software Engineer in the WEX Mobility Engineering organization. This role will sit in the Mobility team that caters fleet management and mobility payments solutions to our large customers. Mobility development team spans across USA, Brazil, and India. Our Mobility systems provide SaaS and API solutions to various customers. WEX Mobility products enable credit issuance to fleet companies and their workers in the form of WEX or cobranded credit cards, usable at fueling stations and select other merchants. At WEX, we provide fleet managers and operators with fuel discounts, and flexibility to configure spend controls that restrict fleet members to use their cards at configured merchants, for configured amounts and velocity.

In addition, this role will contribute to the design and development of next-generation intelligent systems leveraging agentic AI, enabling automation, decision-making, and scalable orchestration across Mobility platforms.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and high-performance object oriented code in our backend services.
  • Develop public REST APIs using Java and internal gRPC APIs for inter-service and inter-system communication.
  • Craft systems designs, lead design decisions, and drive alignment with other senior engineers.
  • Write automated unit tests, integration tests, end-to-end tests, concurrency tests, load/performance tests.
  • Analyze existing systems to identify bottlenecks, tech debt, and implement scalability, and stability improvements.
  • Implement automation for testing, monitoring, healing, and scaling applications, continuous integration and deployment to reduce time to market.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other engineers, to define and implement new features.
  • Conduct code reviews (comment, approve, seek revisions, merge), mentor junior and mid-level engineers, and actively promote engineering best practices.
  • Dive deep and troubleshoot complex issues, devise fixes, author root cause analysis documents, and ensure lasting performance and reliability.
  • Conduct objective and comparative analyses of competing technologies to advise the team of pros and cons of a technology solution.
  • Maintain robust documentation (design docs, run books, change management docs, and readiness plans).
  • Provide live-site support for production applications by monitoring systems, ensuring rapid incident resolution, and driving continuous improvement.
  • Drive cross-team projects as a single-threaded-owner (STO) or tech lead, and actively unblock other engineers to make progress.

Agentic AI & Intelligent Systems :

  • Design and build agentic AI systems and services, enabling autonomous workflows, reasoning, and task execution within Mobility platforms.
  • Develop AI agents from scratch, including orchestration, tool usage, memory, and multi-step decision-making capabilities.
  • Implement and scale multi-agent architectures to support complex, distributed use cases across payments and fleet ecosystems.
  • Integrate systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar frameworks to enable secure and scalable interaction between AI agents, APIs, and enterprise data sources.
  • Build and optimize LLM-powered services (e.g., OpenAI APIs, LangChain) for production-grade performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Implement evaluation frameworks, observability, and guardrails to ensure correctness, safety, and compliance of AI-driven systems.
  • Design solutions for context management, memory, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to enhance agent effectiveness.

Experience you'll bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering
  • 8-10 years of professional experience in software engineering
  • Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms, object-oriented design, and problem-solving skills
  • Expertise in designing and developing internet-scale services with scalability, availability, security, and reliability design tenets
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and a collaborative and empathetic mindset
  • Proficiency in backend development, with expertise in Java or C#, frameworks like SpringBoot, building and optimizing RESTful APIs, ODATA framework, and SQL

Agentic AI & MCP Experience:

  • Hands-on experience building or contributing to AI/LLM-powered applications or agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with agent frameworks, tool-use patterns, and orchestration of LLM workflows
  • Experience integrating AI systems with external tools/APIs using MCP or similar protocols
  • Understanding of prompt engineering, embeddings, and vector-based retrieval systems
  • Experience designing systems for scaling AI workloads in production environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in computer science or software engineering
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering
  • Experience with Python, Java, event-driven architecture and tools like Kafka
  • Experience working on card payments
  • Familiarity with cloud-native architecture (containerization using tools such as Docker and Kubernetes)
  • Awareness of API security and PCI DSS compliance requirements
  • Ability to work on existing codebase, contribute improvements, and adapt to legacy systems’ constraints

Nice to Have (AI Focus):

  • Experience building production-grade AI agents or copilots
  • Familiarity with multi-agent systems and distributed AI architectures
  • Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch)
  • Knowledge of AI evaluation techniques, safety practices, and responsible AI principles

The base pay range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual pay rates will vary and will be based on various factors, such as your qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. Base pay is one component of WEX's total compensation package. Most sales positions are eligible for commission under the terms of an applicable plan. Non-sales roles are typically eligible for a quarterly or annual bonus based on their role and applicable plan. WEX's comprehensive and market competitive benefits are designed to support your personal and professional well-being. Benefits include health, dental and vision insurances, retirement savings plan, paid time off, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition reimbursement, and more. For more information, check out the "About Us" section.Pay Range: $140,600.00 - $173,100.00

raw.description:
CallRevu is the leading communication intelligence platform built for automotive retail- empowering dealerships to take control of every conversation, from the first ring to the final result.

Our unified solution combines a hosted phone system, call monitoring, performance training, and reputation management- fueled by AI powered analytics that turn every customer interaction into actionable intelligence.

Founded in a dealership in 2008, CallRevu was created by the industry, for the industry. We deliver the tools dealerships need to drive revenue, improve operations, and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

Why This Role

This is a senior individual contributor seat on the team that builds and operates the telephony services powering CallRevu’s hosted phone system and conversational intelligence platform. This is critical, high-throughput infrastructure: when it’s healthy, customers never think about it; when it isn’t, every customer feels it immediately.

We are looking for a senior Python backend engineer with deep telephony experience who is comfortable operating across the SIP stack, Kamailio routing, and Linux production systems. This person will help maintain and modernize our voice stack, improve reliability, and make sound build-vs-buy decisions while owning a critical platform end to end.

Essential Functions

Core Voice Platform Responsibilities (Kamailio SBC + Python call routing)

  • Operate, maintain, and enhance the Kamailio-based SBC.
  • Contribute to the development and operation of the Python/Asterisk call-routing layer that drives call flow, recording, and transcription.
  • Play a key role in complex telephony initiatives across both layers, from design through production, with minimal oversight.
  • Make safe changes to call-flow logic across routing modes and application modules.

Python Backend Engineering

  • Build and maintain high-concurrency Python services and worker processes.
  • Build and harden API integrations across mixed protocols, including REST, and vendor SDKs
  • Integrate with Asterisk via AMI and AGI for call control and event handling.

Signaling, Media, and Voice Quality

  • Diagnose and resolve SIP signaling issues involving registration, routing, NAT, and carrier or endpoint interoperability.
  • Troubleshoot RTP/SRTP, codec negotiation, DTMF, jitter, packet loss, and one-way audio issues.
  • Use tools such as sngrep, Wireshark, tcpdump, and Homer/sipcapture to root-cause incidents quickly.
  • Improve real-time transcription and audio-streaming pipelines.
  • Monitor and improve call-quality metrics such as MOS, ASR, ACD, and PDD.

Reliability, Security, and Operations

  • Operate Linux production systems with confidence
  • Build security hygiene into feature delivery
  • Design for high availability and graceful degradation
  • Participate in a L3 on-call rotation

Modernization and Technical Strategy

A key part of this role is helping modernize the voice stack:

  • Assess what is working, what is fragile, what is expensive to operate, and what is slowing the roadmap.
  • Create a clear plan for refactoring, migration to newer technologies, and practical build-vs-buy decisions.
  • Modernize legacy Python patterns without downtime.

Technical Leadership and Collaboration

  • Maintain a high standard for the telephony codebase through code reviews, design discussions, and the quality of the work delivered.
  • Partner with product, support, and hosted phones teams on capacity planning, customer escalations, and roadmap trade-offs.
  • Communicate technical risk, status, and decisions clearly to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience also qualifies.
  • 6+ years of production Python backend experience, including long-running services and worker processes.
  • Hands-on Asterisk experience with AMI/AGI, dial plans, call origination, and SIP troubleshooting.
  • Production Kamailio experience with routing logic, registrar/proxy behavior, and SBC operations.
  • Deep SIP knowledge, including registration, dialog state, routing, NAT traversal, and transports.
  • Linux production operations experience, including service management, logs, and safe rollout/rollback.
  • Track record operating critical voice or real-time systems in production, including on-call support.

Preferred

  • Experience with NetSapiens or similar hosted phone systems.
  • .NET / C# experience, particularly where voice services interface with the broader CallRevu platform.

Mindset and Operating Style

  • Treats telephony infrastructure with the seriousness it deserves, with a bias toward stability, observability, and reversible change.
  • Calm under fire during voice incidents; structured in root-cause analysis and unwilling to leave the problem half-solved.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; can explain a tricky SIP or queue issue to a non-telephony engineer or to a support lead without losing them.
  • Mentors by example through code reviews, design discussions, and incident reviews.
  • Aligns with CallRevu’s mission, vision, values, and goals, while helping the rest of the team do the same.

raw.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

Reports to the Sr. Director of Program Management. The Account Management team owns Reserv's customer relationships beginning in onboarding: we are the customer's single point of contact, the people who make sure claims service matches what was promised, and the reason customers renew and grow.

This role carries multi-stakeholder customer relationships and resolves the most complex problems in the book. That includes the executive relationship at each customer, the cross-functional work that a single fix won't solve, and coaching that helps the team grow.

You will be an excellent fit if you can sit across from a customer executive without a script, take a complex failure from start to finish without handing it up, and you get as much satisfaction from developing a teammate as from closing out a problem yourself.

We hire owners. You see the whole outcome through, go to the details yourself, and keep a customer's confidence by being candid and keeping your word. You use sound judgment and look past today's fix to what would make the program better.

What you'll do

Executive Relationships: Own the health of complex customer relationships, including the executive relationship at each customer. Speak to the program's performance at an executive level, with or without preparation.

Complex Issue Resolution: Resolve complex and cross-program failures without escalating them. When a defect keeps coming back, route it for prevention so it gets fixed at the root rather than case by case.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Own and run cross-functional workstreams with our claims, operations, finance, and data science teams. Lead onboarding for complex new customers and the customer-facing change management that comes with it.

Forecasting: Own volume and revenue projections for the portfolio you hold, and keep them current. Translate portfolio data into valuable insights for customer executives. Identify growth opportunities, bring them to our commercial team, and support the effort to win them.

Mentorship: Onboard, train, and mentor Account Managers, and lead internal sessions that build the team's knowledge of our customers. Raise the standard of the work across the team, not only in your own book.

Industry Presence: Represent Reserv at internal executive forums and at industry conferences and panels.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in claims, program management, or account management, including ownership of complex customer relationships
  • Command of business reviews, claim reviews, and volume forecasting
  • Executive-level communication, written and live, with polished first-pass work
  • A track record of carrying complex problems to resolution without escalation
  • Deep working knowledge of claims operations: the claim lifecycle and reporting
  • Experience mentoring or training others
  • Data fluent: able to translate data into valuable insights for a customer executive
  • A record of owning outcomes end to end and delivering on your commitments
  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • 100% remote (home-based) role designed to support your work-life balance paired with frequent, regular corporate retreats to build team cohesion, reinforce culture, and have fun
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

Our team partners closely with clients to optimize their Workday environments, offering services such as application management, Workday evolution and expansions (Phase X implementations), follow-on solutions, analytics, and continuously enhance the user experience.

Position Summary:


As a Sr. Workday Student Consultant, you will be responsible for ensuring the successful delivery of Workday Student implementations for our higher education customers. In addition, this role will contribute to the development of ERPA’s Workday Student practice and should showcase innovation, strategic thinking and have the drive to make ERPA a Workday Student partner of choice.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Act as a lead consultant on multiple Workday Student implementations with limited direction
  • Execute the day-to-day implementation activities for clients including process design, demonstrate configurations through the development of prototype systems, package implementation lifecycle support, conversion, testing, and project reviews with customer(s)
  • Work with customers to help convert legacy data into Workday
  • Assist the integration consulting team in configuring and testing integrations between the system and other third-party or custom solutions
  • Collaborate effectively with extended team members which include functional and technical resources
  • Ensure customers understand and adopt best practices
  • Partner with project managers to ensure alignment across project plans and allocated budgets
  • Strive to suggest new approaches and tools to deploy the program efficiently and effectively to ERPA as we build our team to become an exceptional leader in the industry

Experience Requirements:


  • Workday Student Recruiting & Admissions certification is required and must remain in Active status throughout employment with ERPA
  • At least two years of experience implementing Student Recruiting and Admissions for Workday Student is required.
  • Functional consulting experience on end-to-end Workday Student implementations is required. Experience leading Workday Student implementations is preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills are required. Must be able to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills are required, along with a proactive approach and detailed understanding of Workday Student Recruiting and Admissions processes and best practices, to make appropriate implementation recommendations.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently as well as in a team environment, coupled with a desire to have fun while building something new (required)

Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job.

insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com.

Job Description:

As a Senior Solution Architect you will be the senior technical and design authority, for Lineos Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) programmes in the UK, reporting into the Global VP of Professional Services, Lineos (FP&CC) You will design, govern and assure end-to-end Lineos solutions that span Financial Planning, Consolidation & Close, Disclosure Management, Account Reconciliation & Tax, that integrate cleanly with the customer's ERP and data landscape.


You are accountable for the integrity of multi-module, multi-entity programmes, you oversee Architects and Lineos consultants across concurrent engagements, and you advise finance leaders on how Lineos supports their wider finance transformation.


Key responsibilities
Lineos EPM solution architecture

  • Define and govern end-to-end Lineos EPM architectures across the Lineos modules: Financial Planning, Close & Consolidate, Disclosure Management, Account Reconciliation and Tax.
  • Design multi-entity, multi-currency and multi-GAAP models, including intercompany, eliminations, ownership and allocations.
  • Set standardised finance data models, chart-of-accounts and dimension strategies, and integration reference architectures for ERP sources (e.g. SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Sage, NetSuite).
  • Lead complex, multi-module and multi-region Lineos deployments, including migrations from legacy EPM and spreadsheet-based processes.

Design authority and delivery governance

  • Chair the Lineos Design Authority for EMEA programmes; run design reviews and sign off solution blueprints.
  • Lead Architects and Lineos consultants as a matrix lead across concurrent projects and programmes, and own solution quality at programme level.
  • Spot systemic delivery risks early and build mitigations into Lineos delivery methods and standards.
  • Contribute to SteerCo and Design Council governance for strategic customers.

Customer advisory and commercial support

  • Act as trusted advisor to CFOs, Financial Controllers, FP&A leaders and CIOs on EPM strategy, close acceleration and FP&A modernisation.
  • Shape complex Lineos deal architecture with Sales and Solutions Engineering: scope, integration risk, effort, pricing approach and success criteria.
  • Turn customer and delivery insight into product roadmap recommendations for Lineos Product Management.

Capability building

  • Mentor and develop Architects and Principal Consultants in the UK and EMEA Lineos practice.
  • Build Lineos accelerators, reference models, integration playbooks and migration toolkits that shorten time-to-value.
  • Define Lineos skills matrices and certification pathways, and lead communities of practice and architecture review forums.

Skills and experience

  • Proven experience working in either EPM/CPM consulting, professional services or enterprise finance solution delivery.
  • A track record of designing and governing multi-module EPM programmes (planning, consolidation and close, disclosure, reconciliation and tax) at enterprise scale.
  • Experience overseeing several delivery teams or engagements at once, ideally in a Design Authority or lead architect role.
  • Hands-on Lineos experience is strongly preferred; deep expertise in comparable EPM platforms (e.g. Oracle EPM/Hyperion, OneStream, Anaplan, SAP BPC/Group Reporting, CCH Tagetik) will be considered.

EPM and finance knowledge

  • Expert understanding of the record-to-report and plan-to-perform processes: budgeting, rolling forecasts, driver-based and workforce planning, statutory and management consolidation, close, account reconciliation, tax provisioning and disclosure reporting.
  • Working knowledge of UK GAAP and IFRS reporting, intercompany, currency translation and minority interests.
  • Awareness of regulatory and market trends affecting UK finance teams, such as ESG/CSRD reporting and Making Tax Digital, and how they shape EPM design.

Technical skills

  • Finance data architecture: dimensional modelling, metadata and hierarchy management, data lineage and authoritative-source strategy.
  • ERP and data integration: APIs, ETL/ELT, SQL, and cloud data platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS, Snowflake).
  • Non-functional design: performance and scalability, high availability and disaster recovery, observability.
  • Security and compliance by design: segregation of duties, audit trails, data retention, identity and access management, and GDPR / UK data protection.

Education and certifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or equivalent.
  • A CIMA, ACCA or ACA qualification is a strong plus.
  • Architecture certifications (e.g. TOGAF) and cloud certifications strongly preferred.
  • Lineos product certifications expected, or completed within the first 6 months.

What success looks like

  • Suite-wide authority: recognised as the go-to expert across all Lineos EPM modules and how they fit together, not one module alone.
  • Sound designs, first time: Lineos programmes pass design review, go live on plan and scale without rework.
  • Trusted by finance leaders: CFOs and Financial Controllers seek your advice on their EPM roadmap.
  • Commercial impact: deals you shape are scoped realistically and delivered profitably.
  • Stronger practice: UK Lineos consultants grow through your mentoring, and your accelerators are reused across projects.
  • Calm under pressure: you anticipate risk, communicate clearly at executive level and keep complex programmes on track.

Trusts Manager.

Salary: £43,100 per annum pro rata.

Location: Remote (with occasional travel to London office).

Contract: Fixed Term Contract until end of December 2027, 35 hours per week.

Benefits:   

  • Over 7 weeks inclusive paid leave pro rata and the option to buy or sell leave.

  • 1 well-being day per year.

  • Cycle to work scheme.

  • Excellent training and the opportunity to undertake professional training for some roles.

  • Flexible maternity, paternity and adoption packages.

  • Up to 7% employer pension contribution and life assurance cover.

Why Action for Children?  

Every child should have a loving home, food, warmth, the chance to grow and learn - the support to cope with life’s challenges. But too many children don’t. By bringing your passion and unique skills and experience, you’ll help us change that where it really matters.

We've been driven by love to take action for children for over 150 years, giving them the protection and practical help they need. A lot’s changed since 1869. But what children really need, hasn’t. So as long as children need us, we’ll be here.

Will you join us?

A bit about the role 

Action for Children aims to deliver substantial growth from our high value audience over the next five years, you will work through the management of the Trusts team to implement the Trusts element of the wider Philanthropy & Trusts strategy through clear team plans, priorities and to oversee a healthy pipeline, while managing a portfolio of significant, complex and multi-year funding partnerships.

How you'll help to create brighter futures 

  • Work collaboratively to deliver the Trusts team’s annual target with a focus on securing significant grants and multi-year partnerships from charitable trusts and foundations and statutory funders.

  • Line managing and developing the team.

  • Overseeing the development and prioritisation of the team’s funding pipeline.

  • Overall responsibility for developing high-quality, compelling proposals, reports and stewardship materials from the Trusts team.

  • Managing a personal portfolio of significant and complex funding partnerships, building relationships with senior funder contacts.

  • Team planning and performance reporting, monitoring income, pledges and pipeline activity.

  • Ensure systems and processes are in place for effective grant management and stewardship across the team.

Let's talk about you 

  • Demonstrable experience of trusts and foundations fundraising with an excellent track record of initiating new relationships and securing significant gifts and developing multi-year funding partnerships.

  • Demonstrable ability to lead, inspire and line manage a team of fundraisers

  • Experience of identifying and prioritising funding prospects and overseeing a complex pipeline.

  • Experience of developing relationships with senior decision makers at trusts and foundations and statutory funders.

  • Demonstrable organisational, financial and analytical skills.

  • Experience of using and interrogating relational databases, ideally Raiser’s Edge

  • Demonstrable understanding of trusts fundraising best practice, the Code of Fundraising Practice, data protection requirements and the responsible handling of confidential information.

It's an exciting time to join the Trusts team at Action for Children, and we are looking for collaborative, energised and forward-thinking individuals to join our ambitious team.

Please see the Job Description for the full list of accountabilities and requirements.  

Our Commitment to Equity, Inclusion and Anti-Racism

At Action for Children, we are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and able to thrive. We know that racism and discrimination create barriers, and we are taking active steps to challenge these inequalities in our organisation and in the communities we serve. 

We strongly welcome applications from people who are Black, Asian, or from other racialised and ethnically marginalised communities, as well as disabled people, who are currently under-represented in our workforce. We are committed to removing barriers in our recruitment processes and ensuring fair access to opportunities. 

Want to know more about Action for Children? 

Find us on  Linkedin, Facebook or YouTube to get to know us better.

Interviews will be week commencing 14th December by MS Teams.

raw.description:
iLogos Game Studios provides solutions for mobile game developers no matter how challenging the project or task is. We’ve been around since 2006 and in that time frame, we have successfully completed 400+ projects and have become a partner of choice for EA, Sony, Disney, Rovio, Ubisoft, and many other companies.

We're looking for a talented Game UI/UX Artist to join iLogos Game Studios and create engaging, colorful, and intuitive interfaces for an exciting mobile F2P endless runner!

We're especially interested in artists who combine strong game UI/UX design skills, creative visual thinking, and hands-on AI-assisted workflows to deliver polished, production-ready interfaces.

About the Project

We're developing a mobile F2P endless runner in Unity for iOS and Android, inspired by the fast-paced gameplay of Subway Surfers, but with a fresh visual identity.

Our game features expressive anthropomorphic animal characters traveling around the world through vibrant, stylized urban environments.

The visual direction combines high-quality cartoon 3D, playful character design, bold colors, and street culture aesthetics.

Players will explore three unique locations, while unlocking characters, customizing hoverboards, collecting rewards, and completing daily challenges.

Our goal is to create a visually distinctive, engaging mobile experience with intuitive navigation and appealing F2P progression systems.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game UI/UX design for mobile F2P games.

  • Strong portfolio featuring stylized game interfaces, preferably from casual or midcore mobile projects.

  • Experience creating visually appealing cartoon-style UI art, including icons, panels, buttons, and in-game interface elements.

  • Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Photoshop.

  • Practical experience designing F2P monetization interfaces, including stores, offers, bundles, currencies, and reward systems.

  • Strong understanding of mobile UX principles, user flows, visual hierarchy, and responsive layouts.

  • Experience preparing and handing off UI assets for Unity integration, including slicing, anchors, safe areas, and different screen resolutions.

  • Strong hands-on experience with generative AI tools for UI art, icons, and visual asset creation.

  • Ability to demonstrate independently developed or customized AI-assisted workflows, including style consistency, paint-over, manual refinement, and production-ready results.

  • Ability to collaborate efficiently with artists, designers, and developers in a production environment.

Nice to have:

  • Experience creating UI animations, transitions, and interactive effects.

  • Previous experience with endless runners or successful casual mobile games.

  • Hands-on experience implementing UI directly in Unity.

  • Experience designing character customization or cosmetic selection interfaces.

  • Familiarity with mobile F2P engagement and retention mechanics.

What the role is about:

  • Design and create engaging game UI/UX for a mobile F2P endless runner, including:

    • Main menus and navigation: home screen, settings, and game modes.

    • Character customization: character and hoverboard selection screens.

    • Monetization UI: in-game store, special offers, bundles, chests, and rewards.

    • Player engagement systems: daily missions, leaderboards, progression, and reward screens.

    • Gameplay UI: in-run HUD, power-up indicators, and results screens.

  • Create high-quality stylized cartoon UI art, including icons, buttons, panels, and decorative elements.

  • Develop intuitive UX flows, wireframes, and responsive layouts for different mobile screen sizes and aspect ratios.

  • Maintain visual consistency with the game's vibrant, street-culture-inspired art direction.

  • Ensure excellent readability, usability, and visual hierarchy across gameplay and menu interfaces.

  • Prepare production-ready UI assets, including slicing, exports, and organized handoff for Unity integration.

  • Collaborate closely with the Art Lead, Game Designers, and Developers to refine UI functionality and visual quality.

  • Apply AI-assisted workflows to accelerate UI art creation, icon production, visual exploration, and asset variations.

  • Contribute to the development and improvement of the studio's AI art production pipelines.

Working conditions:

Our people are what we value the most at iLogos. We treat everyone with respect no matter where you are from or what you believe in. If you share our values which are Mastery, Maturity, Trust & Care, and Positive Mindset – we are a perfect match for each other! Join #ilogos_team and we guarantee you an opportunity for growth, support, and an atmosphere of trust and care that feels more like a family. And as well:

  • Work remotely from anywhere in the world;

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Workload: Full-time with transitioning to part-time.

  • Opportunity to shape the UI/UX of a colorful, character-driven mobile game.

  • Collaborative production environment with a strong focus on AI-enhanced game art workflows.

  • Opportunity to contribute to the development of the studio's AI-assisted art production processes.

raw.excerpt: Job Description This is a remote position.  Contract Type: Permanent, Full-time Stage: Post-Seed / Early Scale-up Location: Remote Working Hours: UK Hours About the Role The client is a sustainable technology company transforming propulsion across Air, Sea, and Sport.
raw.description:
Job Description

This is a remote position.

Contract Type: Permanent, Full-time
Stage: Post-Seed / Early Scale-up
Location: Remote
Working Hours: UK Hours

About the Role
The client is a sustainable technology company transforming propulsion across Air, Sea, and Sport. With a protected IP portfolio of over 30 patents, they have already launched a UK D2C brand in the Sport sector and are in the process of globalising D2C sales.

They are now seeking their first in-house finance hire. This individual will be a strategic partner to the CEO & Finance Director, and will be responsible for building a global, world-class finance function from the ground up to support our trajectory toward the projected revenue target by 2030.

What will make you a great fit for this role?
We are looking for a commercially minded Finance Manager who is excited by the opportunity to take ownership of the day-to-day finance function within a growing, ambitious international business.

This is a hands-on role with plenty of scope to make an impact. You'll be responsible for managing the core finance function, including accounting, reporting, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow, while also helping to improve and automate processes as the business scales.

You'll work closely with an experienced Finance Director, who will provide strategic and board-level guidance, giving you the opportunity to take real ownership of the finance function while developing your experience across a broader commercial and strategic remit.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who has built a strong foundation in finance and is ready to take the next step in their career – gaining greater ownership, commercial exposure and experience within a fast-growing international business.

And this isn't just a finance role. You'll be joining a company making a genuine environmental impact – from reducing underwater noise for marine life to making aviation quieter and paddle sports more accessible.

What you'll do

Own the Day-to-Day Finance Function

  • Take ownership of the day-to-day finance function, including AP, AR, payroll, reconciliations and month-end processes.
  • Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting and maintain strong financial controls.
  • Manage relationships with external accountants, tax advisers and other finance providers where required.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow

  • Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process.
  • Prepare regular cash flow forecasts and monitor working capital.
  • Provide financial insight to help the leadership team understand performance, risks and opportunities.
  • Build financial models and "what-if" scenarios to support commercial and investment decisions.

Finance Transformation & Process Improvement

  • Help transition the finance function from its current outsourced model towards a more efficient and scalable internal function.
  • Identify opportunities to improve, automate and streamline finance processes as transaction volumes increase.
  • Support the implementation and optimisation of finance systems, including the future move to a scalable ERP.
  • Improve the integration between e-commerce, inventory, manufacturing and finance systems.

International Growth

  • Support the financial management of the company's international operations and multi-entity structure.
  • Assist with consolidation, foreign exchange and international tax compliance across the UK, US, EU and Japan.
  • Support the implementation of automated tax solutions for North American sales.

Business Partnering

  • Work closely with the founders and leadership team, providing commercially focused financial insight and guidance.
  • Partner with the company's Technology and Product teams, helping them understand the financial implications of projects and investments without stifling innovation.
  • Support the Finance Director with board reporting, strategic planning and financial governance.

Support Business Growth

  • Provide financial analysis to support new products, markets and investment decisions.
  • Support funding rounds and the preparation of financial information and investment materials.
  • Help establish the financial processes, controls and reporting needed to support the company's transition from a lean startup to an international scale-up.

Requirements

  • Qualified or nearly qualified: ACA, ACCA or CIMA, with relevant post-qualification experience preferred.
  • Commercial finance experience: Experience within a product-based SME, scale-up or similarly fast-paced environment.
  • Strong accounting foundation: Confident managing the day-to-day finance function, month-end, reporting, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow.
  • International exposure: Experience working with multiple entities, currencies and/or international operations would be highly beneficial.
  • Technical capability: Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls and audit requirements.
  • Systems & automation: Comfortable working with finance systems, e-commerce platforms and technology, with an interest in improving and automating finance processes.
  • Analytical mindset: Able to turn financial data into clear commercial insight and support decision-making.
  • Remote Work: Fully set up to work remotely and within UK business hours.

Personal Attributes

  • The "Builder" Mindset: You enjoy taking ownership, improving things and building processes rather than simply maintaining the status quo.
  • Commercially Focused: You understand that finance should support the business and enable growth, not just report on what has already happened.
  • Hands-On: You're happy getting into the detail when needed, while also being able to step back and look at the bigger picture.
  • Growth Mindset: You're looking for an opportunity to broaden your experience and take on increasing responsibility as the company grows.
  • Stakeholder Savvy: You're confident working with founders, senior leaders, technical teams and external advisers.
  • Collaborative: You'll work closely with an experienced Finance Director who will provide strategic guidance, while giving you significant ownership of the day-to-day finance function.

raw.description:
Grip op contracten, oog voor verbetering

Zorg jij graag dat afspraken kloppen, informatie op orde is en processen steeds slimmer worden ingericht? Als contractbeheerder onderhoudscontracten bij Woonzorg Nederland combineer je jouw analytische blik met een belangrijke rol in het beheer en de verbetering van onze vastgoedcontracten.

Jij maakt het verschil doordat je...

  • zorgt dat onze onderhoudscontracten en contractinformatie goed beheerd zijn en het contractbeheersysteem actueel en betrouwbaar blijft.

  • afwijkingen, prestaties en financiële informatie analyseert en vertaalt naar heldere adviezen en verbetervoorstellen.

  • actief meedenkt over betere processen en systemen en daarmee bijdraagt aan de verdere professionalisering van ons contractbeheer.

Jouw impact als contractbeheerder onderhoudscontracten

Goed onderhoud van ons vastgoed begint bij duidelijke afspraken en contracten die op orde zijn. Als contractbeheerder zorg jij ervoor dat onze onderhoudscontracten goed zijn ingericht en beheerd. Je analyseert lopende contracten, onderzoekt afwijkingen en adviseert over de gevolgen daarvan. Ook beoordeel je operationele en financiële contractinformatie en zorg je dat het contractbeheersysteem actueel en betrouwbaar blijft.

Je kijkt verder dan de dagelijkse administratie. Je toetst zelfstandig KPI’s, analyseert resultaten en levert managementinformatie aan. Zie je dat iets beter of slimmer kan? Dan kom je met verbetervoorstellen voor bestaande processen, systemen en werkwijzen. Ook beoordeel je offertes, pas je opdrachten aan, controleer je facturen en houd je de administratie bij.

Je bent bovendien een vraagbaak voor collega’s en begeleidt waar nodig externe deskundigen en medewerkers bij de uitvoering van hun werk. Je denkt mee over de samenwerking met bewonersconsulenten, technisch managers en hoofdaannemers. En als het nodig is, ondersteun en vervang je de contractmanager. Zo zorg je samen met je collega’s voor grip op de contractportefeuille en een professionele samenwerking met onze aannemers.

Wat maakt deze functie extra mooi?

  • Je hebt zichtbare invloed op de kwaliteit. Met jouw analyses en verbetervoorstellen help je contracten, informatie en processen steeds verder te verbeteren.

  • Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Je signaleert kansen, denkt mee over vernieuwing en helpt verbeteringen daadwerkelijk realiseren.

  • Je werkt met veel verschillende collega's en partners. Je verbindt informatie, afspraken en mensen en bent een belangrijke inhoudelijke gesprekspartner.

.

Wat je verder krijgt
Uiteraard krijg je daar ook veel voor terug. Zoals de ruimte om zelf mee te denken en te experimenteren met nieuwe werkwijzen. Persoonlijke aandacht, tijdens je inwerkperiode én daarna. En ruime mogelijkheden – inclusief scholingsbudget – voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, ook buiten de gebaande paden. Er is oog voor jouw werkgeluk en een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Want als je werkt met plezier, kun je meer betekenen voor een ander. Daarnaast bieden we je:

  • Een brutomaandsalaris tussen € 3.631,- en € 4.563,- bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur. Deze functie valt binnen schaal G van de cao Woondiensten.

  • De mogelijkheid om (bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur) 4 x 9 uur per week te werken.

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een contract voor onbepaalde tijd

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling.

  • Kilometervergoeding voor je woon-werkverkeer of afspraken. Daarnaast krijg je een mobiliteitspas voor alle vormen van openbaar vervoer.

  • Een thuiswerkvergoeding, faciliteiten om een fijn thuiskantoor in te richten én de vrijheid om in overleg zelf te bepalen waar en wanneer je werkt.

  • Een mooi opleidingsbudget van € 900,- per jaar (gebaseerd op een fulltime dienstverband) en volop mogelijkheden om opleidingen en trainingen te volgen.

  • Een laptop en een nieuw model telefoon.

  • 189,8 vakantie-uren bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur.

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw werkgeluk en een goede balans tussen werk, privé en vitaliteit. Want als je werkt met plezier, kun je meer betekenen voor een ander.

  • Een sport-en-beweegvergoeding van € 128,­- netto per jaar en elke twee jaar een Health Check (preventief medisch onderzoek).

En dat is nog niet alles. In december kies je zelf van welke extra voorwaarden je het volgende jaar gebruik wilt maken. Denk aan extra verlofuren. 

Lees op meer over werken bij onze organisatie >>

Een warm team waarin je wordt gezien en gehoord

Je werkt samen met de teamleider contractmanager DO/Manager onderhoud en realisatie en de collega's binnen het team. In je functie heb je daarnaast contact met onder anderen contractmanagers, technisch managers, bewonersconsulenten en hoofdaannemers.

Requirements

Zo vul jij ons aan

Je bent iemand die graag structuur aanbrengt en zorgvuldig werkt. Je houdt overzicht, duikt graag in informatie en vindt het belangrijk dat afspraken en gegevens kloppen. Tegelijkertijd kijk je kritisch naar bestaande werkwijzen en zie je waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, werkt zelfstandig en zoekt actief de samenwerking op. Collega's kunnen op je rekenen: je communiceert helder, denkt mee en zorgt voor een goede terugkoppeling.

Verder heb je:

  • Mbo+-werk- en -denkniveau.

  • Kennis van en ervaring met bouw- en installatiecontracten en het beheren van contracten.

  • Kennis van huurrecht.

Zet jouw kennis in voor goed vastgoedbeheer

Past deze functie bij jou? Upload dan uiterlijk 13 december 2026 je motivatie en cv. Wil je eerst meer weten over de functie? Bel of app dan even met Saiida Bosse, Manager Programmering & Evaluatie 06-57410058

raw.title: Security Engineer
raw.excerpt: About Athennian Athennian delivers Governance Ops™ software that aligns legal, finance, tax and fund teams through a secure, integrated source of truth for entity and ownership data.
raw.description:
About Athennian

Athennian delivers Governance Ops™ software that aligns legal, finance, tax and fund teams through a secure, integrated source of truth for entity and ownership data. The platform enables organizations managing complex corporate and investment structures to automate governance workflows, maintain audit-ready records and collaborate across functions with confidence.

More than 500,000 entities across over 150 countries are managed on Athennian, helping organizations modernize entity management and transform governance operations into a strategic advantage.

We are a fast-moving, solutions-driven team using an AI-forward approach to solve complex operational challenges. If you are passionate about building technology that transforms traditional industries, we’d love to have you join us.

About the role

With the rapid evolution of AI-driven cyberattacks and sophisticated threat vectors, traditional, reactive vulnerability management is no longer sufficient. We are looking for a hands-on Security Engineer who can proactively identify security gaps, investigate emerging threats, build advanced defenses, and continuously improve Athennian's security posture in line with global enterprise security standards.

In this role, you will partner closely with Information Security, Engineering, Product, and DevOps to embed security by design into how we build, scale, and operate our platform. We are looking for a naturally curious builder who thrives on technical challenges, experiments with emerging technology, and takes end-to-end ownership from vulnerability identification to technical remediation.

What you'll do

  • Proactive Threat Hunting: Conduct advanced threat analysis, continuous posture assessments, and offensive evaluations across our multi-tenant cloud environment to uncover security gaps.
  • Security Architecture & Solution Engineering: Partner with product managers, software architects and engineering teams during the design phase to build and implement scalable, automated security controls with secure coding, and zero-trust principles.
  • AI & Advanced Threat Defense:Research, model, and mitigate emerging AI-accelerated attack vectors, API abuse patterns, and cloud-native infrastructure risks leveraging frameworks such as OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, and MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud.
  • Security Posture Optimization: Continuously tune security telemetry, automated testing pipelines (SAST/DAST/SCA), and detection engineering systems to maximize signal-to-noise ratio and drive continuous cyber defensive improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Security Enablement:Champion a culture of security excellence by coaching engineers, establishing lightweight security playbooks, and bridging the gap between product velocity and high-compliance rigor.
  • Threat Intelligence Integration: Collect, analyze, and disseminate actionable threat intelligence from diverse sources (e.g., vendor updates, public databases, industry advisories) to proactively identify emerging attack vectors and mitigate potential security risks.
  • Vulnerability Triage, Remediation: Triage, prioritize, and remediate security findings by writing or fixing production code directly to close vulnerabilities with defined SLAs.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in application security, product security, or security engineering within a fast-paced software development environment.
  • Code-Level Remediation: Strong software engineering fundamentals with the ability to read, write, and debug production code (e.g., GraphQL, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript/Node.js) to fix vulnerabilities directly rather than just handing off tickets.
  • Vulnerability Management: Proven track record triaging and resolving findings from automated security testing tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning) and managing high-volume alert pipelines.
  • Threat Modeling & Architecture:Demonstrated expertise in conducting threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE) and security architecture reviews across distributed, multi-tenant cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Modern Threat Landscape:Deep understanding of contemporary attack vectors, API security vulnerabilities, cloud-native risks, and secure software development lifecycles (SDLC).
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with product managers and developers, translating complex security risks into practical business and engineering tradeoffs.

Nice to Haves

  • Industry Experience: Prior background navigating high-risk, regulated environments that manage sensitive personal information, particularly within legal tech, fintech, healthcare, or banking.
  • Certifications such as:
    • OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
    • Any AI Security or AI Red-Teaming certifications
    • Relevant Web Application Penetration Tester or Secure Software Programmer certifications
    • AWS Certified Security - Specialty

Location

We have embraced a distributed model of working to reach the best talent in the world. While some roles may require proximity to our Toronto, Calgary and Vancouver offices, roles based outside our office locations can be remote in Canada. Please only apply if you are able to live and work full-time in Canada.

Our Culture

We thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where every team member plays a critical role in our success. We value ambitious, results-driven people who spot opportunities, take initiative and go the extra mile. Collaboration fuels our growth as we take on new challenges, learn constantly and move quickly. If you're a go-getter who thrives on impact, you'll fit right in. Our values are:

  • Outcome Driven: We focus on setting ambitious goals and achieving measurable results, valuing success by the outcomes we deliver.
  • Wide Responsibility: Our team is empowered to shape success, taking ownership from problem identification to solution implementation.
  • Learning Mindset: We embrace curiosity, rejecting the status quo and encouraging continuous learning and agility.
  • Strategic Speed: We make fast, effective decisions and embrace a bias for action to seize opportunities quickly.

Benefits at Athennian

We keep things simple and invest in the perks that matter — your wellbeing, growth and flexibility.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, equity and performance-based bonus structure.
  • Work-Life Balance: A minimum of 3 weeks vacation, 5 sick days and 6 personal/flex days, plus a company-wide winter holiday shutdown.
  • Comprehensive Coverage: Health, dental, vision, long-term disability and a Health Spending Account (HSA).
  • Family Support: Flexible parental leave, including top-ups.
  • Remote Setup: A work-from-home allowance to get you set up for success.
