raw.description:
Trusts Manager.

Salary: £43,100 per annum pro rata.

Location: Remote (with occasional travel to London office).

Contract: Fixed Term Contract until end of December 2027, 35 hours per week.

Benefits:   

  • Over 7 weeks inclusive paid leave pro rata and the option to buy or sell leave.

  • 1 well-being day per year.

  • Cycle to work scheme.

  • Excellent training and the opportunity to undertake professional training for some roles.

  • Flexible maternity, paternity and adoption packages.

  • Up to 7% employer pension contribution and life assurance cover.

  • Blue Light Card eligibility with discounts at 15,000 national retailers.

Why Action for Children?  

Every child should have a loving home, food, warmth, the chance to grow and learn - the support to cope with life’s challenges. But too many children don’t. By bringing your passion and unique skills and experience, you’ll help us change that where it really matters.

We've been driven by love to take action for children for over 150 years, giving them the protection and practical help they need. A lot’s changed since 1869. But what children really need, hasn’t. So as long as children need us, we’ll be here.

Will you join us?

A bit about the role 

Action for Children aims to deliver substantial growth from our high value audience over the next five years, you will work through the management of the Trusts team to implement the Trusts element of the wider Philanthropy & Trusts strategy through clear team plans, priorities and to oversee a healthy pipeline, while managing a portfolio of significant, complex and multi-year funding partnerships.

How you'll help to create brighter futures 

  • Work collaboratively to deliver the Trusts team’s annual target with a focus on securing significant grants and multi-year partnerships from charitable trusts and foundations and statutory funders.

  • Line managing and developing the team.

  • Overseeing the development and prioritisation of the team’s funding pipeline.

  • Overall responsibility for developing high-quality, compelling proposals, reports and stewardship materials from the Trusts team.

  • Managing a personal portfolio of significant and complex funding partnerships, building relationships with senior funder contacts.

  • Team planning and performance reporting, monitoring income, pledges and pipeline activity.

  • Ensure systems and processes are in place for effective grant management and stewardship across the team.

Let's talk about you 

  • Demonstrable experience of trusts and foundations fundraising with an excellent track record of initiating new relationships and securing significant gifts and developing multi-year funding partnerships.

  • Demonstrable ability to lead, inspire and line manage a team of fundraisers

  • Experience of identifying and prioritising funding prospects and overseeing a complex pipeline.

  • Experience of developing relationships with senior decision makers at trusts and foundations and statutory funders.

  • Demonstrable organisational, financial and analytical skills.

  • Experience of using and interrogating relational databases, ideally Raiser’s Edge

  • Demonstrable understanding of trusts fundraising best practice, the Code of Fundraising Practice, data protection requirements and the responsible handling of confidential information.

It's an exciting time to join the Trusts team at Action for Children, and we are looking for collaborative, energised and forward-thinking individuals to join our ambitious team.

Please see the Job Description for the full list of accountabilities and requirements.  

Our Commitment to Equity, Inclusion and Anti-Racism

At Action for Children, we are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and able to thrive. We know that racism and discrimination create barriers, and we are taking active steps to challenge these inequalities in our organisation and in the communities we serve. 

We strongly welcome applications from people who are Black, Asian, or from other racialised and ethnically marginalised communities, as well as disabled people, who are currently under-represented in our workforce. We are committed to removing barriers in our recruitment processes and ensuring fair access to opportunities. 

Want to know more about Action for Children? 

Find us on  Linkedin, Facebook or YouTube to get to know us better. 

Closing Date: Tuesday 8th December 2026.

Interviews will be week commencing 14th December by MS Teams.

AfC Commitment Statement

raw.description:
iLogos Game Studios provides solutions for mobile game developers no matter how challenging the project or task is. We’ve been around since 2006 and in that time frame, we have successfully completed 400+ projects and have become a partner of choice for EA, Sony, Disney, Rovio, Ubisoft, and many other companies.

We're looking for a talented Game UI/UX Artist to join iLogos Game Studios and create engaging, colorful, and intuitive interfaces for an exciting mobile F2P endless runner!

We're especially interested in artists who combine strong game UI/UX design skills, creative visual thinking, and hands-on AI-assisted workflows to deliver polished, production-ready interfaces.

About the Project

We're developing a mobile F2P endless runner in Unity for iOS and Android, inspired by the fast-paced gameplay of Subway Surfers, but with a fresh visual identity.

Our game features expressive anthropomorphic animal characters traveling around the world through vibrant, stylized urban environments.

The visual direction combines high-quality cartoon 3D, playful character design, bold colors, and street culture aesthetics.

Players will explore three unique locations, while unlocking characters, customizing hoverboards, collecting rewards, and completing daily challenges.

Our goal is to create a visually distinctive, engaging mobile experience with intuitive navigation and appealing F2P progression systems.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3+ years of professional experience in game UI/UX design for mobile F2P games.

  • Strong portfolio featuring stylized game interfaces, preferably from casual or midcore mobile projects.

  • Experience creating visually appealing cartoon-style UI art, including icons, panels, buttons, and in-game interface elements.

  • Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Photoshop.

  • Practical experience designing F2P monetization interfaces, including stores, offers, bundles, currencies, and reward systems.

  • Strong understanding of mobile UX principles, user flows, visual hierarchy, and responsive layouts.

  • Experience preparing and handing off UI assets for Unity integration, including slicing, anchors, safe areas, and different screen resolutions.

  • Strong hands-on experience with generative AI tools for UI art, icons, and visual asset creation.

  • Ability to demonstrate independently developed or customized AI-assisted workflows, including style consistency, paint-over, manual refinement, and production-ready results.

  • Ability to collaborate efficiently with artists, designers, and developers in a production environment.

Nice to have:

  • Experience creating UI animations, transitions, and interactive effects.

  • Previous experience with endless runners or successful casual mobile games.

  • Hands-on experience implementing UI directly in Unity.

  • Experience designing character customization or cosmetic selection interfaces.

  • Familiarity with mobile F2P engagement and retention mechanics.

What the role is about:

  • Design and create engaging game UI/UX for a mobile F2P endless runner, including:

    • Main menus and navigation: home screen, settings, and game modes.

    • Character customization: character and hoverboard selection screens.

    • Monetization UI: in-game store, special offers, bundles, chests, and rewards.

    • Player engagement systems: daily missions, leaderboards, progression, and reward screens.

    • Gameplay UI: in-run HUD, power-up indicators, and results screens.

  • Create high-quality stylized cartoon UI art, including icons, buttons, panels, and decorative elements.

  • Develop intuitive UX flows, wireframes, and responsive layouts for different mobile screen sizes and aspect ratios.

  • Maintain visual consistency with the game's vibrant, street-culture-inspired art direction.

  • Ensure excellent readability, usability, and visual hierarchy across gameplay and menu interfaces.

  • Prepare production-ready UI assets, including slicing, exports, and organized handoff for Unity integration.

  • Collaborate closely with the Art Lead, Game Designers, and Developers to refine UI functionality and visual quality.

  • Apply AI-assisted workflows to accelerate UI art creation, icon production, visual exploration, and asset variations.

  • Contribute to the development and improvement of the studio's AI art production pipelines.

Working conditions:

Our people are what we value the most at iLogos. We treat everyone with respect no matter where you are from or what you believe in. If you share our values which are Mastery, Maturity, Trust & Care, and Positive Mindset – we are a perfect match for each other! Join #ilogos_team and we guarantee you an opportunity for growth, support, and an atmosphere of trust and care that feels more like a family. And as well:

  • Work remotely from anywhere in the world;

  • Flexible working hours.

From scaling specialized tech infrastructure to delivering bilingual front-line customer service, Jobsity provides an all-in-one staffing solution including recruitment, onboarding, payroll, compliance, and more.

Why Work With Jobsity

We match standout professionals across Latin America with high-impact opportunities at leading U.S. companies. Joining Jobsity is about finding a rewarding remote role and working with innovative teams. It also means you get to become part of a community that values your experience, supports your ambition, and invests in your ongoing professional growth.

Whether you are looking for your next challenge, seeking greater flexibility, or ready to elevate your career, Jobsity gives you the platform and partnership to thrive on your terms.

We’re seeking a Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Java + TypeScript) to build production web applications with a flexible 50/50 backend and frontend focus. Job Description

This is a remote position.

Contract Type: Permanent, Full-time
Stage: Post-Seed / Early Scale-up
Location: Remote
Working Hours: UK Hours

About the Role
The client is a sustainable technology company transforming propulsion across Air, Sea, and Sport. With a protected IP portfolio of over 30 patents, they have already launched a UK D2C brand in the Sport sector and are in the process of globalising D2C sales.

They are now seeking their first in-house finance hire. This individual will be a strategic partner to the CEO & Finance Director, and will be responsible for building a global, world-class finance function from the ground up to support our trajectory toward the projected revenue target by 2030.

What will make you a great fit for this role?
We are looking for a commercially minded Finance Manager who is excited by the opportunity to take ownership of the day-to-day finance function within a growing, ambitious international business.

This is a hands-on role with plenty of scope to make an impact. You'll be responsible for managing the core finance function, including accounting, reporting, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow, while also helping to improve and automate processes as the business scales.

You'll work closely with an experienced Finance Director, who will provide strategic and board-level guidance, giving you the opportunity to take real ownership of the finance function while developing your experience across a broader commercial and strategic remit.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who has built a strong foundation in finance and is ready to take the next step in their career – gaining greater ownership, commercial exposure and experience within a fast-growing international business.

And this isn't just a finance role. You'll be joining a company making a genuine environmental impact – from reducing underwater noise for marine life to making aviation quieter and paddle sports more accessible.

What you'll do

Own the Day-to-Day Finance Function

  • Take ownership of the day-to-day finance function, including AP, AR, payroll, reconciliations and month-end processes.
  • Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting and maintain strong financial controls.
  • Manage relationships with external accountants, tax advisers and other finance providers where required.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow

  • Lead the annual budgeting and forecasting process.
  • Prepare regular cash flow forecasts and monitor working capital.
  • Provide financial insight to help the leadership team understand performance, risks and opportunities.
  • Build financial models and "what-if" scenarios to support commercial and investment decisions.

Finance Transformation & Process Improvement

  • Help transition the finance function from its current outsourced model towards a more efficient and scalable internal function.
  • Identify opportunities to improve, automate and streamline finance processes as transaction volumes increase.
  • Support the implementation and optimisation of finance systems, including the future move to a scalable ERP.
  • Improve the integration between e-commerce, inventory, manufacturing and finance systems.

International Growth

  • Support the financial management of the company's international operations and multi-entity structure.
  • Assist with consolidation, foreign exchange and international tax compliance across the UK, US, EU and Japan.
  • Support the implementation of automated tax solutions for North American sales.

Business Partnering

  • Work closely with the founders and leadership team, providing commercially focused financial insight and guidance.
  • Partner with the company's Technology and Product teams, helping them understand the financial implications of projects and investments without stifling innovation.
  • Support the Finance Director with board reporting, strategic planning and financial governance.

Support Business Growth

  • Provide financial analysis to support new products, markets and investment decisions.
  • Support funding rounds and the preparation of financial information and investment materials.
  • Help establish the financial processes, controls and reporting needed to support the company's transition from a lean startup to an international scale-up.

Requirements

  • Qualified or nearly qualified: ACA, ACCA or CIMA, with relevant post-qualification experience preferred.
  • Commercial finance experience: Experience within a product-based SME, scale-up or similarly fast-paced environment.
  • Strong accounting foundation: Confident managing the day-to-day finance function, month-end, reporting, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow.
  • International exposure: Experience working with multiple entities, currencies and/or international operations would be highly beneficial.
  • Technical capability: Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls and audit requirements.
  • Systems & automation: Comfortable working with finance systems, e-commerce platforms and technology, with an interest in improving and automating finance processes.
  • Analytical mindset: Able to turn financial data into clear commercial insight and support decision-making.
  • Remote Work: Fully set up to work remotely and within UK business hours.

Personal Attributes

  • The "Builder" Mindset: You enjoy taking ownership, improving things and building processes rather than simply maintaining the status quo.
  • Commercially Focused: You understand that finance should support the business and enable growth, not just report on what has already happened.
  • Hands-On: You're happy getting into the detail when needed, while also being able to step back and look at the bigger picture.
  • Growth Mindset: You're looking for an opportunity to broaden your experience and take on increasing responsibility as the company grows.
  • Stakeholder Savvy: You're confident working with founders, senior leaders, technical teams and external advisers.
  • Collaborative: You'll work closely with an experienced Finance Director who will provide strategic guidance, while giving you significant ownership of the day-to-day finance function.

raw.description:
Grip op contracten, oog voor verbetering

Zorg jij graag dat afspraken kloppen, informatie op orde is en processen steeds slimmer worden ingericht? Als contractbeheerder onderhoudscontracten bij Woonzorg Nederland combineer je jouw analytische blik met een belangrijke rol in het beheer en de verbetering van onze vastgoedcontracten.

Jij maakt het verschil doordat je...

  • zorgt dat onze onderhoudscontracten en contractinformatie goed beheerd zijn en het contractbeheersysteem actueel en betrouwbaar blijft.

  • afwijkingen, prestaties en financiële informatie analyseert en vertaalt naar heldere adviezen en verbetervoorstellen.

  • actief meedenkt over betere processen en systemen en daarmee bijdraagt aan de verdere professionalisering van ons contractbeheer.

Jouw impact als contractbeheerder onderhoudscontracten

Goed onderhoud van ons vastgoed begint bij duidelijke afspraken en contracten die op orde zijn. Als contractbeheerder zorg jij ervoor dat onze onderhoudscontracten goed zijn ingericht en beheerd. Je analyseert lopende contracten, onderzoekt afwijkingen en adviseert over de gevolgen daarvan. Ook beoordeel je operationele en financiële contractinformatie en zorg je dat het contractbeheersysteem actueel en betrouwbaar blijft.

Je kijkt verder dan de dagelijkse administratie. Je toetst zelfstandig KPI’s, analyseert resultaten en levert managementinformatie aan. Zie je dat iets beter of slimmer kan? Dan kom je met verbetervoorstellen voor bestaande processen, systemen en werkwijzen. Ook beoordeel je offertes, pas je opdrachten aan, controleer je facturen en houd je de administratie bij.

Je bent bovendien een vraagbaak voor collega’s en begeleidt waar nodig externe deskundigen en medewerkers bij de uitvoering van hun werk. Je denkt mee over de samenwerking met bewonersconsulenten, technisch managers en hoofdaannemers. En als het nodig is, ondersteun en vervang je de contractmanager. Zo zorg je samen met je collega’s voor grip op de contractportefeuille en een professionele samenwerking met onze aannemers.

Wat maakt deze functie extra mooi?

  • Je hebt zichtbare invloed op de kwaliteit. Met jouw analyses en verbetervoorstellen help je contracten, informatie en processen steeds verder te verbeteren.

  • Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Je signaleert kansen, denkt mee over vernieuwing en helpt verbeteringen daadwerkelijk realiseren.

  • Je werkt met veel verschillende collega's en partners. Je verbindt informatie, afspraken en mensen en bent een belangrijke inhoudelijke gesprekspartner.

.

Wat je verder krijgt
Uiteraard krijg je daar ook veel voor terug. Zoals de ruimte om zelf mee te denken en te experimenteren met nieuwe werkwijzen. Persoonlijke aandacht, tijdens je inwerkperiode én daarna. En ruime mogelijkheden – inclusief scholingsbudget – voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling, ook buiten de gebaande paden. Er is oog voor jouw werkgeluk en een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Want als je werkt met plezier, kun je meer betekenen voor een ander. Daarnaast bieden we je:

  • Een brutomaandsalaris tussen € 3.631,- en € 4.563,- bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur. Deze functie valt binnen schaal G van de cao Woondiensten.

  • De mogelijkheid om (bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur) 4 x 9 uur per week te werken.

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een contract voor onbepaalde tijd

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling.

  • Kilometervergoeding voor je woon-werkverkeer of afspraken. Daarnaast krijg je een mobiliteitspas voor alle vormen van openbaar vervoer.

  • Een thuiswerkvergoeding, faciliteiten om een fijn thuiskantoor in te richten én de vrijheid om in overleg zelf te bepalen waar en wanneer je werkt.

  • Een mooi opleidingsbudget van € 900,- per jaar (gebaseerd op een fulltime dienstverband) en volop mogelijkheden om opleidingen en trainingen te volgen.

  • Een laptop en een nieuw model telefoon.

  • 189,8 vakantie-uren bij een fulltime dienstverband van 36 uur.

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw werkgeluk en een goede balans tussen werk, privé en vitaliteit. Want als je werkt met plezier, kun je meer betekenen voor een ander.

  • Een sport-en-beweegvergoeding van € 128,­- netto per jaar en elke twee jaar een Health Check (preventief medisch onderzoek).

En dat is nog niet alles. In december kies je zelf van welke extra voorwaarden je het volgende jaar gebruik wilt maken. Denk aan extra verlofuren. 

Lees op meer over werken bij onze organisatie >>

Een warm team waarin je wordt gezien en gehoord

Je werkt samen met de teamleider contractmanager DO/Manager onderhoud en realisatie en de collega's binnen het team. In je functie heb je daarnaast contact met onder anderen contractmanagers, technisch managers, bewonersconsulenten en hoofdaannemers.

Requirements

Zo vul jij ons aan

Je bent iemand die graag structuur aanbrengt en zorgvuldig werkt. Je houdt overzicht, duikt graag in informatie en vindt het belangrijk dat afspraken en gegevens kloppen. Tegelijkertijd kijk je kritisch naar bestaande werkwijzen en zie je waar verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid, werkt zelfstandig en zoekt actief de samenwerking op. Collega's kunnen op je rekenen: je communiceert helder, denkt mee en zorgt voor een goede terugkoppeling.

Verder heb je:

  • Mbo+-werk- en -denkniveau.

  • Kennis van en ervaring met bouw- en installatiecontracten en het beheren van contracten.

  • Kennis van huurrecht.

Zet jouw kennis in voor goed vastgoedbeheer

Past deze functie bij jou? Upload dan uiterlijk 13 december 2026 je motivatie en cv. Wil je eerst meer weten over de functie? Bel of app dan even met Saiida Bosse, Manager Programmering & Evaluatie 06-57410058

raw.description:
About Athennian

Athennian delivers Governance Ops™ software that aligns legal, finance, tax and fund teams through a secure, integrated source of truth for entity and ownership data. The platform enables organizations managing complex corporate and investment structures to automate governance workflows, maintain audit-ready records and collaborate across functions with confidence.

More than 500,000 entities across over 150 countries are managed on Athennian, helping organizations modernize entity management and transform governance operations into a strategic advantage.

We are a fast-moving, solutions-driven team using an AI-forward approach to solve complex operational challenges. If you are passionate about building technology that transforms traditional industries, we’d love to have you join us.

About the role

With the rapid evolution of AI-driven cyberattacks and sophisticated threat vectors, traditional, reactive vulnerability management is no longer sufficient. We are looking for a hands-on Security Engineer who can proactively identify security gaps, investigate emerging threats, build advanced defenses, and continuously improve Athennian's security posture in line with global enterprise security standards.

In this role, you will partner closely with Information Security, Engineering, Product, and DevOps to embed security by design into how we build, scale, and operate our platform. We are looking for a naturally curious builder who thrives on technical challenges, experiments with emerging technology, and takes end-to-end ownership from vulnerability identification to technical remediation.

What you'll do

  • Proactive Threat Hunting: Conduct advanced threat analysis, continuous posture assessments, and offensive evaluations across our multi-tenant cloud environment to uncover security gaps.
  • Security Architecture & Solution Engineering: Partner with product managers, software architects and engineering teams during the design phase to build and implement scalable, automated security controls with secure coding, and zero-trust principles.
  • AI & Advanced Threat Defense:Research, model, and mitigate emerging AI-accelerated attack vectors, API abuse patterns, and cloud-native infrastructure risks leveraging frameworks such as OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, and MITRE ATT&CK for Cloud.
  • Security Posture Optimization: Continuously tune security telemetry, automated testing pipelines (SAST/DAST/SCA), and detection engineering systems to maximize signal-to-noise ratio and drive continuous cyber defensive improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Security Enablement:Champion a culture of security excellence by coaching engineers, establishing lightweight security playbooks, and bridging the gap between product velocity and high-compliance rigor.
  • Threat Intelligence Integration: Collect, analyze, and disseminate actionable threat intelligence from diverse sources (e.g., vendor updates, public databases, industry advisories) to proactively identify emerging attack vectors and mitigate potential security risks.
  • Vulnerability Triage, Remediation: Triage, prioritize, and remediate security findings by writing or fixing production code directly to close vulnerabilities with defined SLAs.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in application security, product security, or security engineering within a fast-paced software development environment.
  • Code-Level Remediation: Strong software engineering fundamentals with the ability to read, write, and debug production code (e.g., GraphQL, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript/Node.js) to fix vulnerabilities directly rather than just handing off tickets.
  • Vulnerability Management: Proven track record triaging and resolving findings from automated security testing tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning) and managing high-volume alert pipelines.
  • Threat Modeling & Architecture:Demonstrated expertise in conducting threat modeling (e.g., STRIDE) and security architecture reviews across distributed, multi-tenant cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Modern Threat Landscape:Deep understanding of contemporary attack vectors, API security vulnerabilities, cloud-native risks, and secure software development lifecycles (SDLC).
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with product managers and developers, translating complex security risks into practical business and engineering tradeoffs.

Nice to Haves

  • Industry Experience: Prior background navigating high-risk, regulated environments that manage sensitive personal information, particularly within legal tech, fintech, healthcare, or banking.
  • Certifications such as:
    • OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
    • Any AI Security or AI Red-Teaming certifications
    • Relevant Web Application Penetration Tester or Secure Software Programmer certifications
    • AWS Certified Security - Specialty

Location

We have embraced a distributed model of working to reach the best talent in the world. While some roles may require proximity to our Toronto, Calgary and Vancouver offices, roles based outside our office locations can be remote in Canada. Please only apply if you are able to live and work full-time in Canada.

Our Culture

We thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where every team member plays a critical role in our success. We value ambitious, results-driven people who spot opportunities, take initiative and go the extra mile. Collaboration fuels our growth as we take on new challenges, learn constantly and move quickly. If you're a go-getter who thrives on impact, you'll fit right in. Our values are:

  • Outcome Driven: We focus on setting ambitious goals and achieving measurable results, valuing success by the outcomes we deliver.
  • Wide Responsibility: Our team is empowered to shape success, taking ownership from problem identification to solution implementation.
  • Learning Mindset: We embrace curiosity, rejecting the status quo and encouraging continuous learning and agility.
  • Strategic Speed: We make fast, effective decisions and embrace a bias for action to seize opportunities quickly.

Benefits at Athennian

We keep things simple and invest in the perks that matter — your wellbeing, growth and flexibility.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, equity and performance-based bonus structure.
  • Work-Life Balance: A minimum of 3 weeks vacation, 5 sick days and 6 personal/flex days, plus a company-wide winter holiday shutdown.
  • Comprehensive Coverage: Health, dental, vision, long-term disability and a Health Spending Account (HSA).
  • Family Support: Flexible parental leave, including top-ups.
  • Remote Setup: A work-from-home allowance to get you set up for success.

Business Analyst

We are seeking a Business Analyst with a specialization in CyberSecurity Identity and Access Management Analyst to support a large-scale clinical information system transformation initiative within a public sector health organization. This role focuses on user population management, identity rationalization, and identity data governance to ensure all identity and access processes, technologies, and controls are ready for a provincial clinical system implementation. The successful professional will work to establish and maintain trusted user population datasets, identify authoritative identity sources, reconcile duplicate and multiple accounts, and develop matching and correlation rules that support system readiness and ongoing operations.

This position requires someone who can perform identity data discovery, analysis, and reconciliation to support multiple phases of a clinical system program, including testing, training, deployment, go-live readiness, and operational sustainment. Key responsibilities include analyzing identity data across HR systems, provider registries, Active Directory, and other approved sources; building and maintaining trusted user population datasets; developing and documenting identity attribute standards and data definitions; assessing identity data quality and identifying gaps and remediation opportunities; reconciling duplicate user records and multiple accounts; performing user population analysis to support planning and deployment; validating onboarding populations prior to deployment waves; supporting user identification activities related to training enrollment, multi-factor authentication, access provisioning, and onboarding readiness; coordinating with identity and access management, role-based access control, training, identity governance and administration, security, and operational teams; and supporting identity governance processes and operational procedures. The role includes mentoring and knowledge transfer to program personnel to ensure continuity and long-term program success.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, Health Informatics, or a similar discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 3+ years - performing business, data, or systems analysis in a large enterprise environment
  • 3+ years - working with identity, access, user account, provider, HR, or directory data
  • 3+ years - performing data analysis, reconciliation, validation, and quality assessment activities
  • 3+ years - gathering and documenting business rules, data rules, workflows, and requirements
  • 3+ years - working with large datasets using Excel, reporting tools, databases, or similar analysis tools
  • 3+ years - coordinating with technical, operational, and business stakeholders
  • 3+ years - strong written and verbal communication skills
  • 3+ years - investigating issues, performing root-cause analysis, and recommending corrective actions
  • 3+ years - supporting large-scale healthcare, clinical information system, EMR, EHR, or enterprise transformation initiatives
  • 3+ years - working with Active Directory, Entra ID, LDAP directories, provider registries, HR systems, or identity repositories

Nice to Have

  • 3+ years - building or managing enterprise user population datasets
  • 3+ years - performing identity reconciliation, account rationalization, or duplicate record resolution activities
  • 3+ years - defining identity matching rules, correlation logic, or identity data standards
  • 3+ years - conducting data quality assessments, profiling, cleansing, and remediation activities
  • 3+ years - supporting multi-factor authentication, single sign-on, Tap-and-Go, user provisioning, or authentication-related programs
  • 2+ years - supporting Identity Governance and Administration solutions such as Saviynt or similar platforms
  • 3+ years - supporting healthcare user onboarding, provider identity, or access management initiatives
  • 2+ years - supporting testing, training, or deployment readiness activities for large-scale system implementations
  • French language proficiency, spoken and written

Corporate Practice

Michael Baker International understands that people require choices in where they want to begin to build a sustainable future. For more than 85 years, Michael Baker International has maintained an entrepreneurial work environment that fosters great careers, which has ultimately brought great success to the organization. Michael Baker offers many opportunities to help you grow professionally to build your career. Whether it is in Finance, IT, Human Resources, Technology, Communications, Proposal Development, Legal or our National Practice and Market segments, take your next step with us and help make a difference in the lives of those you work with and those we serve.

What We're Looking For

Michael Baker's Design Technology team is looking for a ProjectWise Specialist to help our project teams get the most out of ProjectWise, our Common Data Environment. You'll be the go-to person when engineers and designers need help, and you'll set up and maintain the projects, permissions, and workspaces that keep work moving across a large portfolio of infrastructure projects.

This is a learning and growth role. You'll work alongside senior ProjectWise and Bentley specialists who want to share what they know, and you'll build skills in platform administration, automation, and Bentley's cloud solutions as we move toward cloud-based digital delivery. If you know how ProjectWise is put together, enjoy helping people solve problems, and want to grow with where the platform is heading, we'd like to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a primary contact for ProjectWise support requests, troubleshooting access, permissions, workspace configuration, synchronization, and file management issues, and follow through until each one is resolved.

  • Talk with project teams to understand what they need, then turn those needs into practical ProjectWise setups.

  • Create and maintain projects, work areas, folder structures, metadata, user groups, and permissions using approved standards and security practices.

  • Deploy and maintain managed workspace configurations, and apply naming conventions and metadata standards consistently across projects.

  • Perform routine file recovery, restoration, and health checks, and keep runbooks, checklists, and operational records current.

  • Support system upgrades, patching, and configuration changes, including testing before production release.

  • Write and update user guides, process documentation, and onboarding materials, and deliver or co-deliver training sessions.

  • Help build automations, dashboards, and reports for project setup, permissions, standards, and usage, and help evaluate Bentley cloud solutions such as Bentley Infrastructure Cloud and iTwin.

What You Need to Succeed

  • At least 18 months of hands-on experience with Bentley ProjectWise that includes some administration or configuration work — for example, setting up projects or folders, managing users, groups, and permissions, or supporting managed workspaces. This experience may come from a state DOT, federal agency, transit or toll authority, engineering or construction firm, or a CAD/BIM support role.

  • Experience supporting users in a technical role, such as help desk, service desk, CAD/BIM support, or application support. This can overlap with your ProjectWise experience.

  • An understanding of how engineering and design teams use CAD or BIM tools such as MicroStation, OpenRoads, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, or Revit.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical topics to people who aren't technical.

  • An associate or bachelor's degree in engineering, architecture, construction management, information technology, or a related field — or an equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, military service, or work experience.

  • Authorization to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.

Helpful, but not required: ProjectWise experience with a state DOT or other public infrastructure owner; MicroStation or OpenRoads managed workspace configuration; exposure to Bentley Infrastructure Cloud or iTwin. If you don't have these, we still encourage you to apply.

Compensation

The approximate compensation range for this position is $78,000 - $112,000. This compensation range is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be dependent upon factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, qualifications, education, skill set, and geographic location.

Why Choose Us

  • Life, AD&D, short-term, and long-term disability

  • Professional and personal development

Program Director – Civil Society Partnership Fund

Classification: Fixed-term, full-time, project-funded employment with an anticipated term of 4.5 years

Reports to: Australia Representative

Supervisory Responsibility: Direct line management of the CSPF Hub team

Location: Accepting applications from those living in and authorized to work in Australia and the Asia-Pacific Region. The role may be performed on a fully remote basis and requires regular travel across Southeast Asia, the Pacific, and Australia.

About The Asia Foundation

The Asia Foundation (TAF) is an international nonprofit organization working to solve the toughest social and economic challenges in Asia and the Pacific. For more than 70 years, we have been helping people in more than 20 countries navigate complexity and change to realize their aspirations. Our vision is a peaceful, just and thriving Asia and Pacific.

We root our work in local insight, on-the-ground presence, and trust. We operate as a committed and locally grounded partner, with most of our people coming from the places in which we work. This enables us to respond nimbly to evolving challenges, catalyze contextually relevant and effective solutions, and sustain relationships long enough to see systemic change take hold.

The Civil Society Partnership Fund: In 2024 the Australian Government committed AUD 35 million over four years to establish the Civil Society Partnership Fund (CSPF) to address the challenges of shrinking civic space across the Indo-Pacific. The Asia Foundation (TAF) is implementing the CSPF in partnership with the Australian Council for International Development (ACFID) and the Pacific Islands Association of Non-Governmental Organizations (PIANGO). CSPF will be implemented utilizing a virtual Hub team, with country-based personnel located in TAF's offices across the two regions.

Position Summary

The Program Director will provide high-level strategic, technical and operational leadership for CSPF and will be accountable for the overall quality, coherence and performance of the program. The Program Director will lead the program through mobilization and inception, establish its management, grants, MEL, risk and safeguarding systems, and steer a portfolio of partnerships and grants across Southeast Asia and the Pacific.

The Program Director will ensure that CSPF remains aligned with the program objective, Australia’s Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) requirements, the needs of local partners and the evolving context in each country. The Program Director will represent CSPF at senior meetings, engage strategically with DFAT Canberra and Posts, ACFID, PIANGO, TAF country offices, regional institutions and civil society partners, and lead the CSPF Hub team.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Program Leadership and Strategic Direction

  • Provide high-level strategic leadership and oversight of CSPF, ensuring activities align with the program logic and end-of-program outcomes, Australian Government priorities, partner needs, and DFAT guidelines and requirements.
  • Lead mobilisation and the nine-month inception phase, including establishing the Hub, developing the Inception Plan, Inception Phase Report and annual work plans.
  • Work closely with DFAT, TAF’s Country Offices and partners in the management of the program and provide timely, evidence-based advice on key decisions, risks and opportunities.
  • Lead and manage the CSPF Hub team.
  • Represent TAF and CSPF at relevant meetings, forums, events and senior stakeholder engagements.

Grant Making and Partnership Portfolio

  • Provide strategic oversight of CSPF's grant making activities.
  • Oversee CSPF’s partnership portfolio, embedding equitable partnership practice, working with local partners to shape priorities, resource allocation and program direction, while maintaining TAF’s fiduciary oversight and safeguarding.

Program Management, Performance and Reporting

  • Provide oversight and strategic input across financial management, grants management, procurement, contracting and administration, working closely with TAF's grants management, finance and compliance teams.
  • Provide high-level oversight of annual budget planning and execution, ensuring expenditure is aligned with approved work plans and that disbursement targets and payment milestones are met.
  • Oversee the preparation of work plans, budgets, annual reports and other deliverables.

Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning & GEDSI

  • Oversee the development and implementation of the program-wide MEL Framework and ensure ongoing alignment with DFAT's Design and Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Standards.
  • Oversee the development and implementation of the GEDSI Action Plan, ensuring gender equality and disability equity are embedded across grant making, partnerships, MEL and governance.

Qualifications, Experience and Competencies

Essential

  • Advanced qualification in international development, political science, public policy, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Substantial senior leadership experience managing complex, multi-country and/or regional donor-funded programs, including responsibility for strategy, delivery, supervision, budgets, risk, governance and donor relationships.
  • Strong understanding of civic space, civil society and governance dynamics in Southeast Asia and/or the Pacific, and experience working in politically sensitive or constrained operating environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply political economy analysis and thinking and working politically approaches to program strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior government and donor stakeholders, and to build trusted relationships with civil society, regional institutions and development partners.
  • Demonstrated experience managing fiduciary, safeguarding, child protection, PSEAH and do no harm requirements in programs that fund local partners.
  • Excellent strategic judgement, written communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated commitment to GEDSI, locally led development, equitable partnerships and inclusive leadership.

Highly Desirable

  • Direct experience working with DFAT, including knowledge of DFAT program management, MEL standards, risk, value for money and reporting requirements.
  • Experience working across Southeast Asia and/or the Pacific.
  • Experience establishing or leading a program through inception, including setting up grants, MEL, risk and safeguarding systems.
  • Experience with leadership development or cohort-based capability and coalition building programs for civic actors.

Location and Employment Terms

Australian-based candidates with unrestricted work rights in Australia are strongly preferred. Given the position's substantial engagement with DFAT and other Canberra-based stakeholders, preference will be given to applicants who are based in Australia and eligible to work in Australia without current or future visa sponsorship.

The Asia Foundation also welcomes applications from highly qualified candidates based across Asia and the Pacific. All applicants must have legal authorization to work in their country of residence and must not require visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Candidates hired in Australia will be employed through The Asia Foundation's designated Employer of Record (EOR) partner, which will serve as the legal employer for payroll, benefits administration, and employment compliance purposes.

This is a full-time, fixed-term employment position with an anticipated term of 4.5 years.

Compensation and Benefits

Compensation and benefits will be determined in accordance with the policies, salary structure, and benefit programs of the employing entity and applicable local law. The final compensation package will reflect the selected candidate's qualifications, experience, work location, and internal equity considerations.

This is a locally engaged position and not an international assignment. As such, the position is not eligible for expatriate or assignment-related benefits, including relocation assistance, housing, education, or post allowances. Employment terms and benefits will be administered in accordance with local laws and The Asia Foundation's policies in the country of employment.

How to Apply: Visit us at Careers | The Asia Foundation Your application must include a CV, cover letter, and three (3) professional references. Receipt of all applications will be acknowledged. Due to the volume of applications received, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted regarding next steps in the selection process.

Application Deadline: December 23, 2026

All employees are expected to uphold the Foundation’s safeguarding, child protection, anti-harassment, anti-discrimination, and code of conduct policies. Any offer of employment will be subject to satisfactory, role-appropriate reference checks and background checks conducted in accordance with applicable law, organizational policy, and any applicable funder requirements. See Our Safeguarding Commitments for more details.

The Asia Foundation is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any status protected by applicable law. Qualified applicants with disabilities may request reasonable accommodations during the application and selection process and, if hired, to perform the essential functions of the position.

Founded in 2008, what started as a small business has grown into a diverse and innovative global team owned by Cook Inlet Region, Inc. an Alaska Native Regional Corporation. The PM is a representative of the company and shall have organizational authority to execute the requirements and serves as the senior authority on the program/contract. In this role, the PM will provide direction, prioritization, coordination, and conflict resolution while managing project teams that accomplish project objectives. Core responsibilities include serving as the single point of contact and escalation resource for assigned Billing Attorneys and their Practice Assistants; conducting monthly check-ins to ensure billing processes are functioning correctly; directing the triage of financial inquiries across Finance groups; conducting high-profile client audits; and managing reversal projects.

raw.description:
Senior Product Manager

Location: Remote (any location or time zone)

Team: Product

Reports to: Ben Dowling (Founder / Co-CEO)

About IPinfo

At IPinfo, we're building the world's best understanding of the internet.

We're an independent, profitable, fast-growing internet data company whose products help thousands of developers and businesses understand internet connections and make better decisions. Our data powers products and decisions across cybersecurity, fraud prevention, payments, advertising, gaming and other industries.

We've spent years building sophisticated proprietary datasets, technology for understanding how the internet works, and a global measurement network of more than 1,400 points of presence in over 170 countries. Our products span geolocation, network intelligence, privacy detection and more, delivered through APIs, databases and integrations.

We believe there's an enormous opportunity to turn these capabilities into even more valuable products.

The opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who loves discovering opportunities, understanding customers and turning ideas into successful products.

Ideas come from everywhere at IPinfo. Our founder has plenty. Our engineering and data teams regularly uncover new possibilities. Customers bring us interesting problems, and our commercial teams see opportunities in the market.

You'll help us figure out which opportunities are worth pursuing, develop the most promising ones, and turn them into successful products. That means understanding how customers actually use our data, investigating underlying problems, exploring technical possibilities, assessing commercial potential, shaping products, and working with our teams to bring them to market.

Your initial focus will be our emerging data products, working with customers and technical teams to identify valuable use cases, shape compelling products, and bring them to market.

Some opportunities will start with a clear vision that needs validation, refinement and execution. Others will start with a technical discovery, an unmet customer need or something nobody has thought of yet. We want someone who enjoys both.

You'll work directly with IPinfo's founder and with talented engineers, data scientists, sales and solutions engineering colleagues. You'll have genuine autonomy and influence on product direction, while helping establish the product discipline that turns discovery into action and learning.

What the role looks like in practice

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. Your initial focus is personally investigating opportunities, shaping emerging data products, and driving them toward meaningful customer adoption.

  • Interview customers to understand their problems, how they use IPinfo data today, and where we could deliver more value.
  • Meet with engineering and data leaders to explore emerging capabilities, technical constraints and promising product directions.
  • Review and triage feedback from solutions engineering, sales and support, alongside customer usage and market signals, to identify patterns worth investigating.
  • Bring evidence-backed product proposals and recommendations to the founder, discussing priorities, tradeoffs and consequential investment decisions.
  • Work with technical, product marketing and commercial colleagues to move agreed products toward launch, adoption and learning from results.

You'll work closely with both Co-CEOs, our engineering and data leaders, solutions engineering, sales and our existing product marketing function. You won't personally do every part of product development or go-to-market; you'll bring the right people together, clarify decisions and ensure momentum.

What you'll do

  • Understand customers and uncover opportunities. Go beyond feature requests to understand how customers use our data, what problems they're trying to solve, how they solve them today, and which outcomes matter. Talk directly to customers, identify patterns and discover opportunities we might otherwise miss.
  • Connect technical capabilities to customer value. Work with engineering and data teams to understand what's possible and what our evidence can reliably support. Find the use cases and value propositions that connect those capabilities to real decisions customers need to make.
  • Validate and recommend. Investigate demand, commercial potential, strategic fit, tradeoffs and uncertainties. Develop clear, well-evidenced recommendations on what to pursue, test, defer or stop. Work closely with the founder on consequential product investment choices.
  • Drive products from idea to impact. Help define, prioritize, develop, launch and refine products in partnership with technical and commercial owners. Keep momentum, make decisions within agreed scope, and stay accountable for customer value and adoption, not just releases.
  • Own a lightweight feedback loop. Bring together insights from customers, sales, solutions engineering, support and the technical team. Make sure signals reach decisions, colleagues understand the reasoning, and learning from launched products feeds back into future work.
  • Measure and improve value delivery. Work with commercial colleagues on positioning, delivery, packaging and pricing experiments. Use adoption, customer outcomes and business results to improve our products and how customers access them.

About you

  • Customer discovery is a demonstrated strength. You can get beyond feature requests to actual problems, existing alternatives, decision-makers, constraints and evidence of value. You learn directly from customers.
  • You have strong product judgment. You can connect ambiguous technical capabilities with customer outcomes, distinguish evidence from assumption and make thoughtful recommendations about where to invest.
  • You take ownership. You have driven opportunities through meaningful decisions, product delivery and learning, with the judgment to follow through and to stop weak ideas.
  • You're technically fluent and curious. You can reason about data, APIs, evidence, delivery formats and technical constraints with engineers and data scientists. Experience with B2B data, developer tools, cybersecurity or internet infrastructure is especially useful.
  • You're commercially thoughtful and collaborative. You care about the full journey from useful data to value realized by a customer. You communicate clearly, challenge constructively and work effectively across teams without formal authority.
  • You use process pragmatically. You can create the minimum structure needed to learn, make decisions and ship, without confusing documents or activity with progress.

We're more interested in what you've built, how you think and the impact you've had than a rigid years-of-experience requirement or a particular career path.

Role Overview

We design and ship headless commerce storefronts for major retail brands, where a 100ms regression in Largest Contentful Paint directly affects conversion and revenue. We're building on Storefront Next, Salesforce's new React Router 7 storefront architecture, in one of the earliest production implementations, including a replatform off a legacy commerce suite ahead of holiday-peak traffic.

As Senior Solutions Architect (Salesforce Commerce Cloud), you'll own the technical direction for one of our distributed delivery teams across the full stack, from the Storefront Next experience tier to the SCAPI and SLAS layer, platform extensions, and enterprise integrations, and you'll represent Space Dinosaurs as our Salesforce and architecture subject-matter expert with clients.

Essential Functions

  • Design and own full-stack architectures for enterprise Salesforce B2C Commerce implementations on Storefront Next: route loaders and actions, server rendering and streaming, session and auth middleware, and the API layer to the commerce platform, and record rendering, caching, and auth decisions in ADRs
  • Represent Space Dinosaurs as Salesforce and architecture subject-matter expert with clients, translating business needs into pragmatic roadmaps and explaining tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders
  • Architect the platform extension layer (SCAPI hooks, Custom APIs, jobs, service integrations, custom objects) and the data flows that connect it to enterprise systems such as OMS, payments, tax, CRM, and data platforms, including secure, PCI-aware checkout for headless storefronts
  • Break epics into implementable stories with clear acceptance criteria, identifying technical dependencies and estimating complexity, resolve technical ambiguity before sprint, and escalate architectural drift when design intent diverges from implementation
  • Drive Core Web Vitals and API performance across your delivery team with budgets checked in CI, and plan load and soak testing ahead of peak-traffic events
  • Set accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), security, resilience, and observability requirements at design time and check them in design review
  • Define coding standards and project conventions in formats that enable both engineers and AI agents to execute reliably, and mentor engineers through reviews and pairing, contributing reusable patterns back to the practice.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of software engineering, including 5+ years on Salesforce B2C Commerce (SFRA, PWA Kit/Composable Storefront, or Storefront Next) with at least 2 years of architectural ownership
  • Technical leadership of distributed engineering teams (3+ engineers), with strong written and verbal English: able to explain architectural tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders and define the conventions engineers build against, and at least four hours of overlap with US business hours
  • Hands-on depth in B2C Commerce extensibility: SCAPI and SLAS, hooks, Custom APIs, jobs, the service framework, custom objects, and site import and data replication, plus enterprise integration architecture: batch and async feeds, idempotency, failure handling, and third-party system integration
  • Experience designing secure, PCI-aware checkout flows, with performance engineering expertise: Core Web Vitals, caching strategy, load testing, and a track record of shipping measurable improvements
  • Evidence of designing work for agentic operation: writing specs agents can execute, maintaining documentation as context infrastructure, decomposing features so agent output is reviewable, and handling data responsibly (masked data, no PII in prompts or context)
  • Agency, consultancy, or multi-client delivery experience
  • At least one Salesforce B2C Commerce certification (Developer or Architect)
  • Preferred: Deep React and TypeScript with a modern SSR framework (React Router 7/Remix or Next.js App Router), hands-on Storefront Next or Managed Runtime experience (including side projects), and experience with Page Designer, OMS integration, payments orchestration, or large data migrations

Tools

  • React, React Router 7, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite
  • Salesforce B2C Commerce (SCAPI, SLAS, Storefront Next, Managed Runtime, Business Manager)
  • GitHub and GitHub Actions
  • SonarQube, Lighthouse, axe, Playwright, Jest or Vitest
  • Cursor and/or Claude Code
  • Slack, Jira, Confluence

What We Offer

  • Startup Environment: A lean, fast-moving team where ownership, autonomy, and accountability are expected.
  • High-Impact Work: Meaningful, hands-on work with direct visibility into outcomes and production impact.
  • Top-Tier Clients: Opportunities to work with well-known, global brands and complex, real-world challenges.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Market-aligned pay, comprehensive benefits, and bonus structures where applicable.
  • Unlimited PTO: Flexible time off built on trust, ownership, and clear expectations.
  • 100% Remote Work: Work from anywhere with a distributed, async-first team.
  • Growth & Development: Room to expand scope, build expertise, and grow alongside the company

EEO Statement: Space Dinosaurs is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Employment decisions are based on job-related qualifications and business needs.

raw.description:
Role Snapshot
The Part-Time Managed Care Pharmacist supports the clinical and operational goals of WPS Health Insurance by providing clinical oversight of pharmacy benefits, ensuring appropriate medication use, and identifying opportunities to improve quality and reduce total cost of care. This role collaborates with internal teams, pharmacy vendor partners, clinicians, and external stakeholders to optimize formulary strategy, evaluate drug utilization trends, and implement initiatives that enhance member outcomes while managing pharmacy spend.

Salary Range
55.00-70.00/hr. (20 hours/week)
The base pay offered for this position may vary within the posted range based on your job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Work Location
We are open to remote work in the following approved states:
Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, New Jersey, North Carolina, Ohio, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia, Wisconsin

How do I know this opportunity is right for me? If you enjoy the following:

  • Provide clinical oversight of pharmacy benefit programs, ensuring evidence-based, safe, and cost-effective medication use.
  • Review and evaluate drug utilization data to identify trends, outliers, and opportunities for clinical or financial improvement.
  • Develop and recommend cost-savings strategies, including formulary optimization, prior authorization criteria updates, and targeted utilization management interventions.
  • Support the evaluation of high-cost specialty medications and emerging therapies, including financial impact assessments and policy recommendations.
  • Collaborate with internal clinical, actuarial, medical management, and provider network teams to support integrated care strategies.
  • Review complex prior authorization cases and provide clinical input to ensure alignment with guidelines and benefit intent.
  • Assist in outcomes measurement, reporting, and monitoring of implemented programs to validate effectiveness.
  • Maintain knowledge of drug trends, regulatory changes, clinical guidelines, and managed care best practices.
  • Provide clinical consultation for internal stakeholders related to pharmacy benefits, medical-pharmacy integration, and cost-of-care initiatives.
  • Support PBM oversight activities, helping ensure contract compliance, quality performance, and effective program implementation.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) or Bachelor of Pharmacy degree required.
  • Active and unrestricted pharmacist license in the United States (specific state requirements may apply).
  • Minimum 2+ years of experience in managed care, health plan pharmacy, PBM, clinical pharmacy, or related setting.
  • Experience with formulary management, drug utilization analysis, and interpreting clinical evidence preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross‑functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with pharmacy claims data, UM tools, and pharmacy benefit design preferred.

Remote Work Requirements

  • High speed cable or fiber internet.
  • Minimum of 10 Mbps downstream and at least 1 Mbps upstream internet connection (can be checked at ).
  • Please review Remote Worker FAQs for additional information.

Benefits

  • Remote work options available
  • 401(k) with a 100% match for the first 3% of your salary and a 50% match for the next 2% of your salary (100% vested immediately). Qualify after 1000 hours of service.
  • Paid time off, including holidays.

Who We Are

WPS, a health solutions company, is a leading not-for-profit health insurer and federal government contractor headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin. WPS offers health insurance plans for individuals, families, seniors and group health plans for small to large businesses. We process claims and provide customer support for beneficiaries of the Medicare program and manage benefits for millions of active-duty and retired military personnel across the U.S. and abroad. WPS has been making healthcare easier for the people we serve for nearly 80 years. Proud to be military and veteran ready.

Culture Drives Our Success

WPS’ culture is where the great work and innovations of our people are seen, fueled and rewarded. We accomplish this by creating an open and empowering employee experience. We recognize the benefits of employee engagement as an investment in our workforce—both current and future—to effectively seek, leverage, and include differing and unique perspectives that fuel agility and innovation on high-performing teams. This results in people bringing their authentic selves to work every day in an organization that successfully adapts to business changes and new opportunities.

We are proud of the recognition we have received from local and national organization regarding our culture and workplace: WPS Newsroom - Awards and Recognition.

Ready to be a Titan?


As the PDR Manager I, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and implementing ServiceTitan’s Outbound Sales strategy. You will join a rapidly growing team and will be involved in helping recruit, onboard, and train numerous new hires for success. If you thrive in a fast-paced and exciting environment and want to help build out an extraordinary team and company, then this is the role for you.

Your primary focus will be on the outbound PDR team. Cold Calls, Cold Emails, Direct Mail, Creative Follow up, whatever it takes to help us find and help as many service contractors as we can. This role is incredibly important to the entire company, and you will be working hand-in-hand with leadership to build out the best PDR team in the country.


What You'll Do:


  • Manage the PDRs on objectives and performance achievement
  • Monitor lead processes, metrics, and catalyze pipeline creation
  • Shape and implement PDR strategy and processes
  • Stay abreast of and coach PDRs on best practices
  • Serve as a mentor for your team and be a steward of the ServiceTitan organization
  • Report to Sr. Management on operational and financial KPIs
  • Motivate, incent, and recognize team members to encourage top performance
  • Recruit, interview, and onboard new Team Members
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with each PDR
  • Help evaluate new technologies and programs to drive superior performance
  • Mentors other managers
  • Identifies trends and implementing strategies for improvement

What You'll Bring:


  • 3+ years experience as PDR/BDR (business development rep) or inside sales AND 3+ years of PDR management experience. Strong preference for OUTBOUND experience over inbound
  • Track record of success managing a high-performing inside sales team
  • Strong understanding of outbound pipeline generation processes
  • Enthusiastic and vibrant attitude
  • Expert communication and presentation skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills and high emotional intelligence
  • Analytical mindset comfortable generating reports and identifying trends in data
  • Adept at adopting and rolling out new sales enablement technologies, proficiency with Salesforce.com is a must

Be Human With Us:
Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.


Use of AI Technology:

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.


What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.
  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision (with 100% employer paid options and 90% coverage for dependents), FSA and HSA, 401k match, and telehealth options including memberships to One Medical.
  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in fertility services (i.e. IUI and IVF), surrogacy, and adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, pet insurance, legal advisory services, financial planning tools, and more.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), genetic information, protected military or veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

ServiceTitan is committed to fair and equitable compensation for all of our employees. We thoughtfully consider a wide range of factors when determining individual compensation, which may change over time. We comply with all applicable minimum wage laws. For candidates in the United States, the good faith salary ranges estimate for this role isZone 1: $112,500 USD Applicable for: CA, CT, DC, MD, MA, NJ, NY, VA, and WAZone 2: $105,100 USD Applicable for: All other US locations.This role is also eligible for a variable commission plan.International Compensation for candidates residing outside the United States will vary by location and will be discussed during the hiring process. Actual compensation within a range is determined by factors including relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and performance. In addition to base salary and variable commission, our total compensation package includes equity, and a holistic suite of benefits.

1 MISSION OF THE DEPARTMENT

Enable the WWF mission through driving a strong, inspiring, compelling and strategic communications approach to ensure and support conservation impact in line with the strategic priorities of WWF International.

Drive strategic communications to the Network, Governing bodies, International Secretariat, and leadership in support of WWF International strategic priorities. Drive the strategic alignment on articulating consistent external positions on emerging issues across the Network. Ensure a coherent ‘One WWF, One Voice’ by integrating and supporting the communications, media, and brand functions across WWF International and supporting these services to the network (offices in over 90 countries). Engage targeted audiences across the globe to accelerate conservation impact, influence decision makers and to build the WWF brand. Facilitate and coordinate the implementation of the global communications strategy. Provide common technology platforms, Network-wide, to enable communication with key audiences. Provide a Centre of Excellence to the Network and convene the Communications Community in terms of communications practice.

2 MAJOR FUNCTIONS

Work closely with the Global Communications Leadership Team (CLT) on implementing the department strategy, including prioritisation, forward planning and briefing-in stakeholder projects. Develop and maintain reporting mechanics to assess how we are delivering the department strategy, gathering information and insights for the CLT to help inform any course correction needed. Build and maintain strong relationships with the WWF Global Community of Communicators, acting as the liaison to the Global Comms department Lead integrated communications planning of flagship products and communications launches to ensure they are delivered on time and with strong impact and audience engagement Lead the Planning Unit in tracking communications projects, coordinating Network requests with relevant functional leads, and ensuring agreed commitments have a clear delivery plan

3 Major Duties and Responsibilities

Provide planning insights and recommendations to CLT to inform departmental strategy and prioritisation Work with functional leads to coordinate implementation of the department strategy, supporting integrated planning and alignment across teams Guide the department in various reporting mechanics to inform delivery and awareness of our departmental strategy within WWF International Field requests from the network for global comms support, ensuring alignment with our global priorities Oversee communications products that facilitate collaboration and integration with network communicators, including communicators newsletter and monthly calls Represent Global Communications in relevant organisational planning and coordination meetings, as agreed with department leadership, and share relevant information across teams Lead and support the development of strategic communications plans and messaging frameworks for agreed departmental priorities, working with relevant functional leads and subject experts to define objectives, priority audiences and key messages, and ensure consistent standards and quality across the department Manage the Specialist, Community & Project Management and delegate tasks accordingly Undertake any other task requested by the Director, Strategic Planning & Content

4 PROFILE

Required Qualifications.

University degree in a relevant field, or equivalent; Minimum of 10 years experience in strategic communications Management experience Experience working in a global environment.

Required Skills and Competencies.

Significant experience leading the development of marketing plans, communications plans, and/ or brand strategy Experience bringing together and leading cross-functional groups, building alignment across an organization Demonstrated ability to influence complex stakeholder relationships and build engagement and support across a wide range of complicated issues or projects Strong leadership with an ability to think strategically, creatively and laterally Excellent planning skills, including coordinating multiple stakeholders, managing multiple projects simultaneously, and delivering on time Excellent written and verbal communication skills Excellent interpersonal and diplomatic skills Effective negotiating and influencing skills A flexible and positive approach to problem-solving Dynamic individual who works well in a fast-paced global environment An open and participatory style that encourages creativity and cooperation Demonstrated skills and experience in managing high-level relationships with agencies and external partners An interest in and commitment to environmental and conservation issues Perfect command of English, and other languages an asset Embraces the WWF mission and values of the organization: Courage, Integrity, Respect & Collaboration

5 WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

Internal. Works closely with the Communications Leadership Team and all members of the department to ensure effective delivery of our strategy. Interacts frequently at a senior level with colleagues at WWF International and across the network. Acts as a key point of contact for department-wide planning and coordination, working closely with relevant functional leads. External. Works closely with external communication experts, design and advertising agencies or freelancers; partners and other NGOs

Mehr als 100 angehende Fach- und Betriebswirte werden jährlich bei dem digitalen Weiterbildungsinstitut ausgebildet. Die Kundenanzahl steigt von Monat zu Monat.
