Standard Job Description

Data Engineer Sr - Product Lifecycle Enablement

The Product Lifecycle Enablement organization is responsible for Enterprise PLM capabilities and processes, Engineering data strategy and implementation, and establishing common ontology & interfaces that enable 1LMX Digital Thread and embedded Al solutions.​

What You Will Be Doing:

In this role, you will be accountable for defining the MBE and engineering data strategy. Primary responsibilities include the following:

  • Defining engineer data stewardship roles and responsibilities
  • Acting as a data design authority for the model based enterprise
  • Documenting analytics architectures, strategies and metrics for a variety of audiences, including the executive level
  • Enforcing data integration and data access control best practices
  • Supporting Lockheed Martin data governance business rhythms and processes
  • Working closely with both functional and technical leads to ensure that analytics requirements are well understood, organized, and documented

Further Information About This Opportunity:
This role is fully remote. US Citizenship is required due to program requirements.

Delivers full-stack data solutions across the entire data processing pipeline. This relies on systems engineering principles to design and implement solutions that span the data lifecycle to: collect, ingest, process, store, persist, access, and deliver data at scale and at speed. It includes knowledge of local, distributed, and cloud-based technologies; data virtualization and smart caching; and all security and authentication mechanisms required to protect the data.Build data pipelines that clean, transform, and aggregate unorganized data into databases or data sources that are ready for analysis; Design and implement data solutions by defining functional capabilities, security, back-up, and recovery specifications; Work through all stages of a data solution lifecycle, e.g., analyze / profile data, create conceptual, logical and physical data model designs, architect and design ETL, reporting and analytics; Maintain data systems performance by identifying and resolving production and application development problems; calculating optimum values for parameters; evaluating, integrating, and installing new releases; Define standards, best practices, and certification processes for data objects

Basic Qualifications

  • Demonstrated knowledge of data stewardship, data ontology, and master data governance
  • Demonstrated knowledge of product lifecycle management tools and other engineering data repositories
  • Experience with data warehouses such as Oracle or DataBricks
  • Demonstrated knowledge of model-based engineering and data models
  • Experience supporting enterprise data systems or digital transformation
  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent experience
  • US Citizenship is required due to program requirements

Desired Skills

  • Demonstrated success in developing data ontologies
  • Ability to abstract, summarize and explain data and analytics concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to work across organization boundaries to leverage best practices and share assets
  • Experience in data engineering, data architecture, or data governance functions
  • Ability to manage ambiguous or competing requirements, collaborating with project teams to align on solutions.

Pay Information

GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role.

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $106600.00 - $198000.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $95900.00 - $178100.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $85300.00 - $158300.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc.
  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $76700.00 - $142500.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only.
Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

raw.title: Consulting Clinician - Pediatric Clinical Rater (French Fluency)
raw.excerpt: About Cogstate At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.
raw.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- VINELAND/VABS Administration Experience Required
- French Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MA/MS in Psychology or equivalent
  • ≥25 administrations of study scales or similar semi-structured clinical interviews
  • Experience working with pediatric populations with neurodevelopmental delays
    • Rare disease experience is a plus, including Angelman syndrome, Phelan-McDermid syndrome, Fragile X syndrome, or similar disorders
  • Vineland/VABS administration experience
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment, including experience working with pediatric populations and caregivers
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • French Fluency

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on the company. Privacy Notice for Job Applicants

Cogstate is committed to protecting your personal data. We collect and process your information for recruitment purposes in compliance with applicable laws, including the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs), the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA), Colorado Privacy Act (CPA), and similar laws in other jurisdictions.

EFM Formations est une école 100 % à distance qui prépare les talents de demain aux métiers de la Fonction publique. Nous proposons notamment des formations dédiées à la préparation des concours de sous-officier de gendarmerie (SOG) et de gendarme adjoint volontaire (GAV).

Dans le cadre du développement de notre équipe pédagogique, nous recherchons un expert métierspécialiste de la Gendarmerie nationale, disposant d'une solide expérience du terrain et capable de transmettre ses connaissances, de partager son expertise professionnelle et d'évaluer nos élèves selon les exigences des concours SOG et GAV.

Vos missions

En étroite collaboration avec notre équipe pédagogique, vous interviendrez principalement sur l'évaluation de nos élèves, avec des missions ponctuelles de création pédagogique :

  • Corrections d'épreuves écrites : évaluer et annoter les copies blanches (compositions, cas pratiques) en fournissant des retours constructifs, détaillés et personnalisés pour faire progresser les candidats à l’aide de notre outil de correction vidéo.

  • Simulations d'oraux : faire passer des épreuves orales blanches (jurys), évaluer la posture, les connaissances de l'institution et les motivations des candidats pour les préparer aux conditions réelles.

  • Création de contenus écrits et vidéos (missions ponctuelles) : intervenir ponctuellement sur la rédaction, l'optimisation ou la mise à jour de nos supports de cours. Vous pourrez également être amené(e) à animer des classes virtuelles, tourner des capsules pédagogiques ou des corrections d'annales en vidéo, agissant ainsi comme l'un des visages experts de notre préparation.

Profil et compétences recherchés

  • Expertise terrain : vous êtes obligatoirement gendarme (en activité, en disponibilité ou ancien militaire). Une expérience en tant que cadre instructeur en école de gendarmerie est un atout majeur.

  • Sens de la pédagogie : vous savez identifier les axes d'amélioration d'un candidat, structurer un retour écrit ou oral, et connaissez parfaitement les attendus, les pièges et la méthodologie des concours SOG et GAV.

  • Aisance audiovisuelle : vous êtes naturel et dynamique face caméra. Vous acceptez que votre image soit visible par nos élèves et utilisée sur nos plateformes. Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils numériques et de visioconférence.

  • Rigueur et bienveillance : vous êtes exigeant dans vos évaluations tout en sachant encourager et guider les candidats vers l'excellence.

Ce que nous offrons #teamEFM

  • Un poste 100 % à distance : travail depuis votre domicile, sans déplacement.

  • Une grande flexibilité : horaires libres et organisation autonome de vos interventions, en fonction du volume d'oraux blancs et de copies à corriger.

  • Une activité ponctuelle et adaptable, idéale en complément d'une activité professionnelle.

  • Une rémunération définie selon notre barème interne et le volume d'activité réalisé.

  • Une mission valorisante : contribuer directement à la formation des futurs gendarmes et transmettre votre expérience à vos futurs pairs.

  • Un accompagnement pédagogique : notre équipe prend en charge les aspects techniques, le montage et la mise en forme de vos contenus.

raw.description:
Are you an experienced forestry auditor who enjoys combining technical certification work with building strong client relationships? Do you want to help forest managers and companies across Indonesia and the Asia Pacific region strengthen responsible forestry practices? If so, this role could be the right fit for you.

What you can expect:

Preferred by Nature is looking for a Senior Forestry Specialist based in Indonesia to manage, audit and administer our forestry certification and verification services in Indonesia and the wider Asia Pacific region. Working with internationally recognised standards such as FSC Forest Management, FSC and PEFC Chain of Custody, SBP and Preferred by Nature’s own certification, you will lead audits, review the work of other auditors, manage a client portfolio and drive sales and market development. As one of the faces of Preferred by Nature in the region, you will play a key role in growing our forestry portfolio while keeping the quality of our audits high.

Working with us is never routine, so in your first year you can expect the following areas to be central to your work.

  • Conduct forestry certification and verification audits for assigned clients, including on-site visits, remote evaluations and report writing within agreed timeframes and quality requirements.

  • Act as task manager for your client portfolio, covering client support, audit budgeting, planning and scheduling, and keeping certification and verification records up to date.

  • Carry out quality reviews of audit reports, including technical review and certification or verification decisions within your qualifications.

  • Lead sales processes with potential clients, from presentations and scoping to preparing service proposals.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and stakeholders, providing excellent customer service together with the Asia Pacific team.

  • Support the development of the forestry certification market in Indonesia and across the region.

  • Ensure efficiency, quality control and adherence to Preferred by Nature’s operational, certification and verification protocols.

Your first year with us:

Within three months, you will:

  • Build a strong understanding of Preferred by Nature’s forestry certification and verification services, internal systems and procedures.

  • Get to know your assigned client portfolio in Indonesia and establish working relationships with the Asia Pacific team.

  • Begin conducting audits and task management for assigned clients, and start the qualification process for our schemes.

Within six months, you will:

  • Independently lead audits and manage your client portfolio, from planning and budgeting through to reporting.

  • Prepare service proposals and take part in client presentations and sales meetings with potential clients.

  • Progress towards quality reviewer qualifications for the key standards in your portfolio.

Within twelve months, you will:

  • Hold qualifications as auditor, quality reviewer and task manager for your assigned forestry schemes.

  • Manage a stable and growing client portfolio with consistent audit quality and strong client satisfaction.

  • Contribute actively to market development, identifying and following up on new business opportunities in Indonesia and the Asia Pacific region.

Important that you:

  • Hold a bachelor’s degree in forestry, natural resource management, environmental science or a related field.

  • Bring at least four years of relevant experience in the forestry industry, a certification body, an NGO or another international organisation.

  • Are qualified as an auditor under FSC Forest Management, FSC Chain of Custody, PEFC Chain of Custody and/or SBP.

  • Are fluent in written and spoken English and Bahasa Indonesia.

  • Have good communication and client management skills, and feel confident presenting to clients and preparing proposals.

  • Possess strong analytical and report-writing skills.

  • Have strong self-management skills, with the ability to stay focused and follow through on commitments.

  • Are comfortable travelling within Indonesia and the Asia Pacific region for on-site audits.

  • Are proficient in MS Office applications, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Would also be great, but not necessary, if you:

  • Have experience as a quality reviewer or task manager in a certification body.

  • Bring experience in sales or business development within a certification or consulting environment.

  • Have worked in an international, multicultural team.

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you!

What Sets Us Apart:

  • Global work culture

  • High degree of flexibility - remote work, work from home.

  • An in-depth onboarding and professional training that prepares you with the right skills and knowledge to thrive in this role.

  • Excellent opportunities for growth and professional development

  • Potential future international travel opportunities

  • A friendly, international team of colleagues, with a pleasant work environment

  • 20 days of vacation leave per year

Preferred by Nature

Preferred by Nature is a non-profit, mission driven organisation that works for sustainable land management and climate-friendly solutions. With 350+ employees and a network of local experts, we develop practical solutions to drive positive impacts in production landscapes and supply chains in 100+ countries. We focus on forest and climate impact commodities and related sectors.

How to apply:

If you feel you meet the requirements of the role, please submit your application, including salary expectations, via the application form below.

Application pre-screening will be conducted during the application period. Preferred by Nature wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

raw.description:
The Analytics Engineer III on the ACV Transportation team is a skilled practitioner who transforms raw data into trusted, decision-ready models and reports that drive the business forward. Sitting at the intersection of data engineering and business intelligence, this role contributes across the full analytics stack - from dbt model design and data quality to Omni BI dashboards - and partners with the Transportation Business to surface insights on operational risk and product initiatives. A key objective of this role is reducing ad-hoc analytical bottlenecks over time. You will be expected to answer urgent business questions quickly and directly, while systematically building the underlying dbt models, metric definitions, and BI layer in a way that enables self-serve analytics - including AI-assisted querying - so that business stakeholders can answer common questions themselves.

What you will do (Responsibilities):

Analytics Modeling & Data Quality:

Design, build, and maintain dbt models (staging, intermediate, production layers) that serve as the single source of truth for Transport KPIs, with machine-readability in mind

Enforce data quality through dbt tests, source freshness checks, and documentation so downstream consumers can trust what they see

Write complex SQL transformations on large datasets; optimize for cost and performance

Reporting & BI:

Translate business questions into well-scoped analytical requirements; define metrics in collaboration with Transport stakeholders and keep definitions governed in our semantic layer

Build upon our Omni BI semantic layer, enabling self-serve chat and dealer-facing embedded reporting

Balance responsiveness to ad-hoc requests while optimizing via building: triage what should be answered once vs. what should be codified so stakeholders or AI tools can self-serve it in the future

Deliver clear, compelling data narratives to non-technical stakeholders; support follow-on questions and iterate quickly

Transportation Business Domains:

Business Operations:

Support the business in ensuring visibility into trends, exceptions, making recommendations for cure

raw.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

Reports to the Sr. Director of Program Management. The Account Management team owns Reserv's customer relationships beginning in onboarding: we are the customer's single point of contact, the people who make sure claims service matches what was promised, and the reason customers renew and grow.

Our customer base has grown fast. This role owns a portfolio of roughly 30 MGA, carrier, and self-insured customers and is their reliable, responsive partner at Reserv. The work is high volume and hands-on: lots of inbound, lots of follow-through, and full attention for every customer in the book.

You will be an excellent fit if you are the most organized person on most teams you join, you answer fast and close the loop every time, and you like building the systems that let one person run a big book well. If you have helped a young company go from a handful of clients to dozens -- and built the process to support it -- we especially want to talk to you.

We hire owners. You see the whole outcome through, go to the details yourself, and keep a customer's confidence by being candid and keeping your word. You use sound judgment and look past today's fix to what would make the program better.

What you'll do

Book Ownership: Own the relationship for a portfolio of about 30 customers as their primary point of contact. Keep context across every account -- open issues, key contacts, recent claims activity -- so customers never have to repeat themselves.

Issue Resolution and Follow-Through: Drive inbound questions, service issues, and escalations to resolution, working with our claims, operations, finance, and data science teams to get answers. Close the loop with the customer every time, and spot repeat issues so they get fixed at the root.

Retention at Scale: Maintain a consistent touchpoint cadence across the book, monitor account health, and raise risk early. Make sure every customer gets the same quality of response and attention.

Systems and Scalability: Build and maintain the infrastructure that lets a high-volume book run well -- CRM hygiene, templates, cadences, and playbooks. Find the manual work that slows the book down and fix it, so the book can grow without anything getting missed.

Data and Insight: Be data fluent. Pull and explain claims data, and translate it into valuable insights for each customer. Spot trends across your accounts and flag risks and growth opportunities to leadership.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in account management, customer success, or client services, ideally carrying a book of 20+ accounts at once
  • Highly organized: you run many accounts in parallel without dropping threads, and you can show us how you do it
  • Fast, professional communicator -- in writing and live -- who keeps customers informed before they have to ask
  • A problem solver who works across teams to get issues closed, not just passed along
  • Data fluent: able to translate data into valuable insights for a customer
  • Working knowledge of P&C insurance or claims; deep specialization in a single line of business is not required
  • Startup experience growing a client base (say, from 2 clients to 50) and building the processes behind it is a strong plus
  • A record of owning outcomes end to end and delivering on your commitments
  • Bachelor's degree (lack of one should not stop you from applying if you possess all the other qualifications)

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • 100% remote (home-based) role designed to support your work-life balance paired with frequent, regular corporate retreats to build team cohesion, reinforce culture, and have fun
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- MADRS Administration Experience Required
- Japanese Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD, DO, MBBS or PhD, PsyD in Psychology or RN, APRN, PA, MA/MS/MSW in Psychiatry (or equivalent)
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • Japanese Fluency
  • MADRS Administration Experience Required

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

As a Senior Business Partner, Global FP&A & EPM, you will serve as the primary link between Finance and Enterprise Systems, supporting FP&A teams across North America, Europe, China, and Japan. You will lead the development and continuous improvement of Oracle EPM solutions while partnering with Finance leaders to enhance forecasting, planning, reporting, and decision-making processes.
This is a highly visible global role that combines business partnering, financial planning expertise, and technology leadership. The successful candidate will help drive standardization, automation, and forecasting excellence across a complex multi-region organization while ensuring Oracle EPM continues to support evolving business needs

What You Will Do:

Global FP&A Business Partnership

  • Partner with FP&A and Commercial Finance teams across global regions to support forecasting, planning, and performance management processes.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable reporting, planning, and automation solutions.
  • Drive consistency and standardization of planning processes, reporting, and key performance metrics across regions.
  • Promote global planning and reporting standards while balancing regional business requirements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to finance leadership on process improvements and system capabilities.

Oracle EPM Leadership & Transformation

  • Own the global Oracle EPM roadmap, prioritization, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Design, develop, and implement enhancements that improve planning efficiency, reporting quality, and user experience.
  • Lead testing, validation, and deployment activities for quarterly Oracle Cloud releases.

Governance & Operational Support

  • Provide advanced support for planning, reporting, and data-related issues.
  • Ensure integrity, reliability, and governance of financial planning systems and processes.
  • Develop documentation, training materials, and best practices for global users.
  • Partner with IT and Finance teams to support strategic transformation initiatives and enterprise projects.

To Be Successful You Will Have:

  • 5+ years supporting FP&A, financial planning, forecasting, or performance management functions.
  • 4+ years’ experience with Oracle EPM Planning / EPBCS.
  • Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, month-end reporting, and management reporting processes.
  • Experience supporting global stakeholders across multiple regions, currencies, and time zones.
  • Experience operating within a global, multi-currency environment.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Experience with Essbase, Smart View, Oracle EPM Reporting, and Financial Close processes.
  • Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence platforms.
  • Knowledge of Oracle E-Business Suite (R12) or other ERP platforms.
  • Demonstrated understanding of Hyperion System 9, SmartView, Essbase, and general MDBMS and OLAP concepts
  • Experience supporting commercial finance, revenue forecasting, or demand planning processes.

The Manager, Commercial Forecasting & Analytics Consulting will play a key role in leading analytics engagements and delivering strategic forecasting solutions to pharmaceutical and life sciences clients. This highly client-facing position requires a strong technical background in pharmaceutical forecasting and commercial analytics, combined with the ability to translate complex data into actionable business recommendations. You will work closely with clients and internal analytics teams to develop innovative solutions, oversee project delivery, and support strategic commercial decision-making.


This is your opportunity to join Inizio Engage and play a critical role in delivering high-impact Decision Optimization solutions for leading life sciences organizations.


Why You’ll Love Working Here


We believe great people deserve great support—at work and beyond. That’s why we offer a rewards experience designed to help you thrive personally, professionally, and financially:

  • Competitive pay that recognizes your experience, expertise, and impact
  • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; accrued paid time off; 401(k) with company match; disability and life insurance; and paid maternity and paternity leave
  • Company-paid holidays so you can rest, recharge, and focus on what matters most
  • Recognition programs, contests, and awards that celebrate your contributions
  • Continuous growth opportunities through learning, leadership development, and career advancement support
  • A collaborative culture where your ideas are valued and your work makes a difference

We’re also proud to be recognized for creating an exceptional employee experience:

  • Best Place to Work in BioPharma — 2022, 2023, 2025
  • Certified Great Place to Work® — 2021, 2023, 2025, 2026

Learn more:

What will you be doing?


  • Lead multiple pharmaceutical commercial analytics engagements, overseeing project delivery, analytical quality, timelines, and client satisfaction
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to pharmaceutical and life sciences clients, partnering with commercial stakeholders across brand, sales, marketing, market access, and commercial operations
  • Lead the development and delivery of pharmaceutical commercial forecasting solutions, including demand, patient-based, sales, product launch, and lifecycle forecasting models
  • Provide hands-on technical expertise and guidance in developing, validating, and enhancing forecasting models, methodologies, assumptions, and analytical outputs
  • Leverage Python, Databricks, Excel, and other analytical technologies to develop, maintain, and improve scalable forecasting and commercial analytics solutions
  • Conduct scenario planning, sensitivity analyses, and forecast assessments to evaluate market opportunities, commercial performance, and potential business risks
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, compelling business insights and strategic recommendations for clients and senior stakeholders
  • Lead client presentations, workshops, and strategic discussions, confidently communicating forecasting methodologies, assumptions, and recommendations
  • Guide analytics teams supporting commercial forecasting, targeting, engagement optimization, performance analytics, and other commercial decision-making initiatives
  • Provide leadership, technical guidance, and mentorship to analytics team members, ensuring high-quality deliverables and supporting professional development
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate market research, commercial data, competitive intelligence, and other relevant information into analytical solutions
  • Support proposal development, identify opportunities to expand client relationships, and contribute to account growth initiatives
  • Ensure engagement quality, delivery excellence, and profitability while maintaining strong client relationships and meeting project objectives

What do you need for this position?


  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or a related discipline
  • 7+ years of experience in analytics consulting, pharmaceutical commercial analytics, forecasting, or a related field
  • Experience developing or leading pharmaceutical commercial forecasting models, including demand, patient-based, sales, or launch forecasting
  • Strong Python skills and advanced Excel proficiency, with the ability to develop, evaluate, and validate complex analytical models
  • Understanding of pharmaceutical commercialization and how forecasting and analytics support strategic business decisions
  • Experience leading client engagements, managing projects, and providing guidance to analytical teams
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex analytics into actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications


  • Master's degree in a relevant quantitative discipline or MBA
  • Experience with Databricks, SAS, SQL, or other advanced analytical platforms
  • Exposure to commercial market sizing, sales force sizing, targeting, marketing analytics, or performance optimization
  • Experience working with pharmaceutical commercial data, including prescription trends, claims data, patient-level datasets, sales performance, and market analytics
  • Background in life sciences consulting, including proposal development, client account growth, or mentoring analytical professionals

The base pay range for this position is $150,000–$190,000 per year. The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, internal equity, and business needs.

Our passionate, global workforce augments local expertise and diverse mix of skills with data, science, and technology to deliver bespoke engagement solutions that help clients reimagine how they engage with their patients, payers, people, and providers to improve treatment outcomes. raw.description:
Milestone is looking for creative people who enjoy a challenge. We provide contracting excellence to our clients, daring them to let us collaborate on their toughest and most sensitive projects across Canada. Specializing in soil and ground remediation, water treatment, heavy civil construction, building decommissioning, land reclamation and rehabilitating sensitive habitats; our people thrive in a fast paced and everchanging environment. Everyone on our team believes in finding creative solutions for our clients while making a positive impact to our environment and community. This can be a tough job and isn’t for everyone. Milestone is up to the challenge, are you?

Milestone’s success comes from putting our team first. We are employee-owned and commit to keeping our people safe, offering competitive wages and benefits, and providing opportunity for professional growth and development. Putting our people first is a promise we have been able to deliver on for the last 10 years and we continue growing stronger. If you think you are a fit, then we want you to grow with us. Learn more about us and what we do on our website! MilestoneEnv.ca

At Milestone, we collaborate relentlessly; we strive to inspire a diverse team of talent; we care, we are equitable, we are inclusive. We want every team member to feel and know they belong here. We are inspired by our people - the best in the business. Our work with Indigenous partners and communities has been a tremendous source of pride and learning for Milestone. We are committed to Indigenous Peoples as partners and employees. We have much to learn from all our partners and employees. We look forward to continuing to attract and retain the best people to tackle the most complex challenges of a cleaner world. Only through acknowledging and encouraging everyone’s potential and contributions will we succeed.

Position Summary:

Milestone Environmental Contracting Inc. (MECI) is seeking a Marketing & Content Lead. This role leads and executes Milestone's marketing, content and brand initiatives. Reporting to the National Director, Business Development, the role works closely with Development and operational leaders to turn Milestone's projects, people, capabilities and partnerships into content and materials that strengthen the brand, support client engagement and contribute to business growth.

This is a hands-on role combining planning with direct execution. The Lead establishes priorities and personally develops much of the content, collateral and digital material, coordinating internal contributors and external specialists as needed. The role has no formal direct reports initially.

Responsibilities:

1. Content Creation & Storytelling

  • Develop, write, edit and publish marketing content highlighting projects, employees, capabilities, partnerships, community involvement and company achievements;
  • Develop project profiles, case studies, thought-leadership articles, website copy, external newsletters and other marketing communications;
  • Identify stories across the organization, interview project teams and subject-matter experts, and translate technical information into clear, engaging content;
  • Capture or coordinate photography and video content from projects, events and company activities;
  • Maintain a forward-looking content calendar aligned with Development priorities, projects, events and business objectives;
  • Confirm technical accuracy and obtain required internal, client and partner approvals before publishing project information, client names, site imagery or content involving Indigenous partners.

2. Marketing Collateral & Business Development Support

  • Personally develop and maintain client-facing capability statements, service-line brochures, project profiles, experience sheets, presentations and digital marketing assets;
  • Work with Development to identify materials and targeted campaigns needed for priority clients, target accounts, sectors, geographies and opportunities;
  • Support priority pursuits and client presentations in coordination with Business Development and Proposals, which retain ownership of pursuit strategy and proposal delivery;
  • Maintain an organized library of current, brand-compliant marketing assets and templates for use across the organization.

3. Marketing Leadership & Planning

  • Develop and recommend an annual marketing and content plan and supporting budget for approval by the National Director, Business Development and VP Development;
  • Secure approval from the same approvers for major campaigns and material changes to the plan or budget;
  • Set monthly and quarterly priorities and manage day-to-day requests and spending within the approved plan, budget and agreed business priorities;
  • Maintain brand standards and consistency across marketing channels and materials and identify opportunities to improve visibility in priority markets;
  • Coordinate internal contributors and manage external agencies, designers, photographers, videographers, printers and other specialists within approved budgets;
  • Provide practical guidance to employees contributing marketing content and coordinate with Corporate Services and HR on employee stories and company initiatives. Corporate and employee communications remain with Corporate Services and HR.

4. Social Media & Digital Marketing

  • Own Milestone's social media presence, including writing, design, scheduling and publication of content;
  • Manage website content to keep information current, relevant and aligned with business priorities;
  • Apply SEO best practices and support targeted digital campaigns that contribute to business objectives;
  • Monitor social engagement, website performance and campaign results, and use findings to improve content and channel effectiveness.

5. Events, Conferences & Brand Support

  • Develop marketing materials and content for conferences, trade shows, sponsorships and industry events;
  • Coordinate brand presence, displays, promotional materials and external vendors in support of agreed event priorities;
  • Support marketing communications before and after key events, working with Business Development and event leads on requirements and delivery.

6. Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish practical KPIs and report on marketing outcomes, priorities and upcoming initiatives;
  • Track delivery against agreed priorities, including support for target accounts and priority pursuits, collateral readiness, content schedules and responsiveness to business needs;
  • Assess content reach, audience engagement and how Development uses marketing materials in client conversations and pursuits;
  • Use feedback and performance results to improve planning, reduce reactive work and focus marketing effort where it creates the greatest business value.

Qualifications:

  • A degree or diploma in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Demonstrated experience independently planning and delivering B2B marketing, preferably in construction, environmental services, engineering or another technical industry;
  • Strong writing, editing and content development skills, supported by a portfolio of relevant work;
  • Hands-on experience producing marketing collateral, managing social media and updating website content through a content management system;
  • Practical design and layout skills using tools such as Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva and PowerPoint, with the judgment to engage specialist support when required;
  • Working knowledge of SEO, digital campaigns and marketing analytics;
  • Ability to manage competing priorities independently, work with technical teams and senior leaders, and coordinate external specialists;

Health and Safety:

  • Reads, understands and follows MECI’s Corporate Health and Safety Program, Policy and Procedures. Ensures health and safety is considered in the performance of all activities both on and off the job. Participation in H & S initiatives will be monitored and reviewed as necessary

Work Environment:

  • Remote work is supported. Occasional travel to Milestone offices, project sites or industry events is expected, generally less than 10%. Office visits are anticipated once or twice annually, with arrangements depending on employee location and business needs.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary based on experience, skills, internal equity, and work location;
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and prescription drug coverage;
  • Annual pro-rated $500 Health Spending Account;
  • Group Registered Savings Plan (GRSP) with employer matching after 3 months of employment;
  • Three weeks’ vacation to start;
  • Paid Annual Cultural Day to celebrate what matters most to you;
  • Annual professional development budget to support certifications, training, and career advancement.

We would like to thank all applicants for their interest, however only the ones selected for the interview will be contacted.

Salary: $85,000.00 - $105,000.00

raw.description:
Careyn biedt de kans om begin 2027 door te groeien van Verzorgende IG naar mbo Verpleegkundige via een erkend opleidingstraject. Werken en leren worden gecombineerd in een professionele omgeving met begeleiding van ervaren collega’s. De kennis en ervaring die je al hebt, vormen een waardevolle basis voor deze volgende stap. Je krijgt ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen in de zorg.

Requirements

Dit ga je doen als leerling Verpleegkundige

Als leerling mbo Verpleegkundige leer je in de praktijk en volg je daarnaast theoretisch onderwijs. Onder begeleiding ontwikkel je je tot een zorgprofessional met bredere verantwoordelijkheden. Je coördineert het verpleegkundig zorgproces, voert complexe handelingen uit en begeleidt collega’s in opleiding. Kwaliteitsverbetering en team coaching zijn belangrijke onderdelen van je leertraject. Een leerzame en afwisselende stap in je zorgloopbaan.

Wat werken en leren bij Careyn aantrekkelijk maakt

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding van zowel praktijkopleiders als ervaren collega’s.

  • Leren in een sector waar zorginnovatie, technologie en persoonsgerichte zorg steeds belangrijker worden.

  • Ruimte om te experimenteren, te leren en fouten te maken in een veilige omgeving.

  • Onderdeel worden van een hecht team dat samen leert en groeit.

  • Gericht voorbereid worden op een zelfstandige rol als Mbo Verpleegkundige.

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

  • Salaris volgens cao VVT, FWG 45 vanaf: € 2.981,98 (o.b.v. 36 uur).

  • Een leerarbeidsovereenkomst voor 24 tot 32 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vaste aanstelling na het afronden van je opleiding.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding, 8% vakantietoeslag en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering.

  • Vergoeding van lesgeld en studieboeken.

  • Uitzicht op een vaste aanstelling na diplomering.

  • Gedeeltelijke vergoeding voor je studie-uren

  • Mogelijkheid om gebruik te maken van het meerkeuzesysteem, zoals extra verlof of een fietsregeling.

  • Toegang tot o.a. HeyCoach, budgetcoach en DigiCoach voor jouw ontwikkeling.

  • Bij Careyn krijg je meer dan de arbeidsvoorwaarden uit de cao VVT. Meer weten? Bekijk onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Om de veiligheid van onze cliënten en medewerkers te waarborgen, is voor alle medewerkers die bij Careyn in dienst komen een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) vereist. Bij gelijke geschiktheid krijgen interne sollicitanten voorrang ten opzichte van externe kandidaten.

Conducts continuous improvement initiatives with an emphasis on reducing total cost of ownership.

  • Advanced communication and negotiation skills

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

About the Company

The client is a fast-growing technology company that develops innovative software solutions for the home improvement industry. Its platforms help contractors streamline their sales processes, generate accurate project estimates, and offer flexible financing options to homeowners.

The company's technology helps contractors simplify complex sales processes, connect homeowners with financing options through a single application, and turn more in-home consultations into signed and funded projects.

With more than $14 billion in project estimates powered through its platforms, the company is trusted by some of the most recognized names in the home improvement industry.

As the company continues to grow and expand its technology, it is seeking a highly experienced Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build, scale, and improve its financing platform.

About the Role

The Senior Full Stack Engineer will play a key role in building and scaling the company's home improvement financing platform.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role that requires strong backend development experience, particularly with .NET (C#), along with solid frontend capabilities using TypeScript and Angular or React.

The successful candidate will own features end to end, working across backend services, frontend applications, database architecture, third-party integrations, and cloud infrastructure.

Beyond writing production-quality code, this person will contribute to technical decisions, improve development practices, participate in code reviews, and mentor other engineers on the team.

The ideal candidate is someone who combines strong technical expertise with independent problem-solving skills, takes ownership of their work, and is comfortable leveraging AI coding agents as part of their daily development workflow.

Key Responsibilities

Backend Development

  • Build, maintain, and evolve backend services and APIs using .NET (C#) and ASP.NET Core.

  • Design and implement scalable, reliable, and maintainable backend architectures.

  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrations with third-party services.

  • Build asynchronous and event-driven systems, including message queues, background jobs, retries, and idempotent processing.

  • Design and maintain reliable webhook integrations, including signature validation, retry handling, duplicate prevention, and background processing.

  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code while maintaining high standards for performance and security.

Frontend Development

  • Design, build, and maintain modern web applications using TypeScript with Angular or React.

  • Develop responsive, user-friendly interfaces that support the platform's business requirements.

  • Collaborate with product and design teams to translate requirements into functional software.

  • Ensure frontend applications are maintainable, scalable, and properly integrated with backend services.

Database & System Architecture

  • Design and maintain PostgreSQL database schemas, migrations, and queries.

  • Optimize database performance and troubleshoot complex data-related issues.

  • Contribute to technical architecture decisions, considering scalability, security, performance, and long-term maintainability.

  • Work across different services and technologies as needed, including Python, Go, Ruby, and Elixir.

  • Identify opportunities to improve system reliability and overall application performance.

Cloud Infrastructure & Deployment

  • Deploy, maintain, and operate services across Azure and AWS environments.

  • Collaborate with the engineering team on CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.

  • Work with containers and cloud-based infrastructure as needed.

  • Monitor application performance and help identify and resolve production issues.

  • Contribute to improving the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of cloud-based systems.

AI-Assisted Development & Automation

  • Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code and GitHub Copilot as part of the daily development workflow.

  • Leverage AI tools to plan, write, test, debug, and review code more efficiently.

  • Apply independent technical judgment to validate AI-generated code and ensure its quality, security, and reliability.

  • Help improve how the engineering team integrates AI-assisted development into its processes.

  • Build and maintain automated QA processes, including end-to-end test suites using Playwright.

  • Ensure automated tests run consistently within CI pipelines.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead technical design discussions and contribute to important engineering decisions.

  • Conduct code reviews and maintain high standards for code quality.

  • Mentor other engineers and share technical knowledge across the team.

  • Collaborate with product, design, and support teams to understand business needs and deliver effective technical solutions.

  • Take ownership of assigned features and ensure they are delivered from development through production.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including full stack development.

  • Strong backend development experience with .NET (C#), ASP.NET Core, and Web APIs. This is the primary technical requirement for the role.

  • Strong TypeScript skills and production experience with Angular or React. Angular experience is preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, including database schema design, query optimization, and migrations.

  • Experience working with AI coding agents such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot to plan, develop, test, and review code.

  • Ability to independently evaluate, validate, and take ownership of AI-generated code.

The HR Specialist, Employee Relations is responsible for resolving complex employee relations (ER) matters for U.S. and Canada-based associates within the Diagnostics platform. This role provides expert consultation, investigation leadership, and programmatic ER support in partnership with HR Business Partners, People Partners, Legal, Payroll, and Centers of Excellence (COEs) to ensure consistent, fair, legally compliant, and defensible ER outcomes.


This position reports to the Director, Employee Relations and is part of the Employee Relations team and will be fully remote, supporting multiple time zones across the U.S. and Canada..

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Lead, conduct, and oversee employee relations level 1 investigations and support level 2 & 3 investigations, including policy violations, misconduct, retaliation, and ethics concerns managed following assigned SLAs, governance requirements, and documentation standards.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to managers and HR Business Partners by providing coaching and consultation on corrective actions, post-investigation countermeasures, performance management documentation, separation rationales, workforce transition business cases, team interventions, and associate engagement solutions.
  • Act as a key liaison and “voice of the operating companies,” partnering closely with Danaher Corporate Labor & Employee Relations, Legal, and HR COEs to ensure alignment, escalation, and risk-based decision-making.
  • Analyze employee relations data, trends, and root causes to identify systemic risks, prevention strategies, and opportunities to improve associate experience and organizational effectiveness.
  • Support continuous improvement of ER standard work, including intake models, investigation workflows, documentation practices, escalation pathways, training materials, and metrics reporting.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (advanced degree or HR certification preferred; equivalent experience considered) with 5+ years experience OR Master's degree in field with 3+ years experience OR Doctoral degree in field with 0+ years experience.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex employee relations matters, including investigations, disciplinary actions, and performance-related issues with sensitivity, professionalism, and discretion.  Leadership or mentoring experience desired.
  • Working knowledge of employment and labor laws (e.g., anti‑discrimination, retaliation, leave, accommodation) and their practical application in day‑to‑day casework.
  • Strong critical thinking, judgment, and problem-solving skills with the ability to operate independently in a complex, matrixed environment, demonstrating ability to remain composed in difficult situations, lean into constructive conflict, and model high integrity.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Senior Associate to join our Risk Adjustment Operations team. This role is responsible for supporting the end-to-end internal audit execution and supplemental data submission intake process. You will be instrumental in executing medical record requests, reviewing medical documentation for internal audit projects, validating provider-submitted data files, and coordinating data submission workflows. Beyond recurring submission cycles and internal audit reporting, you will partner cross-functionally with other Operations, Risk, Tech, and Compliance teams to support meeting critical business requirements and deadlines.

  • Supplemental File Validation: Review intake forms and provider-submitted data files validating claim control numbers, dates of service, and submission rationale while flagging truncated data or missing fields.
  • Quality Assurance & Error Tracking: Perform systematic quality assurance checks on audit outputs, log resolution summaries, and track error trends across quarterly submission runs.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Collaborate closely with internal Operations, Risk, Tech, and Compliance to resolve data pipeline errors and meet deadlines.
  • Process Documentation: Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for internal audit intake, chart review tracking, and data submission workflows.
  • Audit Closeout Support: Assist with finalizing audit projects, updating closeout trackers, and preparing preliminary reporting for leadership.

Required skills and experience:

Job Description

Trileaf Corporation is a nationwide environmental, architecture, and engineering consulting firm that assists clients with environmental due diligence, regulatory compliance, and engineering and architectural design. From its headquarters in St. Louis, MO, and multiple branch offices throughout the U.S., Trileaf serves the wireless communications, commercial real estate and financial industries.

Location: Remote

Job Summary:

As a Sr. Architectural Project Designer, you would be responsible for initiating and overseeing a subset of Trileaf’s architectural and MEP projects from conception to completion. You would leverage your experience in field conditions, building materials, specifications, construction techniques, as well as building codes and permitting to successfully execute Construction Documents, including coordination with other disciplines.

Trileaf’s project designers manage their own projects individually, with feedback and input from Trileaf’s Project Managers and Architects. As such, Trileaf’s project designers must be experienced enough to understand the permitting requirements of various states, identify and correct potential building code compliance issues, and complete CDs to the satisfaction of the Architect of Record as well as the local Authority Having Jurisdiction, with limited oversight and direction.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Manage a subset of Trileaf’s projects:
    • Perform a cursory overview of the project upon receipt, to identify any potential issues with the Design Intent, on-site conditions, and any additional services that might be necessary for the completion of the project (e.g. Structural engineering, civil engineering, Site Plans, etc)
    • Schedule a complete a kickoff meeting with the Architect of Record, during which you will go over the above, and your proposed solutions to each
    • Within 2-3 business days, complete a Background Drawing and provide to Trileaf’s internal MEP department, alongside a timeline for completion. As the project lead on this project, the overall timeline is your responsibility – as such, it is also your responsibility to hold the MEP department accountable to their timelines (within your authority to do so)
    • Over the course of the next 10-15 business days (dependent on the client and prototype), complete a full set of Architectural Construction Documents
    • Complete your own self-QA/QC to identify any errors
    • You will be working on multiple projects at a time

Additionally, you will have responsibility to work directly with the Client on your delegated projects:

    • Diplomatically ask questions, and talk clients through the costs and benefits of certain decisions
    • Provide periodic updates to the status of reports (typically once/week)

Finally, as part of your responsibilities, you will also be responsible for performing Permitting Assistance on some of the CDs you have produced:

    • Fill out Permit Applications, in coordination with the Client
    • Submit the CDs to the jurisdiction in the manner requested
    • Coordinate any Plan Review fees with the client, and work through the requirements for Trileaf to be reimbursed
    • Periodically follow up with the jurisdiction for updates, and provide those updates to the Client
    • Work through any redlines and/or demonstrations requested from the AHJ
    • Upon approval, pull the AHJ-stamped CDs and submit to the Client (if applicable)

Basic Qualifications:

To be considered, the resume of the applicant must demonstrate the following qualifications/skills:

  • 3+ years of experience completing Construction Documents
    • Experience specific to retail, convenience stores, and/or restaurants strongly preferred
  • Intermediate knowledge of Building Codes, including Accessibility Compliance
  • Strong drafting ability in AutoCAD; REVIT a plus
  • AIA/NCARB registration is desired but not required

Education:

  • BA/BS in Architecture, Interior Design, 5 years (or more) experience in CD development

raw.description:
about rtn mental health

At RTN Mental Health Solutions we believe in taking care of our people just as well as we take care of our patients. We are on a mission to make ADHD and ASD diagnosis and support clear, compassionate, and truly life-changing. We’re a growing network of passionate professionals, but our core purpose remains the same: putting the people we support at the heart of everything we do.

Whether you’re working directly with our clients or behind the scenes, you’ll be part of a warm, neuro-affirming team that lives by three simple values: Respect for every individual's unique story, Transformation through curiosity and innovation, and Nurture by supporting one another to grow.

the role

Reporting to the Medical Director, our Medical team is looking for an experienced Clinical Lead Psychiatrist to provide senior clinical leadership across our ADHD assessment and treatment pathways, with a dedicated focus on complex case titration and multi-professional clinical supervision.

role responsibilities

You will be:

  • Leading and conducting four half-day ADHD titration clinics per week (two days weekly), managing complex adult physical and mental health comorbidities across NHS and Right to Choose (RTC) pathways.

  • Carrying out structured psychiatric assessments for complex ADHD presentations, confirming diagnoses using standardised tools, and communicating outcomes clearly and compassionately with clients and families.

  • Providing clinical leadership, supervision, clear medical advice, and teaching to our multidisciplinary prescribing team, which includes pharmacists, nurses, non-medical prescribers, and psychiatrists.

  • Taking responsibility for the overall safe running of the service and leading clinical compliance and preparation for upcoming CQC inspections (comprehensive handover and regulatory onboarding provided).

  • Overseeing the day-to-day clinical logistics of the titration service in close collaboration with our Service Delivery Manager, ensuring swift prescription turnaround, audit adherence, and Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) development.

  • Supporting key clinical and operational service transformations, including contributing to our migration toward electronic prescribing systems (EPS).

  • Keeping accurate, timely, and compliant clinical records that clearly outline medical formulation and diagnostic rationale in line with GMC and CQC standards.

about you

  • Qualifications: Full General Medical Council (GMC) registration with a licence to practise in the UK, a Certificate of Completion of Training (CCT) in General Adult Psychiatry (on the GMC Specialist Register), and Section 12(2) approval under the Mental Health Act.

  • Clinical & Titration Expertise: Substantial, demonstrable experience in ADHD medication titration—ideally within the NHS or with complex Right to Choose (RTC) patient groups—with confidence in managing complex physical and psychiatric comorbidities without unwarranted clinical caution.

  • Diagnostic Assessment Skills: Proven experience conducting comprehensive psychiatric assessments for ADHD using recognised diagnostic frameworks and standardised tools (e.g., DIVA, ACE).

  • Leadership & People Management: Strong supervisory skills with an approachable and collaborative leadership style; able to communicate definitive medical guidance and mentor experienced multidisciplinary clinicians and prescribers.

  • Governance & Compliance Mindset: A genuine commitment to quality, compliance, and regulations, with readiness to undertake the Registered Manager role and champion CQC standards (prior Registered Manager or direct CQC inspection experience is advantageous, but full transition training is supported).

  • Operational Agility: Confident working cross-functionally with operational teams, comfortable engaging with audit and SOP design, and adaptable to clinical IT systems and electronic prescribing workflows.

  • Right to Work & Safeguarding: Based in the UK with the permanent right to work (sponsorship unavailable) and an Enhanced DBS on the Update Service (or willingness to undertake one).

our values in action

We actively encourage applications from neurodivergent individuals, people with lived experience, and candidates from all backgrounds. We are committed to promoting equality, diversity, and inclusion across our workforce.

As a provider supporting children, young people, and adults at risk, RTN is dedicated to safeguarding. All appointments are subject to standard pre-employment checks.

We want everyone to have an equal chance to show their strengths. If you require any reasonable adjustments or extra support during the application or interview process, please let us know at .

why us?

  • Permanent role, full-time or part-time (full-time working week is 9:00am to 5:30pm).

  • £150,000 per annum.

  • 100% remote working

  • Structured handover and dedicated mentorship from the outgoing Lead

  • 22 days annual leave + 8 bank holidays.

  • Inclusive and supportive culture where individuality and neurodiversity are celebrated.

  • Employer pension scheme.

  • Private Medical Insurance with Vitality.

  • Full IT equipment and tools for the job, alongside dedicated investment in your professional learning and development.

raw.description:
We’re looking for an analytical, hands-on client success leader to own our client relationships and lead implementations from kickoff through go-live and beyond. You’ll be the trusted partner for institutional clients, lead complex onboarding projects, and drive retention and growth across your accounts. You’ll also help build how client success works at KOR. If you have deep experience in OTC derivatives or regulatory reporting, like being close to the detail as well as the relationship, and use modern tools (including AI) to scale what you do, this role is for you. We’ll hire at Manager or Director level depending on experience.

About us

We are a VC backed fintech with a live product in the regulatory trade reporting space and growing list of institutional clients. Our product journey has started in the US with expanded services covering Canada, UK, EU, Australia and Singapore. If you want to join a scale-up that is going to provide growth and ownership, keep reading.

KOR is a company built on leading edge cloud technology built by industry domain experts and world class in-house engineering. We're on a mission to innovate B2B trade servicing starting with regulatory reporting in time for a global wave of mandated changes hitting all segments of market participants across OTC derivatives transactions. We’re solving the most challenging problems around by bringing fresh designs and solutions to data utility, quality, and processing inefficiencies... while unlocking insane value for clients.

Teamwork and laser focus are central to everything we do at KOR. With the right support, we believe small independent teams with deep expertises achieve better results and encourage skilled people to take responsibility and grow their careers. We live by the mantra of work humble, work smart, and work together.

What you’ll do

  • Own a portfolio of institutional client relationships across EMEA/UK, from operations teams up to senior stakeholders

  • Lead client implementations end to end: scoping, planning, coordinating with our engineering team, test cycles and go-live

  • Be the senior escalation point, working through complex reporting, data and regulatory issues with clients

  • Drive retention, renewals and account growth, and partner with sales on expansion and new client pre-sales

  • Define and improve client success processes: onboarding playbooks, health scoring, QBRs and escalation paths

  • Use AI and automation to scale the team’s work and lift the client experience

  • Bring client and regulatory insight back into product priorities and KOR working groups

  • Visit clients on-site for kickoffs, go-lives, executive meetings and relationship reviews

  • Director level: lead and grow the EMEA/UK client success team, including coaching analysts, and own CS metrics and reporting to leadership

Requirements

About you

You’re analytical, client-facing and hands-on. You like to understand how things work, you’re comfortable going deep into data, and you take ownership of outcomes. You see AI and modern tooling as a way to do better work faster, not a novelty.

  • 6+ years in OTC derivatives or regulatory reporting, with significant client-facing or implementation experience (Director: 10+ years, including leading people or a function)

  • Strong working knowledge of EMEA/UK regimes (EMIR, REMIT, MIFID), with exposure to CFTC, SEC, CSA, ASIC or MAS as a plus

  • Proven track record leading complex implementations for institutional clients

  • Experience owning client relationships, renewals and account growth

  • Analytical and comfortable with data: able to diagnose an issue yourself before escalating

  • Already using AI tools in your daily work and keen to shape how a team uses them

  • Excellent communicator, from technical teams to executives

  • Based in EMEA/UK region and happy to travel to clients regularly (around 10–20%)

  • Nice to have: SQL, APIs/JSON, ISO 20022 or FpML, experience at a reporting vendor or trade repository, experience building a CS function at a scale-up

At KOR, company culture and fit to it is everything to us. We are looking for an open-minded, humble, driven, communicative, team-player to join us.

What we have to offer

  • Fully remote

  • A culture of trust, ownership and constructive feedback

  • Competitive salary

  • A modern tool stack, including AI, and room to shape how we use it

  • A span of control that matches your ambitions and skills

  • Tell us what else matters to you

Beyond the package, we’re committed to a working relationship that runs both ways. We’ll listen, take your needs and goals seriously, and invest in your professional growth. If you want room to grow at a company that values your work and backs your ambitions, we’d like to hear from you.

Highlights

Own EMEA/UK client relationships, lead implementations and drive growth. Analytical, hands-on, AI-savvy. Fully remote in EMEA/UK region with regular client travel.
