raw.description:
Position Purpose:
Performs regulatory oversight of delegated vendors supporting assigned markets, independently managing a portfolio that includes complex, high-risk, or multi-function delegation arrangements. Applies advanced knowledge of delegation oversight to analyze delegate performance and compliance with contractual obligations and applicable CMS, NCQA, federal, and state requirements; plans and conducts audits and monitoring reviews; supports the development and tracking of corrective action plans; escalates significant risks to leadership; and serves as a resource to less experienced team members.


Key Details: Applicants for this job have the flexibility to work remote from home anywhere in the Continental United States.


  • Serves as the senior market-level point of contact for regulatory oversight of assigned delegated vendors and delegated functions, including complex, high-risk, or multi-market delegation arrangements.
  • Monitors and analyzes delegate performance against contractual requirements, service-level expectations, regulatory standards, and market-specific obligations, including applicable CMS, NCQA, federal, and state requirements; identify trends, root causes, and systemic risks across delegates and markets.
  • Reviews delegate policies, procedures, reports, operational evidence, and documented processes to assess alignment with contractual and regulatory requirements.
  • Plans and conducts oversight activities, including desktop and onsite audits, file reviews, sample selection, monitoring reviews, and validation of submitted evidence and performance data; determine audit scope based on risk.
  • Identifies, assess the severity of, and communicate compliance gaps, performance deficiencies, emerging risks, and overdue deliverables; recommend risk-based mitigation strategies to delegates, internal stakeholders, and leadership.
  • Reports compliance issues and assist with development and management of corrective action plans and quality improvement activities through completion; evaluate the sustainability of remediation; and recommend escalation, enhanced monitoring, or sanctions, up to and including de-delegation, for unresolved or recurring issues in line with established governance processes.
  • Partners with market Compliance, Operations, Quality, Legal, Procurement, and business owners to coordinate oversight activities; serve as a subject matter expert advising on delegation requirements, contract language, and consistent vendor management practices.
  • Prepares and presents clear, accurate, and timely oversight documentation and analyses, including monitoring results, risk summaries, trend reports, and dashboards, for leadership and compliance committees.
  • Leads Joint Oversight Committee and other delegate governance meetings; present findings and recommendations, document decisions, assign action items, and hold delegates accountable for commitments through closure.
  • Coordinates delegate oversight deliverables for regulatory examinations, accreditation surveys, internal and external audits, and readiness reviews; serve as a primary point of contact for auditors and regulators on assigned delegates.
  • Maintains complete and audit-ready records in designated systems and lead continuous improvement of oversight tools, audit templates, controls, and standard work.
  • Monitors regulatory, contractual, and accreditation changes; assess their impact on delegated functions; and recommend updates to oversight policies, procedures, audit tools, and delegation agreements.
  • Provides guidance, training, and mentorship to Delegation Oversight Specialists and other team members; review work products for quality, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's Degree Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Compliance, Quality, or related field; or equivalent experience required

Are you an experienced forestry professional who enjoys combining technical audit work with building strong relationships across the region? Do you want to help forest managers and companies in Central Africa raise the bar for responsible forestry? If so, this role could be the right fit for you.

What you can expect:

Preferred by Nature is looking for a Senior Forestry & Sustainability Specialist based in Cameroon, Gabon, the Republic of the Congo, the Democratic Republic of the Congo or Côte d'Ivoire. As one of our key representatives in Central Africa, you will deliver high-quality forestry certification services under schemes such as FSC, PAFC and Preferred by Nature's own certification, support stakeholder engagement and business development, and contribute to sustainability projects in the region. Most of your time will be spent on certification and assurance work, with the rest focused on regional engagement, training and project development.

Working with us is never routine, so in your first year you can expect the following areas to be central to your work.

  • Conduct FSC, PAFC, Preferred by Nature certification and related audits and assessments, in line with our internal quality procedures and accreditation requirements.

  • Prepare and review audit reports to a high technical standard.

  • Manage audit schedules and your certification client portfolio, and provide technical support to clients.

  • Promote Preferred by Nature's services and support our regional strategy and commercial objectives.

  • Build relationships with stakeholders and institutions, and represent Preferred by Nature at relevant events.

  • Facilitate training courses and workshops.

  • Support proposal development and donor engagement, and contribute to sustainability projects beyond certification.

Your first year with us:

Within three months, you will:

  • Build a strong understanding of Preferred by Nature's forestry certification services, internal systems and quality procedures.

  • Get to know your client portfolio and key stakeholders in Central Africa.

  • Take part in audits and begin the qualification process for our schemes.

Within six months, you will:

  • Lead audits and prepare audit reports independently, and manage audit schedules for your portfolio.

  • Represent Preferred by Nature in meetings with clients, stakeholders and institutions.

  • Contribute to proposals and training activities in the region.

Within twelve months, you will:

  • Manage a stable certification portfolio with consistent audit quality and strong client satisfaction.

  • Review the reports of other auditors and act as a technical reference in the region.

  • Actively contribute to business development, partnerships and new sustainability projects in Central Africa.

Important that you:

  • Hold a bachelor's degree or higher in forestry, environmental sciences, natural resource management or a related field.

  • Bring at least three years of relevant experience in forestry, certification, sustainability or auditing.

  • Are qualified as an auditor under FSC, PAFC or a similar forest certification scheme.

  • Are professionally fluent in English and French.

  • Are available to travel regularly, nationally and internationally, mainly within Central Africa and Côte d'Ivoire.

  • Have strong analytical and report-writing skills.

  • Communicate well with clients and stakeholders, and are comfortable representing an organisation.

  • Have strong self-management skills and follow through on commitments.

Would also be great, but not necessary, if you:

  • Have experience building professional networks and developing new business opportunities.

  • Have experience managing projects, facilitating trainings or developing proposals for donors.

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you!

What Sets Us Apart:

  • Global work culture

  • High degree of flexibility - remote work, work from home.

  • An in-depth onboarding and professional training that prepares you with the right skills and knowledge to thrive in this role.

  • Excellent opportunities for growth and professional development

  • Potential future international travel opportunities

  • A friendly, international team of colleagues, with a pleasant work environment

  • 20 days of vacation leave per year

Preferred by Nature

Preferred by Nature is a non-profit, mission driven organisation that works for sustainable land management and climate-friendly solutions. With 350+ employees and a network of local experts, we develop practical solutions to drive positive impacts in production landscapes and supply chains in 100+ countries. We focus on forest and climate impact commodities and related sectors.

If you feel you meet the requirements of the role, please submit your application in English, including salary expectations, via the application form below.

raw.description:
Join Cinnamon to make the Roblox games you want to build. Once you’re on the team, you’ll pitch your own ideas through our greenlight process. If your game is approved, we’ll fund development, hire the team with you and back the launch. You’ll lead the creative direction.

The Role

We’re looking for a game maker to lead Pod E. You’ll lead development from the first playable prototype through launch and live updates. You’ll stay hands-on in your discipline, whether that’s art, programming or game design. You’ll decide which skills the game needs and help choose who joins your team. Cinnamon handles recruitment, contracts and studio operations so you can focus on making the game and leading the people building it. Our marketing team will work with you on the launch and help the game reach its audience.

About Cinnamon

Cinnamon is an independent Roblox studio behind LifeTogether (4+ billion visits), BlockSpin (1.3+ billion) and BayView (600+ million). We built these games from scratch, own them outright and use their success to fund what we make next. No investors. Our main Roblox community has 1.4M+ members. Our other Roblox groups include Cinnamon Go! (414.1K+), Cinnamon Cars (238.5K+) and Cinnamon X (46.6K+).

What You’ll Do

  • Pitch original game concepts and turn them into playable prototypes.

  • Work hands-on in your discipline and lead decisions on gameplay, presentation, progression and monetisation.

  • Define the roles your game needs, help select the team and set development priorities.

  • Use playtesting, player feedback and game data to decide what to improve.

  • Lead the game through launch and ongoing updates.

What We’re Looking For

  • Playable examples of games you’ve made, with a clear explanation of what you personally created, designed or led.

  • Hands-on experience in art, programming or game design and the judgement to make decisions about the whole game.

  • The ability to take a game from prototype to release, lead a small team and give feedback people can act on.

We want to see games with a clear creative identity. Show us a clever mechanic, a distinctive world or a fresh take on a familiar genre. Please leave brainrot clones out of your submission.

Roblox experience is highly valued. We also welcome game makers from other engines who want to build in Roblox Studio.

Working Arrangements and Compensation

This is a full-time, fully remote role. We’re open to permanent employees based in the UK who already have the right to work here and contractors based anywhere in the world. We’ll discuss time zone overlap during recruitment. Eligible UK permanent employees receive a company pension. We don’t offer visa sponsorship.

Compensation combines a base salary or contractor rate with a share of the game’s profits. We’ll agree the balance during recruitment. You can choose lower base pay with a higher profit share or higher base pay with a smaller profit share.

Recruitment Process

  1. Application review.Send us links to games you’ve made and tell us what you personally contributed to each.

  2. Recruiter interview.If shortlisted, you’ll meet with our recruiter to talk about your experience, the games you’ve made and what you’d like to build next.

  3. 48-hour creative task.You choose the concept. Build a Roblox game from scratch or add something playable to a Roblox game you’ve already made, such as a new level, mechanic or feature. If you build on an existing game, tell us what you added during the 48 hours. Submit a playable Roblox experience link. Roblox Studio files are ineligible. We’ll play your game and assess the idea, how it feels and what you built. AI tools are welcome. Be ready to explain your decisions and contribution.

  4. Final discussion.Meet our Operations Manager and relevant team members to discuss what you’d like to build, who you’d need on your team and how you’d structure your compensation. If there’s a strong fit on both sides, we’ll move to a formal offer or contractor agreement.

🎉 If there’s a strong fit on both sides, we’ll move to a formal offer.

Job Description:

We welcome remote candidates based in the continental United States. Travel up to 25% may be required based on client needs.


Merkle is seeking a Director, Business Value Consulting to help clients quantify the business impact of strategic technology, customer experience, AI, and digital transformation investments. You'll build the financial and measurement frameworks that turn ambiguous initiatives into clear, defensible numbers, then translate those numbers into recommendations executives can act on. This role blends financial modeling with broader value-realization work: measuring whether change is actually landing, and putting a number on what happens when it doesn't.


You will lead the development of compelling business cases and comprehensive financial models including P&L projections, ROI analysis, and budget forecasting that are critical to client success.


You will join a group of problem-solvers who draw inspiration from everywhere and build solutions that make clients say "wow" including FP&A practitioners, data analysts, consultants, and business analysts. Together, you will articulate and measure the value of dentsu and Merkle solutions, driving higher close rates and revenue through credible business valuation approaches. You'll begin as a detective, uncovering the hidden value in client challenges. You'll evolve into an architect, designing frameworks that turn ambiguity into advantage. You'll become a translator, helping executives see the future through the lens of data.

You Will:

  • Build measurement frameworks that connect program adoption to customer, employee, and business outcomes
  • Quantify the financial impact of delayed or unresolved initiatives, not just the upside of new investments
  • Partner with our consulting teams to lead individual deliverables related to Business Value projection and transformation engagements, often coordinating with concurrent Merkle data, technology, or digital experience implementation teams
  • Plan and facilitate client discovery through client interviews, document review, surveys/questionnaires, or marketing data analysis
  • Manage daily consulting delivery efforts, including client meetings, discussions, workshops, deliverable reviews, or readouts
  • Support governance and steering committee reporting with clear financial narrative and value tracking over time
